title: GPU Compute & MLIR Compiler Principal Engineer — AI Workloads
description:
**Company:**
------------

Qualcomm India Private Limited

**Job Area:**
-------------

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering

**General Summary:**

* Drive technical direction and execution of AI and Generative AI workloads on GPU platforms.
* Lead exploration and optimization of emerging workloads including LLMs, transformer-based models, computer vision, and other AI/ML applications.
* Collaborate across architecture, compiler technologies and frameworks such as TVM, MLIR, and IREE, software, performance, and product teams to drive solutions from early exploration through product-quality implementation.
* Provide technical leadership, conduct design reviews, and mentor engineers working across GPU AI initiatives.
* Develop and optimize GPU solutions leveraging capabilities such as matrix acceleration, mixed-precision computation, quantization, and other hardware acceleration features.
* Analyze end-to-end AI workload performance and identify bottlenecks across models, frameworks, compilers, runtimes, GPU kernels, and hardware architecture.
* Drive compiler and runtime optimizations to improve AI workload performance, power efficiency, and scalability.
* Evaluate emerging AI models, algorithms, frameworks, and optimization techniques and assess their implications for future GPU architectures.
* Work closely with GPU architecture teams to translate workload analysis into actionable recommendations for future architectural capabilities.
* Develop prototypes and proof-of-concepts to evaluate new ideas and demonstrate GPU capabilities for AI workloads.
* Communicate technical findings, trade-offs, recommendations, and results effectively to both engineering and leadership audiences

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 8+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.

OR
  
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 7+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.

title: Solutions Architect, MADS Support
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are looking for a passionate, customer-obsessed Solutions Architect to join the Amazon Ads team. In this role, you will serve as the primary technical point of contact for customers during their onboarding journey — guiding them through implementation, troubleshooting technical issues, translating customer needs into actionable engineering and program requirements, and acting as a technical Customer Success Manager.  
This is a customer-facing role that demands strong technical depth across AWS services, excellent communication skills, and a project management mindset. You will be the bridge between customers and internal teams, ensuring a seamless onboarding experience while advocating for customer needs.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Key Responsibilities  
  
Customer Onboarding: Own end-to-end technical onboarding of customers onto Amazon Ads solutions, ensuring smooth and timely implementation.  
Technical Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve technical issues across the AWS stack, working closely with customers and internal engineering teams to drive resolution.  
Customer Advocacy: Act as the voice of the customer — collect and synthesize VOC (Voice of the Customer) feedback, and translate customer questions, pain points, and feature requests into engineering and program-level requirements.  
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering, product, and program teams to drive resolution of customer issues and influence the product roadmap based on customer insights.  
Technical Customer Success Management: Proactively monitor customer health, identify risks, and drive adoption by ensuring customers realize the full value of the solutions they are onboarding onto.  
Documentation & Enablement: Contribute to onboarding runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge base articles to improve the onboarding experience at scale.  
Project Management: Manage multiple customer onboarding engagements simultaneously, tracking milestones, dependencies, and deliverables to ensure on-time delivery.  
  
Basic Qualifications  
  
3+ years of experience in a Solutions Architect, Cloud Engineer, or similar customer-facing technical role.  
Hands-on experience with AWS services, including:  
AWS CloudFormation  
Amazon S3  
AWS Glue  
Amazon Athena  
Amazon EventBridge  
AWS Lake Formation  
AWS Clean Rooms  
  
Proficiency in SQL and Python for data analysis, scripting, and automation.  
Experience managing technical projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.  
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills with a bias for diving deep into root causes.  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
Familiarity with Boto3 / AWS SDKs for programmatic AWS resource management.  
Experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (PETs) or data collaboration concepts.  
AWS Certification (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional).  
Prior experience in a Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or Support Engineering role.  
Experience working with cross-functional teams across different time zones.  
Background in advertising technology or digital marketing platforms.  
  
Leadership Principles Emphasized  
  
Customer Obsession: You start with the customer and work backwards. You are relentless about earning and maintaining customer trust through every interaction.  
Dive Deep: You operate at all levels, stay connected to the details, and audit frequently. No issue is beneath you when a customer needs help.  
Bias for Action: You take swift, calculated action to unblock customers and drive progress — speed matters in onboarding.  
Deliver Results: You own the customer onboarding outcome. You focus on the key inputs, track milestones, and deliver with the right quality in a timely manner, even in the face of setbacks.  
Earn Trust: You listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat customers and colleagues with respect. You are transparent about challenges and proactive about solutions.  
  
A day in the life  
You will start your day reviewing customer engagement progress and preparing for technical design sessions. Much of your time is spent working directly with customer stakeholders, whiteboarding architectures, writing code, or refining solution designs that balance complexity, scale, and performance. You will regularly collaborate with delivery teams and AWS service teams, contributing to governance discussions and ensuring smooth handoffs from presales to delivery. Between customer meetings, you might review a colleague's technical proposal, draft a blog post capturing lessons learned, or explore how generative AI tools can enhance a customer's solution.  
  
About the team  
We partner with customer teams and our Engineering Partners and AWS Teams to execute cloud computing initiatives, delivering focused guidance through specialty practices that cover a broad range of solutions, technologies, and industries. Our culture is built on collaboration, empathy, and inclusion. We are committed to continuous learning and encourage every team member to grow, share knowledge, and contribute to an environment where creative problem-solving drives meaningful customer impact.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of IT implementation experience
* Experience and technical expertise (design and implementation) in cloud computing technologies
* Experience leading the design, development and deployment of business software at scale or recent hands-on technology infrastructure, network, compute, storage, and virtualization experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Associate Gen AI Engineer
description:
**Introduction**  

Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

  
**Overview**

You will partner with business stakeholders to design AI-driven extraction rules that convert unstructured documents into high‑value structured data. You’ll craft and evaluate prompts for LLM-based extraction, maintain a Python codebase that powers workflows, and translate stakeholder needs into repeatable, auditable extraction pipelines.

  
  
**How you'll make an impact**

**Responsibilities:**

  

* Translate business requirements into precise extraction targets, schemas, and quality thresholds.
* Design, test, and iterate prompts for LLM-based extraction; implement evaluation protocols (e.g., accuracy, precision/recall).
* Configure and maintain extraction workflows in Python, including parsing, validation, and post-processing rules.
* Triage and resolve minor code issues; write unit tests and improve logging, monitoring, and error handling.
* Work closely with the GB Data Science team in the US in an onsite-offshore model.
* Partner with business owners to review outputs, prioritize improvements, and manage a backlog in Azure DevOps.

  
  
**About you**

**Qualifications:**

* Preferred Degree: Bachelor’s / Master’s Degree in Statistics / Applied Math/Stats
* Experience: 2- 5 years as AI Engineer or Prompt Engineer, Understanding of designing data science experiments

**Preferred qualifications:**

* An undergraduate/Masters degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
* Experience with enterprise-scale datasets or high-volume document processing.
* Exposure to Azure services, ideally Azure AI Search/Cognitive Search and Azure OpenAI, Databricks, Snowflake
* Employees should have experience in Python/Spark, CI/CD, Sci-Kit Learn, Git.
* Practical experience crafting prompts for LLMs and evaluating outputs (few-shot prompts, structured output formats, guardrails).
* Ability to read/modify Python scripts, debug minor issues, and write clear, maintainable code.
* Strong communication skills: can elicit requirements, clarify edge cases, and document decisions and workflows.
* Working knowledge of handling sensitive data securely and following standardized procedures.

  
  
**Additional Information**

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
* A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership
* The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact

**At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.

title: Principal Engineer – AI Engineering
description:
GE Vernova is embracing cutting-edge technologies to streamline operations, improve customer experiences, and drive growth. As part of this vision, we are building a dedicated team to leverage Generative AI and redefine how we engage with our industry. The ultimate goal of the team is to automate prompting, develop a framework for prompting across use cases to maximize reuse as well as sharing across businesses.
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated and talented AI Engineer to join our dynamic team. The successful candidate will be responsible for creating and optimizing prompts for LLMs, collaborating with domain experts and end users to develop software solutions that address both internal and external needs. This position offers a great opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced technology and traditional industry, making a tangible impact on our business processes.
  
  
We are driving strategy and leading research & development efforts to execute on the business’s mission to help power the energy transition. We forge the collaborations and help invent the technologies required to electrify and decarbonize for a zero-carbon future.
  
Representing virtually every major scientific and engineering discipline, our researchers are collaborating with GE Vernova’s businesses, the U.S. government, and more than 420 entities at the forefront of technology to execute on 150+ energy focused projects. Collectively, these research programs and initiatives aim to solve near term technical challenges, deliver next generation product advances, and drive long term breakthrough innovation to enable more affordable, reliable, sustainable, and secure energy.

**Job Description**
===================

* Collaborate with domain experts to understand business needs and translate them into clear and effective LLM prompts.
* Develop, test, and refine prompts for a variety of use cases, ensuring high accuracy and relevance in generated outputs.
* Work closely with software developers to integrate LLM solutions into existing or new applications.
* Contribute to the development of a scalable framework for prompt engineering, promoting reuse and knowledge sharing across different business units.
* Assist in gathering and analyzing user feedback to continually improve prompt effectiveness.
* Stay up-to-date with advancements in LLM technology and contribute to strategic decisions on tool and platform selection.
Document prompt engineering processes, best practices, and use case outcomes to build a comprehensive knowledge base.  

**Qualifications/Requirements:**

* **Master’s degree** in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science,, AI Engineering, Mathematics, or related field with **15+ years' relevant experience.**
* Experience with prompt engineering and familiarity with tools such as OpenAI’s GPT models, Hugging Face, etc.
* Proficiency in Python or other programming languages commonly used in AI/ML development.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and adapt to changing project requirements.
Candidate must be willing to travel a minimum of 2 weeks per year  

**Ideal Candidate Characteristics:**

* PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI Engineering, or related field
* Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch) and data processing libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy).
* Previous experience or internships involving NLP or machine learning projects.
* Familiarity with version control systems like Git.
* Understanding of traditional industry operations and challenges.

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: Applied AI Solutions Engineer – PHB Commercial Transformation
description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**




At Novonesis, we believe biology holds the key to solving some of the world's biggest challenges. To unlock that potential, we are scaling AI capabilities that help our sales, marketing, and technical service teams work smarter, serve customers better, and create measurable business impact.

As an **Applied AI Solutions Engineer** , you will join the Strategy Deployment team within the Planetary Health Biosolutions (PHB) business division. Working at the intersection of applied AI, commercial problem-solving, and business transformation, you will help turn high-value opportunities into practical AI solutions that transform how commercial teams operate.

This is a forward-deployed engineering opportunity for someone who wants to combine strong technical expertise with visible business impact. You will move between commercial workflows, solution design, and hands-on development, owning the journey from identifying a business challenge to delivering solutions that users genuinely adopt and value.

**The Role & Your Impact**

In this role, you will design, build, deploy, and continuously improve AI solutions that enable PHB commercial teams to work more effectively and create measurable business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Solution Development**

* Work directly with PHB commercial teams to understand workflows, user needs, and business challenges, translating them into practical AI solutions.
* Design and build AI agents, applications, and workflows utilizing prompting, grounding, retrieval, tool usage, actions, and orchestration.
* Develop thin-slice solutions to rapidly validate user value and technical feasibility.
* Build iteratively with users, leveraging feedback and evidence to improve, redesign, or discontinue solutions where appropriate.

**Integration & Engineering**

* Securely connect AI solutions to enterprise platforms and data sources, including Salesforce, Microsoft 365, and approved AI services.
* Build integrations using APIs, connectors, and workflow technologies with appropriate identity, security, and approval controls.
* Work with structured and unstructured data, enterprise knowledge sources, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns.
* Design and develop solutions with security, privacy, responsible AI, maintainability, and reuse in mind.

**Evaluation, Deployment & Scale**

* Design and execute functional, integration, regression, and AI-specific evaluations covering groundedness, retrieval quality, agent behavior, reliability, and user experience.
* Test solutions with end users and make data-driven decisions on whether to scale, iterate, or stop initiatives.
* Deploy, monitor, support, and continuously improve production solutions in partnership with Central IT, ComEx, and other enterprise stakeholders.
* Document solutions, technical patterns, and key learnings to support ongoing maintenance, reuse, and scale across the organization.

**What You'll Need to Be Successful**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2–6 years of relevant professional experience building and deploying AI, GenAI, or agent-based solutions in production environments.
* Hands-on experience with LLMs, AI agents, prompting, grounding, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool use, and orchestration frameworks.
* Strong programming skills in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Experience working with APIs, data integration, Git/version control, testing practices, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience building workflows and integrations using technologies such as Microsoft Power Platform, Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, Salesforce Flow, REST APIs, or similar tools.
* Experience taking AI solutions from prototype through deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
* Good understanding of cloud platforms, identity and access management, secure enterprise data handling, responsible AI, and production reliability.
* Ability to work directly with business users and technical teams to translate business challenges into practical technology solutions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Salesforce Agentforce, UiPath, or comparable technologies.
* Experience supporting sales, marketing, customer engagement, or commercial business functions.
* Curiosity and adaptability to work across different AI models, platforms, and frameworks while selecting the best technology for the business problem.
* Experience working in fast-paced environments with evolving priorities and emerging technologies.

What We Offer

At Novonesis, you will help shape how AI transforms commercial operations across a global, purpose-driven organization. You will work alongside experienced colleagues, gain exposure to cutting-edge AI technologies, and contribute to solutions that create tangible value for customers and the business.

We offer an environment that encourages innovation, learning, ownership, and professional growth while supporting our purpose of unlocking the power of biology to address global challenges.

**Application Deadline:** November 23rd November 2026 - *We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.*

**Our purpose guides the way**

In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.

**Opportunities for everyone**

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.

**Explore other openings**

If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

title: Associate Director, Data & Agentic AI Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

GSK R&D and Digital & Tech's collective goal is to deliver GSK impact, including the acceleration of the discovery and development of medicines and vaccines to patients. The Labs and CMC Tech function is central to this mission, driving the reimagining and business transformation of our global laboratory and CMC processes. We are actively transitioning from managing raw scientific data to generating structural scientific knowledge—the foundation for how R&D will discover future medicines in a technology-enabled ecosystem.

The Labs CMC Data, Agentic and Knowledge Engineering (DAKE) group architects the data, agentic and knowledge foundations upon which critical R&D processes and scientific workflows depend. Crucially, our operating model relies on a hybrid workforce: AI agents function as "digital workers" to execute hands-on engineering tasks. They generate pipelines, test and deploy them, monitor them in production and remediate failures.

Reporting into the Director of Data and Agentic AI Engineering (G5), the Associate Director, Data & Agentic AI Engineering, leads the design of production data systems for a team and its domains within Labs & CMC. The role defines the architectural, quality, and governance standards the team and its digital workers apply, leads the team's AI-grade data infrastructure, and mentors junior and mid-level engineers.

**Why This Role Exists**

* **Production System Leadership:** Leads the design of production data systems for a Labs & CMC team and its domains, including pipelines that serve multiple downstream consumers and the AI-grade infrastructure beneath them incorporating existing standards and approaches.
* **Defining the Hybrid Workflow:** Defines how the team works with digital workers through the architectural standards, quality checks and review patterns their work must meet within our operating model.
* **Capability Mentorship:** Improves and implements our Raises the engineering standards bar with respect to for the team by setting the code, documentation and governance standards others use as the baseline, and advances by mentoring of junior and mid-level engineers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Domain-Level Data and Agentic Engineering**

* Design and build production data pipelines for your specific Labs and CMC domain, serving multiple downstream scientific consumers.
* Implement, and enforce and extend our your team's patterns for agent-generated work, defining exactly what digital workers build and remediate autonomously versus what requires human review within your domain.
* Integrate digital workers into your team's specific orchestration and observability workflows, applying clear guardrails, tool designs, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Lead the response to significant data quality incidents within your team's purview, from initial detection through to permanent resolution.

**Context & Semantics Layer**

* Set the context standards for the team's Labs & CMC domains: how definitions, contracts, classification and lineage are captured in the governed context layer, so humans and digital workers can rely on them.
* Actively contribute to the broader Labs and CMC context layer by feeding your team's hands-on operational experience upward to evolve the platform.

**Data Quality & Governance**

* Execute data quality and governance standards for your team's domains, encoding them directly into the context layer so both humans and digital workers apply them by default.
* Lead local data quality initiatives to achieve measurable outcomes, such as reduced error rates, improved audit readiness, and better downstream AI performance.

**AI Data Infrastructure & Lifecycle**

title: Senior Applied AI Solutions Engineer – PHB Commercial Transformation
description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**




At Novonesis, we believe biology holds the key to solving some of the world's biggest challenges. To unlock that potential, we are scaling AI capabilities that help our sales, marketing, and technical service teams work smarter, serve customers better, and create measurable business impact.

As a **Senior Applied AI Solutions Engineer** , you will join the Strategy Deployment team within the Planetary Health Biosolutions (PHB) business division. Working at the intersection of applied AI, commercial problem-solving, and business transformation, you will turn high-value opportunities into practical AI solutions that transform how commercial teams operate.

This is a senior, forward-deployed engineering role for someone who combines deep technical expertise with the ability to navigate complexity and ambiguity. You will take ownership of strategic AI initiatives, shaping their vision, architecture, development, deployment, and adoption while delivering measurable business value.

**The Role & Your Impact**

In this role, you will design, build, deploy, and continuously improve AI-driven solutions that enhance commercial effectiveness across PHB. You will work directly with business stakeholders, technical teams, and enterprise partners to solve meaningful problems and accelerate the adoption of AI across commercial functions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Solution Development & Commercial Transformation**

* Partner with PHB commercial teams to understand complex workflows, business challenges, and user needs.
* Translate opportunities into practical AI solutions that create measurable business value.
* Design and build AI agents, applications, and workflows leveraging prompting, grounding, retrieval, tool use, actions, and orchestration.
* Develop and validate thin-slice solutions to assess user value and technical feasibility.
* Iterate rapidly based on user feedback and business outcomes.
* Lead multiple AI initiatives simultaneously, owning technical direction and delivery outcomes.
* You will work alongside other Applied AI engineers who also run projects independently. Your distinction will be the ability to take on the assignments with the greatest ambiguity, integration complexity, enterprise risk or cross-functional scope, while helping establish reusable technical patterns and a consistently high engineering and evaluation bar across the team.

**Integration & Engineering**

* Define solution architectures for complex enterprise use cases and evaluate trade-offs across custom applications, Microsoft platforms, Salesforce capabilities, enterprise services, and third-party providers.
* Integrate AI solutions securely with enterprise platforms including Microsoft 365, Salesforce, and approved AI services.
* Build integrations using APIs, connectors, and workflow technologies while implementing appropriate identity, authorization, and approval controls.
* Develop solutions utilizing both structured and unstructured data, enterprise knowledge repositories, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns.
* Ensure solutions are secure, scalable, maintainable, reusable, and aligned with responsible AI principles.

**Evaluation, Deployment & Scaling**

* Establish evaluation methodologies, quality standards, and release criteria for AI solutions.
* Design and execute functional, integration, regression, and AI-specific evaluations covering reliability, groundedness, retrieval quality, agent behavior, and user experience.
* Validate solutions with users and determine whether to scale, iterate, or discontinue initiatives based on evidence.
* Deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve production solutions.
* Document architectures, patterns, and learnings to support future reuse and scale across the organization.

**What You'll Need to Be Successful**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4–8 years of relevant professional experience building and deploying AI, GenAI, or agent-based solutions in real-world environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, prompting, grounding, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool use, and orchestration techniques.
* Strong programming skills in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Experience with APIs, data integration, version control (Git), testing, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience building enterprise workflows and integrations using technologies such as Microsoft Power Platform, Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, Salesforce Flow, REST APIs, or comparable solutions.
* Experience taking AI solutions from prototype to production, including testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Understanding of cloud platforms, identity and access management, secure data handling, responsible AI, and operational reliability.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Salesforce Agentforce, UiPath, or similar enterprise AI platforms.
* Experience working with commercial, sales, marketing, or customer-facing business functions.
* Demonstrated ability to select appropriate technologies based on business outcomes rather than platform preference.
* Experience operating effectively in highly ambiguous and fast-changing environments.

What We Offer

At Novonesis, you will help shape how AI transforms commercial operations across a global, purpose-driven organization. You will work alongside experienced colleagues, gain exposure to cutting-edge AI technologies, and contribute to solutions that create tangible value for customers and the business.

We offer an environment that encourages innovation, learning, ownership, and professional growth while supporting our purpose of unlocking the power of biology to address global challenges.

**Application Deadline:** November 23rd November 2026 *We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible."*

**Our purpose guides the way**

In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.

**Opportunities for everyone**

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.

**Explore other openings**

If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

title: Principal Engineer, Data & Agentic AI Engineering
description:
**About the Role**

GSK R&D and Digital & Tech's collective goal is to deliver GSK impact, including the acceleration of the discovery and development of medicines and vaccines to patients. The Labs and CMC Tech function is central to this mission, driving the reimagining and business transformation of our global laboratory and CMC processes. We are actively transitioning from managing raw scientific data to generating structural scientific knowledge—the foundation for how R&D will discover future medicines in a technology-enabled ecosystem.

The Labs CMC Data, Agentic and Knowledge Engineering (DAKE) group architects the data, agentic and knowledge foundations upon which critical R&D processes and scientific workflows depend. Crucially, our operating model relies on a hybrid workforce: AI agents function as "digital workers" to execute hands-on engineering tasks. They generate pipelines, test and deploy them, monitor them in production and remediate failures.

Reporting into the Senior Data and Agentic Engineer, the Principal Engineer, Data & Agentic AI Engineering, independently owns a specific Labs & CMC data domain. The role designs pipelines for complex scientific use cases, owns the quality of what digital workers deliver in that domain, and keeps its context accurate and audit-ready. It also contributes reusable components to the platform and works collaboratively to raise technical quality across the team.

**Why This Role Exists**

  

* Owns a Labs & CMC data domain end-to-end, with clear accountability for the pipelines, models and datasets digital workers build and operate in it, and sound independent judgement on design choices.

* Delivers quality-assured scientific data to AI systems through data contracts, governed context and quality frameworks that hold up to the strict auditability mandates of life sciences.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Domain Level Data and Agentic Engineering**

* Design pipelines for complex Labs & CMC use cases and direct digital workers to build and operate them, with clear, defensible architectural trade-offs.
* Own the quality of agent-generated work in your scientific domain: review, test and approve it within the remit our operating model sets, and escalate what falls outside it to senior engineering leadership.
* Improve how digital workers operate in your domain by refining the frameworks, tools and evaluations they use, iterating on reliability signals so manual intervention falls measurably over time.

**Context & Semantics**

* Own the context for your Labs & CMC domain in the governed context layer: definitions, contracts, lineage and governance documentation that humans and digital workers rely on.
* Contribute reusable components to the broader Labs and CMC context layer, such as metadata enrichment, classification or lineage capture, that other scientific domains can adopt.

**Data Quality & Governance**

* Build an end-to-end data quality framework for your domain, encoding standards directly into the context layer with lineage tracking and governance documentation that passes audit.
* Apply privacy, IP, and consent controls in AI data pipelines, and manage sensitive R&D data appropriately across the data lifecycle.

**AI Data Infrastructure & Lifecycle**

* Build cloud data infrastructure independently using infrastructure as code and contribute reusable components to the team's shared data platform to reduce setup time for new Labs and CMC projects.

* Raise team technical quality through code review and documentation, working closely with senior engineers and domain scientists to translate ambiguous requirements into well-scoped designs.

* 6+ years of experience building and operating production data pipelines and data models.

* Experience designing and operating at least one AI agent or LLM-powered tool inside a data workflow, and fluent, daily use of AI coding assistants and agents with sound judgement on what to accept, change or reject.
* Experience designing and building feature stores, vector databases or retrieval infrastructure for production AI systems, including data contracts for at least one AI consumer.
* Experience managing training datasets, evaluation sets and data versioning for at least one AI project in production.
* A track record of building data quality frameworks and lineage for a domain, and of applying privacy, consent and compliance controls in AI data pipelines.
* Experience building cloud data infrastructure independently with infrastructure as code, with observability designed in from the start.

**Preferred Experience**

  

* Led the design and delivery of a component of a larger data platform.
* Experience with agentic systems in production: multi-step tool use, evaluations, guardrails and observability applied to operational data problems.

* Experience with quality frameworks and with catalogue, metadata or lineage tooling.
* Experience in regulated or high-stakes data environments, such as life sciences, labs, CMC, or healthcare, where strict data integrity is a mandate

**Education**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Computer Programming, Data Analysis, Data Governance, Data Ingestion, Data Integration, ETL Development, Performance Tuning, Structured Query Language (SQL)

title: Manager, Engineering
description:
### **About the Role**

Navan's GOS engineering team builds the shared platform and capabilities that help teams across Navan develop, evaluate, deploy, and operate AI-powered products safely and at scale. The team focuses on reusable AI services that reduce repetitive manual workflows, along with model and provider integrations, evaluation and observability, guardrails, and a strong developer experience.

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of 5-10 full-stack engineers. You will translate business and product needs into a clear technical strategy, balance near-term delivery with long-term platform investments, and create an environment where engineers can do their best work.

### **What You Will Do**

* **Lead and Develop the Team:** Manage, coach, and grow a team of 5-10 engineers. Set clear expectations, hold regular one-on-ones, provide actionable feedback, and support career development.
* **Set Technical Direction:** Guide architecture and engineering trade-offs for shared AI services and platform capabilities, with a focus on scalability, security, reliability, and ease of adoption.
* **Drive Delivery:** Turn strategy into realistic roadmaps, milestones, and ownership. Manage dependencies and risks while helping the team deliver measurable product and platform outcomes.
* **Gather and Clarify Requirements:** Work closely with Operations, SRE, Security, Data Science, Legal, and engineering teams across Travel and Expense to understand problems, resolve ambiguity, and define clear requirements.
* **Raise the Quality Bar:** Establish practices for AI evaluation, observability, privacy, safety, cost management, and operational readiness. Use data and production feedback to improve the platform.
* **Build Strong Partnerships:** Communicate decisions and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Coordinate cross-team initiatives and create alignment around shared priorities.
* **Scale the Organization:** Identify staffing needs, lead hiring and onboarding, and improve engineering processes as the team and its responsibilities grow.

### **What We Are Looking For**

* **Experience:** 7+ years of software engineering experience building scalable systems, including at least 2 years of direct engineering management experience.
* **Technical Depth:** Strong knowledge of distributed systems, APIs, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure. Experience with AI or machine learning platforms, large language model applications, or developer platforms is valuable.
* **Engineering Judgment:** Ability to evaluate architecture, make practical trade-offs, and guide teams through complex technical and operational decisions.
* **Leadership and Execution:** A record of building healthy teams, managing delivery across competing priorities, and holding a high bar for quality and ownership.
* **Communication:** Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical concepts, decisions, and risks to different audiences.
* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

### **Good to Have**

* Knowledge of the travel domain, including corporate travel, booking, servicing, or expense workflows.
* Strong product knowledge and a product-minded approach to connecting platform investments with customer and business needs.
* Experience working with varied stakeholders to gather requirements, reconcile competing needs, and turn ambiguous problems into an executable plan.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a record of simplifying complex technical or business challenges.
* Hands-on exposure to large language models, model providers, retrieval systems, evaluations, observability, or AI governance.
* Experience building shared capabilities that are adopted by multiple product and engineering teams.

title: SAP RISE SAP Basis Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As an SAP Basis Operations RISE Support Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the availability, stability, and performance of SAP environments. You will provide L1/L2 SAP Basis support, monitor business-critical SAP systems, manage incidents and alerts, and support outage recovery in a 24x7 production environment. You will work closely with SAP RISE operations, hyperscaler teams, and customer stakeholders to ensure SLA-driven service delivery.

  

**What will you do**

  

* Monitor SAP systems, applications, databases, interfaces, dashboards, and operational queues, proactively identifying potential service risks.
* Handle L1/L2 SAP Basis incidents, performing initial diagnosis, troubleshooting, resolution, escalation, and documentation according to SLA commitments.
* Participate in major incident and outage bridges, supporting impact analysis, service restoration, root cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and corrective actions.
* Perform SAP Basis operational activities including system monitoring, startup/shutdown, background jobs, spool administration, user locks, transports, and system maintenance. Monitor SAP HANA database health and performance and support system refreshes, client copies, kernel updates, and parameter reviews.
* Support approved changes and releases, including system readiness validation and transport movement across SAP landscapes.
* Coordinate with SAP RISE, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, customer, and technical support teams during incidents and service disruptions.
Work within ITIL-based Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes, maintaining accurate tickets, operational documentation, SLA/OLA compliance, and service reports.  

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

The career path ahead is full of exciting opportunities to grow and advance within the job family. * Collaborate with multi-functional teams to define operational requirements and support strategic infrastructure initiatives.
* Mentor junior administrators and engineers while promoting operational excellence across the organization.
* Additional responsibilities as assigned.

  
**Qualifications**  
**Who You Are:**  
**What you'll bring with you:**

* Deep expertise supporting WAN and routing topologies, datacenter switching architectures, firewall technologies, and traffic management platforms.
* Demonstrable experience supporting secure hybrid multi-cloud environments including AWS, GCP, and Azure networking services.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across network, operating system, and application layers.

* Expertise supporting traditional and next-generation firewall technologies using Cisco and Palo Alto Networks solutions.

* Solid understanding of security frameworks and regulations including ISO 27001, NIST, and PCI DSS.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and drive operational issues through resolution with minimal supervision.

* Familiarity with observability platforms, dashboard creation, capacity planning, and actionable alerting strategies.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and lead technical discussions across multi-functional teams.

title: Associate Director, Global Medical Affairs – Digital & Tech
description:
**About the Role**

Do you bring the engineering judgement to turn complex Medical Affairs opportunities into working digital, data, analytics, and AI solutions? Can you embed directly with business teams, move rapidly from problem framing to proof of concept, and then engineer successful solutions for secure, compliant production use at scale?

As Senior Principal Engineer for Global Medical Affairs Digital & Tech, you will work side by side with Medical Affairs leaders, product teams, data scientists, engineers, and end users to build solutions that improve Measurement, Analytics and Insights. Unlike a role focused only on PoCs and MVPs, this position owns the path from discovery and rapid validation through production deployment, adoption, scaling, and continuous improvement.

You will focus on high-value opportunities across Data Generation, Scientific Communications, Medical Information, and MSL Engagement. The outcome is not slideware or isolated pilots. It is working, trusted software and analytics that are used in real workflows and deliver measurable Medical Affairs value.

**Why This Role Exists**

* Global Medical Affairs needs engineers who can close the gap between business questions, scientific workflows, fragmented data, and scalable technology. This role combines deep customer embedding, rapid engineering, production accountability, and reusable platform thinking so that promising ideas become durable capabilities.
* Proves value quickly — frames priority problems and delivers PoCs, PoVs, and MVPs at pace using real data and workflows.
* Takes solutions to production — engineers validated concepts for secure, reliable, compliant, and supportable use.
* Scales what works — expands successful products across therapy areas, regions, teams, and use cases while creating reusable patterns.
* Improves decisions and impact — builds Measurement, Analytics and Insights solutions that help Medical Affairs understand performance, identify opportunities, and act.
* Oversee Strategic partners – work directly with GSK Tech strategic partners and their engineering teams to ensure solutions are designed, engineering and can be supported in production
* environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Embedded Discovery, Prototyping and Value Validation**

* Embed with Medical Affairs teams to understand scientific and operational workflows, decision points, user needs, data constraints, and measures of value.
* Own high-priority use cases from problem framing through PoC, PoV, and MVP, using short delivery cycles and direct user feedback.
* Prototype against representative data and real workflows, testing desirability, feasibility, usability, data quality, and business value before material investment.
* Form and defend evidence-based continue, pivot, or stop recommendations with clear implications for investment and scale.

**Production Engineering and Scale**

* Own the transition from validated MVP to production, including architecture, engineering, integration, testing, security, controls, deployment, observability, documentation, and support readiness.
* Build reliable, maintainable solutions that meet GSK Digital and Tech requirements for privacy, quality, compliance, performance, resilience, and user experience.
* Scale successful solutions across therapy areas, regions, and Medical Affairs functions by designing configurable components, reusable services, data products, and reference architectures.
* Establish product measures and production telemetry to track adoption, service performance, decision impact, realised value, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Address technical debt and production issues pragmatically, balancing speed with long-term sustainability and total cost of ownership.

**Measurement, Analytics and Insights Solutions**

* **Data Generation:** build data and analytics products that improve visibility across evidence planning, study execution, evidence generation, data quality, analysis, and reporting.
* **Scientific Communications:** develop measurement and insight capabilities across medical writing, publications, congress activity, content development, scientific dissemination, reach, engagement, and impact.
* **Medical Information:** create analytics and AI-enabled solutions that identify inquiry trends, knowledge gaps, response performance, content needs, and emerging scientific questions while supporting accurate and compliant operations.
* **MSL Engagement:** build solutions that strengthen planning and measurement of scientific exchange, stakeholder engagement, field insights, content use, follow-up, and the translation of field observations into actionable Medical Affairs insights.
* Cross-functional impact measurement: connect data across these domains to create trusted metrics, dashboards, analytical products, and decision-support experiences that demonstrate Medical Affairs value and identify where action is needed.

**AI-Native Engineering**

* Use AI coding assistants and agent-based workflows for planning, coding, testing, review, documentation, and operational support, applying human judgement and validation throughout.
* Apply GenAI, machine learning, natural language processing, knowledge retrieval, and advanced analytics where they are appropriate to the problem and evidence supports their use.
* Design human-in-the-loop controls, evaluation approaches, and monitoring so AI-enabled capabilities remain accurate, explainable, responsible, and fit for Medical Affairs use.

**Partnership, Governance and Reuse**

* Partner with Medical Affairs Digital & Tech Product Directors, Enterprise Data and AI, architecture, Cyber Security, Quality, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, and shared engineering services.
* Embed security, privacy, quality, records, Responsible AI, and regulatory requirements from discovery through production rather than treating governance as a late-stage gate.
* Distil each engagement into reusable code, data models, agents, prompts, evaluation assets, APIs, patterns, and reference architectures.
* Coach product teams and Medical Affairs Digital and Tech colleagues in AI-augmented delivery, analytical thinking, experimentation, and product adoption.

**What You Bring**

**Required Experience:**

* At least 10 years of full-stack, data, analytics, or software engineering experience, including ownership of production deployments and scaled enterprise solutions.
* Strong proficiency in modern software languages, plus experience with at least one modern application development language or framework such as TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Phyton, or similar.
* Experience with data engineering, analytics products, APIs, cloud platforms, modern software engineering, testing, DevSecOps, observability, and production support.
* Experience applying GenAI patterns such as agents, multi-agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering, evaluation, and responsible human oversight.
* Experience in working with senior business stakeholders and end users, translate needs into technical choices, and communicate trade-offs clearly.
* Experience delivering technology in a regulated or high-control environment with strong expectations for security, privacy, quality, and compliance.

**Preferred Experience.**

* A master's degree in a related field is advantageous.
* Experience building measurement frameworks, data products, dashboards, analytical applications, decision-support tools, or insight-generation capabilities.
* Familiarity with Medical Affairs processes across data generation, scientific communications and publications, medical information, field medical or MSL engagement, and impact measurement.
* Prior experience in a senior principal engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, product engineering, or startup environment.
* Track record of scaling a successful solution across multiple markets, business units, or user groups while improving reuse and reducing delivery time.

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**Skills Profile**

**Capability**

**G6 expectation**

**Delivery**

Embeds with users, frames ambiguous problems, prototypes quickly, and iterates using evidence and direct feedback.

**Technical Ownership**

Engineers validated concepts into secure, compliant, observable, supportable products and remains accountable through adoption and stabilisation.

**Scale and Reuse**

Designs configurable, reusable components and patterns that allow successful solutions to expand across functions, therapy areas, and regions.

**Measurement and Analytics**

Translates Medical Affairs objectives into trusted measures, analytical products, insights, and decision-support experiences.

**Technical Judgement**

Makes sound architecture, data, AI, and engineering decisions with incomplete information while balancing value, risk, speed, and sustainability.

**Customer Partnership**

Builds trusted relationships with Medical Affairs leaders, product owners, scientists, analysts, engineers, and operational teams.

**Responsible Innovation**

Integrates security, privacy, quality, compliance, and Responsible AI into delivery from the start.

**Capability Building**

Leaves teams stronger by coaching colleagues and contributing reusable assets, standards, and ways of working.

**What Success Looks Like**

In the first 12 months, the person in this role will have:

* Owned multiple high-priority Medical Affairs engagements from problem framing through prototype, production deployment, adoption, and measurable value realisation.
* Put at least one new Measurement, Analytics and Insights solution into production and established a credible path to scale across additional teams, therapy areas, or regions.
* Improved decision-making or operational performance in one or more priority domains: Data Generation, Scientific Communications, Medical Information, or MSL Engagement.
* Established clear product metrics and production monitoring covering adoption, data quality, service performance, user experience, and realised business value.
* Contributed reusable engineering, data, analytics, or AI assets that materially accelerate subsequent Medical Affairs solutions.
* Built strong trust with Medical Affairs and Tech stakeholders as an embedded technical partner who delivers working outcomes, not only recommendations.

**About Global Medical Affairs and Medical Digital & Tech**

Global Medical Affairs generates and communicates scientific evidence to support informed decision-making, demonstrate product value, and enable high-quality scientific exchange with healthcare professionals. Its work spans evidence and data generation, scientific communications and publications, medical information, field medical and MSL engagement, and the measurement of Medical Affairs impact.

Global Medical Affairs Digital & Tech enables this mission through secure, compliant, user-centred digital, data, analytics, and AI capabilities across therapy areas, regions, and central functions. The team partners with Medical Affairs to modernise workflows, connect data, generate actionable insights, improve stakeholder experiences, and scale solutions that deliver measurable scientific and business value.

title: Senior Staff AI Scientist
description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

The ideal candidate is a PhD-trained AI scientist with 5–8+ years of post-PhD experience driving cutting-edge medical imaging and Physical AI research from conception to real-world clinical deployment. This individual operates as a technical authority and research leader, shaping AI strategy across imaging, embodied and physics-aware AI, foundation models, and multimodal healthcare systems, while mentoring senior scientists and influencing product and clinical roadmaps.  
They bring deep expertise in learning from real-world data and physical signals, including sensor fusion, spatiotemporal modeling, simulation-to-real transfer, and constraint-aware or physics-informed machine learning as applied to imaging hardware, acquisition pipelines, and clinical workflows. The role requires a strong ability to bridge algorithmic innovation with physical systems, such as scanners, devices, or procedural environments, ensuring robust performance under real-world variability and operational constraints.  
The candidate possesses a rare combination of deep technical excellence, a strong publication and patent record, and proven experience translating AI research into regulated, commercially deployed healthcare solutions. They have demonstrated success in taking models from research to production, accounting for physical robustness, safety, reliability, and regulatory requirements, and in collaborating closely with clinicians, engineers, and product teams to deliver clinically impactful AI systems.  
They possess a rare combination of deep technical excellence, strong publication and patent record, and proven experience translating AI research into regulated, commercially deployed healthcare solutions.  
  
GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Research & Technical Leadership:**

* Define and own the long-term research vision for **medical image analysis, Physical AI–enabled imaging systems, foundation models, and multimodal healthcare AI** across clinical domains.
* Architect and lead the development of state-of-the-art **detection, segmentation, classification, reconstruction, and quantitative imaging systems**, incorporating **physics-aware modeling, spatiotemporal reasoning, and sensor-informed learning**, deployed in real clinical workflows.
* Drive innovation across:
  + Vision and multimodal transformers
  + Large-scale foundation models
  + Self-supervised, weakly supervised, and semi-supervised learning
  + Physics-informed ML, constraint-aware learning, simulation-to-real transfer, and embodied perception paradigms relevant to medical imaging and procedural environments.
* Establish technical standards for **experimental rigor, physical robustness, uncertainty quantification, clinical validation, fairness, and generalization** across imaging devices, sites, and populations.

**Clinical Translation & Real-World Impact:**

* Partner deeply with clinicians, radiologists, pathologists, imaging scientists, and regulatory stakeholders to formulate **AI problem statements grounded in clinical workflows and physical realities of imaging systems**.
* Lead dataset and system design strategies including:
  + Multi-site and multi-device data curation
  + Annotation frameworks aligned with clinical and procedural context
  + Bias mitigation, domain shift analysis, and hardware- and protocol-aware generalization assessment.
* Guide AI solutions through clinical validation, regulatory pathways, and real-world deployment, ensuring **safety, robustness to physical variability, and compliance with regulated healthcare environments**.

**Organizational & Cross-Functional Leadership:**

* Act as a **technical mentor and design reviewer** for senior scientists, postdocs, and junior researchers across AI, imaging, and Physical AI domains.
* Influence product direction, portfolio prioritization, and platform strategy in collaboration with **engineering, imaging hardware teams, MLOps, product, and clinical partners**.
* Serve as a go-to expert for **medical imaging AI and Physical AI systems**, advising on architecture decisions, risk trade-offs, and long-term strategy.
* Represent the organization externally through **publications, patents, invited talks, and collaborations** with academia, healthcare systems, and industry partners.

**Research Excellence & Thought Leadership:**

* Consistently publish in top-tier venues (e.g., MICCAI, CVPR, NeurIPS, TMI, MedIA, Radiology AI, Nature family journals), including work that bridges **learning-based AI with physical modeling and real-world systems**.
* Drive IP creation through high-value patents covering **algorithmic innovation, system-level design, and physics-aware or multimodal AI methods**.
* Stay ahead of emerging trends in **Physical AI, foundation models, multimodal and embodied AI, federated learning, regulatory science, and AI safety in healthcare**.

**Technical Expertise (Senior-Level Expectations):**

* Deep mastery of deep learning frameworks (PyTorch preferred) and large-scale **training, fine-tuning, optimization, and deployment**.
* Advanced expertise in medical image analysis across **2D/3D/4D imaging and multimodal MRI/CT/PET/X-ray/Ultrasound**, using MONAI, SimpleITK, OpenCV, and related tools.
* Proven experience with:
  + Vision and multimodal foundation models
  + Self-, weakly-, and semi-supervised learning at scale
  + Domain adaptation and generalization across institutions and devices
  + **Physics-informed ML, simulation-based learning, spatiotemporal modeling, sensor fusion, and uncertainty-aware inference**
* Strong understanding of **MLOps, experiment tracking, reproducibility, scalable research platforms**, and model lifecycle management.
* Solid grasp of **data governance, model risk management, privacy-preserving ML, regulatory expectations (FDA, CE, SaMD), and real-world safety considerations** for AI operating on physical systems.

**Educational Qualifications:**

* PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Applied Physics, Robotics, or a closely related field.
* 5–8+ years of post-PhD experience in **medical imaging AI, healthcare AI, Physical AI, or applied AI research**.

**Required Skills:**

* Has led **large, system-level research initiatives** rather than isolated models, often spanning algorithms, data, and physical constraints.
* Strong publication and/or patent track record in top AI, imaging, or systems-oriented venues.
* Demonstrated history of **end-to-end ownership**: research ideation system design validation regulated, real-world deployment.
* Experience operating in matrixed, cross-functional, and clinically driven environments involving **both software and physical systems**.
* Comfortable making architecture and strategy decisions **under ambiguity and real-world constraints**.
* Balances scientific rigor with pragmatism, optimizing for **clinical impact, robustness, and deploy ability**.
* Recognized as a **trusted technical advisor** by engineering, clinical, imaging, and product leadership.

title: Network Switch Platform Test Engineer (PoE & Automation)
description:
Network Switch Platform Test Engineer (PoE & Automation)This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

**What You’ll Do:**
-------------------

  

* Validate networking switch platforms through functional, regression, interoperability, and reliability testing.
* Design and execute PoE tests covering IEEE 802.3af/at/bt behavior, power negotiation, classification, allocation, power budgets, multi-port stress, and overload scenarios.
* Test copper and fiber interfaces across product-supported speeds—from multi-rate and 100 Mb/s through 1G, 10G, 25G, 40G, 100G and, where applicable, higher rates up to 800G. Validate link bring-up and recovery, auto-negotiation, FEC, channelization, MTU, VLAN, and LACP.
* Measure throughput, latency, packet loss, and interface error behavior.
* Validate platform and chassis behavior, including hardware bring-up, packet path, LEDs, route-engine behavior, boot/BIOS, and memory subsystems, as applicable.
* Translate market, hardware, and software requirements into test plans and Python automation for new features, typically within a few days.
* Maintain feature test automation and integrate suites into CI/CD pipelines where applicable.
* Analyze failures using logs, packet captures, counters, and platform diagnostics; work with development teams to identify root causes.
* Collaborate across hardware, firmware, and software teams to define coverage for new features and releases.
* Prepare test reports, defect summaries, and release quality metrics.
* Explore practical AI-assisted workflows that improve engineering efficiency and test delivery.

**What You’ll Bring:**
----------------------

**Required qualifications and skills**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience testing networking products, platforms, switches, interfaces, PoE, or closely related networking systems. Relevant platform testing on adjacent networking products, such as routing or security platforms, is also applicable.
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals and how networks operate.
* Hands-on Python test automation, including the ability to translate feature specifications into repeatable tests and adapt scripts as requirements change. This role focuses on feature test automation; deep ownership of a standalone tooling platform is not required.
* Demonstrated technical depth in at least one relevant area, such as PoE, interfaces/optics, or platform/chassis validation. The complementary area can be learned on the job; experience in both is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of Linux, shell scripting, and Git.
* Strong debugging and communication skills in hardware/software integrated environments.
* Willingness to work in a hybrid, lab-dependent environment and attend the office more than two days in a week when business or testing needs require it.

**Good to have**

  

* Experience across both PoE and interface/optics validation, including PoE standards, certification workflows, and power measurement setups.
* Knowledge of Layer 2 and Layer 3 features such as VLAN, STP/RSTP/MSTP, LACP, QoS, IGMP, and routing basics. EVPN/EVPN-VXLAN familiarity is useful.
* Familiarity with pytest or unittest, API/CLI automation, log parsing, and CI/CD integration.
* Experience with traffic generators such as IXIA, Spirent, TRex, or equivalent tools.
* Experience with SNMP, NETCONF/RESTCONF, gNMI, or telemetry validation.
* Experience with campus topologies, interoperability testing, and enterprise endpoints such as IP phones, wireless access points, and other PoE devices.
* Practical use of AI-assisted engineering workflows.

**How Success Is Measured**

  

* High, repeatable automation coverage for PoE, interfaces, and platform regression.
* Reduced manual test-cycle time and stronger release confidence.
* Earlier detection and clear diagnosis of platform and interoperability defects.
* Stable test infrastructure that supports frequent product releases.
