title: Customer Experience & Retention Manager
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

**About the Role**

Harness is growing its Digital and Commercial customer base, and we will not scale it by adding people in proportion. This role owns **customer experience and retention for a large book of Digital and Commercial customers**, and its main job is to **build and run the tech-touch engine that serves them**.

You will design automated journeys, health signals, in-product and email programs, and self-service resources that deliver onboarding, adoption, risk detection, renewal and expansion without a person in every interaction. You will use human time on the moments that matter: a customer stuck on a technical blocker, an at-risk account, a renewal negotiation. You will also feed what you learn back into the automation so those moments become rarer.

**Operating principle:** Automate by default, involve a human by exception. Every manual touch should either solve a high-value problem or teach us what to automate next.

**What You'll Own**

* **Tech-Touch Customer Experience Engine**

* Design, scale and optimize automated lifecycle programs: onboarding, activation, adoption, renewal and win-back. Run them through the CRM, the CS platform, email and in-product channels. Build triggered plays driven by product usage, milestones, health score, support signals and contract events.
* Own the segmentation and coverage model: which customers get automation only, automation plus on-demand human help, or direct engagement.
* Build the self-service layer: guides, templates, pipeline examples, office hours, webinars, community content and a knowledge base. Measure what gets used and fill the gaps.
* Run experiments (A/B tests on messaging, timing and channel) and report on what changes adoption and retention.
* Use AI-assisted workflows for summarisation, content personalisation, ticket and usage insight, and outreach drafting to raise throughput without losing quality.

* **Data-Driven Health, Risk & Prioritisation**

* Own the customer health model: define, validate and tune the signals (usage depth, feature adoption, engagement, support trends, sentiment and commercial indicators).
* Turn the data into automated risk and opportunity alerts, and route them to the right play or person. Build dashboards that show portfolio health, coverage efficiency, adoption funnels and renewal risk. Run recovery plans for at-risk accounts, then capture the pattern as a repeatable, automated play.

* **Technical Enablement & Hands-On Support**

* Guide customers through product configuration, integrations (GitHub, GitLab, cloud platforms, CI/CD tools) and common pipeline issues when automation and self-service are not enough.
* Join technical discovery and proof-of-value work with Solutions Engineering and forward-deployed teams.
* Reproduce common issues, gather logs and configuration details, and escalate cleanly to Support and Engineering.
* Convert every recurring technical question into reusable enablement: a guide, template, in-product prompt or automated play.
* Turn recurring customer challenges into product feedback and prioritised requests.

* **Renewals, Retention & Commercial Ownership**

* Own renewal execution end to end: automated renewal journeys and reminders, risk assessment, commercial discussion and close, with human involvement focused on at-risk and strategic renewals. Identify expansion, cross-sell and right-sizing opportunities from usage signals, and trigger plays and handoffs to Account Executives.
* Coordinate quotes, Order Forms, approvals and procurement with internal stakeholders. Keep renewal forecasts, customer records and risk assessments accurate and current. Work with Account Executives and Revenue Operations to improve gross revenue retention and reduce preventable churn.

* **Continuous Improvement & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Work with Sales, Support, Product, Engineering, Marketing and Revenue Operations to connect data, systems and messaging across the customer journey.
* Find manual, repetitive tasks and remove them through automation, integrations and tooling. Document playbooks and share best practices so the model scales across teams and segments.

**Required Qualifications**

* **3+ years required (5+ years preferred)** in Customer Success, Customer Experience, Technical Account Management, Digital/Scaled CS, Solutions Consulting or a similar SaaS role. Experience managing a high-volume B2B SaaS portfolio, ideally in a digital, SMB, mid-market or commercial segment.
* Hands-on experience building automation in a CRM or CS platform (Salesforce, Gainsight, HubSpot, Totango or similar), including journeys, triggers and health scoring.
* Strong analytical skills: comfortable with usage and engagement data, dashboards, funnels and cohort or segment analysis.
* Working knowledge of DevOps fundamentals: Git, CI/CD pipelines, APIs and cloud platforms. Experience with SaaS renewals, retention and commercial discussions, and an understanding of subscription, licensing and billing models.
* Strong communication, troubleshooting and prioritisation skills in a high-volume environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with digital CS tooling: in-app guidance, email and marketing automation, community platforms and knowledge-base or content systems.
* Experience using SQL, BI tools, scripting or low-code automation to build and improve workflows. Experience applying AI or LLM-assisted workflows to customer communication, support or insight. Hands-on exposure to Harness, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar CI/CD platforms. Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure or GCP; REST APIs, webhooks, SSO and YAML configuration.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, Terraform or DevSecOps concepts.
* Experience working alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, Solutions Architects or implementation teams.

**What Success Looks Like**

**Area**

**Outcomes**

  

**Scale & efficiency**

Higher customers-per-manager coverage with stable or improving satisfaction. A growing share of lifecycle touches and renewals handled through automation. Fewer repeat manual tasks.

  

**Adoption &**

**experience**

Faster onboarding and time to value, higher activation and feature adoption, and measurable use of self-service content.

  

**Retention &**

**commercial**

Improved gross revenue retention, lower preventable churn, accurate renewal forecasts and expansion opportunities identified from signals.

  

**Risk & health**

Earlier risk detection through a validated health model, and more recoveries run from standard plays.

  

**Technical**

Routine technical questions resolved through self-service or by you, and less reliance on Engineering for them.

**Ideal Candidate**

You think in systems, not accounts. You are as comfortable building a triggered journey and reading a usage cohort as you are leading a renewal conversation or debugging a CI/CD workflow with a developer. You do not need to be a software developer, but you are curious about how customers build and ship software, and you ask what a repeated touch tells you about what to automate or fix in the product.

### **Harness in the news:**

* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
* Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
* Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

**Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers**

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

* Build evaluation harnesses to test agent accuracy, hallucination rate, and task completion, using both automated metrics and structured human review.

* Monitor deployed agents in production: track cost (token usage), latency, failure modes, and drift in output quality over time.

* Collaborate with market risk SMEs to translate manual, judgment-heavy processes into structured agent tasks

* Working proficiency in Python, including API integration, async programming, and data manipulation (pandas/numpy).
* Hands-on experience building agentic applications — this can come from personal projects, hackathons, internships, or professional work.

* Understanding of prompt engineering fundamentals: system prompts, chain-of-thought/structured reasoning prompts, few-shot examples, output formatting (JSON schemas, XML tags).
* Familiarity with RAG architectures: embeddings, vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, pgvector), chunking strategies, and retrieval evaluation.
* Basic understanding of LLM evaluation techniques — golden datasets, LLM-as-judge patterns, regression testing for prompt changes.Foundational understanding of market risk concepts — VaR, Greeks, stress testing, limit frameworks — gained through coursework, self-study, or prior exposure.
* FRM Part I/II, CQF, or equivalent certification in progress or completed.Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) server development for tool integration.
* Exposure to model risk management (MRM) or SR 11-7-style validation frameworks.
* Prior experience in a regulated environment (banking, insurance, asset management).
* A background in software engineering, data engineering, or quant development, given the technical build nature of this role.Interns can also be considered with 1 year of exposure in AI.

title: Principal Applied Sciences Manager
description:
**Overview**

**Principal Applied Science Manager - Post-Training and Inference Optimization**

**Overview**

Microsoft Foundry helps developers and organizations build, deploy and operate AI solutions at scale. Join an engineering team building the infrastructure that makes model training and inference faster, more reliable and more efficient for customers.

As a Principal Applied Science Manager, you will lead an applied science team improving model and agent quality through post-training and reducing inference latency and cost. You will set scientific direction, develop scientists and remain hands-on in experiments and code. Partner with training, serving and product teams to turn research into reliable customer capabilities, measured by task success, response time and cost per successful task.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more, and we’re dedicated to this mission across every aspect of our company. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. Join us and help shape the future of the world.

 **Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities**

* Hire, coach and manage applied scientists. Set clear goals, give performance feedback and develop technical leaders who can take research through to production.
* Own the science roadmap across post-training and inference optimization. Translate customer needs into testable hypotheses, prioritize experiments and make investment decisions using measured quality and cost improvements.
* Lead supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization and reinforcement learning (RL). Develop reward models and task-based reward signals that improve reasoning, multi-turn task completion and tool-use correctness.
* Build data and feedback pipelines with engineering teams. Curate demonstrations, preference data, synthetic examples and agent interaction histories, with clear data permissions, versioning and separation between training and evaluation data.
* Establish reproducible evaluations with strong baselines and controlled comparisons. Measure generalization and safety, prevent evaluation-data leakage and detect models exploiting rewards without completing the intended task.
* Lead inference experiments in quantization, distillation and speculative decoding to reduce computation and memory use. Measure time to first token, generation speed, tail latency, throughput and cost under representative load, against explicit model-quality targets.
* Partner with systems engineers on distributed training, agent rollout generation, batching and caching. Reduce training GPU-hours and serving cost while preserving convergence, task quality and reliable recovery.
* Take successful experiments into production through staged releases, monitoring and rollback plans. Work with engineering teams to preserve data privacy, tenant isolation, streaming behavior and token-accounting correctness.

 **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* Master's Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Engineering or a related technical field AND 8+ years of relevant applied science, machine learning or engineering experience; OR Bachelor's Degree in a related technical field AND 10+ years of relevant experience; OR equivalent experience.
* Experience managing applied scientists or machine learning researchers, including hiring, coaching, performance management and delivery through a team.
* Hands-on experience delivering both large language model post-training and inference optimizations, with measured improvements in model quality, latency or cost.
* Strong Python and practical experience with PyTorch, JAX or comparable frameworks. Strong foundations in machine learning, optimization, statistics and experimental design.
* Understanding of distributed training and GPU serving bottlenecks, including compute, memory and communication trade-offs.
* A record of turning research into production capabilities with engineering and product partners, and explaining technical trade-offs clearly.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with agent post-training, reward modeling, preference learning or RL systems that improve held-out task success.
* Experience with training toolchains such as verl or TRL, and serving runtimes such as vLLM, SGLang or TensorRT-LLM.
* Experience co-designing model improvements and serving optimizations across model families or hardware platforms.
* Research, open-source or production contributions that demonstrate reproducible scientific results and practical customer impact.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

description:

The team is actively investing in AI-assisted software delivery and quality engineering. The successful candidate will be encouraged to leverage AI tools to improve test design, automation development, defect analysis, documentation, and overall delivery efficiency, while maintaining appropriate governance and quality controls.

Testing is performed in both manual and automated fashion, but the team focuses on expanding the automated test suites. The projects you will be working on are mainly server-side.

**Technology Ecosystem:**

* API Tools: Swagger, Postman, Devtools
* Back End: C#, SQL Server, WebApi, ReqNRoll/Specflow, Gherkin, Cucumber, FIX
* Architect: Docker Kubernetes, TeamCity, BitBucket, Jira, Confluence, Octopus, Rancher, Influx, KPI Metrics, Nolio

* Document test plans, test cases, and test results to facilitate communication and knowledge sharing within the team.
* Improve QA practices through peer review, reusable test assets, knowledge sharing and measurable reduction of manual regression effort.

  
Qualifications:

**To Land this role you will need:**

* Strong professional experience testing complex trading, financial, transactional or other high-integrity backend systems.
* Hands-on experience of manual functional, integration, regression and end-to-end testing in an Agile delivery environment.
* Confident API and backend-service testing, with the ability to validate requests, responses, events and persisted data.
* Basic SQL skills for data interrogation, reconciliation and test-evidence preparation.
* Experience diagnosing issues through application logs, service behaviour, databases and message flows.
* Practical automation experience using C# or a comparable language to extend the existing test framework.
* Experience with Git-based version control, CI/CD pipelines and test execution within build and deployment tooling.
* Ability to translate requirements and business workflows into clear, risk-based test coverage and traceable evidence.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail and clear written and verbal communication.
* Experience taking testing from requirements analysis through QA sign-off, UAT support and production release.

**What will make you stand out:**

* Electronic order entry, order management or execution management systems.
* FIX protocol, including session behaviour and execution-report-based order lifecycles.

* 4 days in office per week

The Associate Director of AI Science is a highly strategic, business-facing leadership role dedicated to driving commercial value across our Home and Mobility verticals. You will act as the crucial bridge between our technical AI Science teams and the Home and Mobility business units, ensuring that complex AI and data science capabilities are translated into adopted, scalable solutions that deliver measurable ROI and continuous business growth.

**Business Strategy & Commercial Value Creation**

* **Monetize AI Capabilities:** Lead the strategic application of advanced propensity models (e.g., likelihood-to-buy, churn prediction, next-best-action, cross-sell/up-sell) to drive tangible growth and retention in the Home and Mobility sectors.

* **ROI Accountability:** Establish frameworks to measure the commercial impact of deployed AI models. Define, track, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) that demonstrate direct value creation, revenue lift, and cost optimization.
* **Lifecycle Optimization:** Embed AI-driven insights into critical touchpoints along the customer lifecycle, ensuring predictive interventions are timed perfectly with high-impact trigger events.

**Stakeholder Management & AI Adoption**

* **Executive Liaison:** Serve as the primary strategic advisor and translator between the AI Science function and Home/Mobility business leaders (Marketing, Product, Sales, and Customer Experience).
* **Drive Business Adoption:** Champion the operationalization of AI models. Overcome organizational silos and resistance by demonstrating clear business value, securing buy-in, and embedding AI tools directly into end-user workflows.
* **Storytelling with Data:** Translate highly technical machine learning concepts, model performance metrics, and statistical outputs into clear, compelling narratives and strategic recommendations for senior executive leadership.
* **Needs Translation:** Proactively identify business pain points within Home and Mobility and translate these into actionable data science projects, defining clear modeling requirements for the technical teams.

**Technical Oversight & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* **Team Mentorship:** Provide strategic direction and business-context mentorship to data scientists and AI engineers, ensuring their technical execution remains tightly aligned with corporate objectives.

**Experience & Education**

* **Education:** Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related field (an MBA with a strong quantitative focus is highly preferred).
* **Industry Experience:** 8+ years of experience in data science, advanced analytics, or AI strategy, with a minimum of 3 years in a leadership, product management, or business-facing role.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Deep understanding of the telecommunications, broadband, or consumer technology industries, specifically within Home (e.g., fiber, smart home, IoT) and Mobility (e.g., 5G, wireless services) verticals.

**Technical & Business Skills**

* **AI/ML Fluency:** Strong foundational understanding of machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, and LLM architecture. Must be highly conversant in how techniques utilizing frameworks like PyTorch and scikit-learn are applied to business problems, even if not writing production code daily.
* **Advanced Propensity & Segmentation:** Proven track record of designing, evaluating, and strategically deploying end-to-end propensity models and clustering techniques for large-scale customer bases.
* **Data Stack Familiarity:** Experience working with cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS, Azure), production MLOps tools, and large-scale data extraction processes.
* **Exceptional Communication:** Elite presentation skills with the ability to distill complex analytical findings into actionable business strategies for non-technical stakeholders.

40

title: Lead SW Architect
description:
The Lead Software Architect will be responsible for ensuring the design and development of software architecture aligns with business objectives and scalability. You will partner cross-functionally to define system requirements and design solutions that integrate seamlessly into complex engineering systems. You will be responsible for driving innovation through prototyping and evaluating new tools, frameworks, and methodologies to enhance development processes

  

**Job Description**

**Software Lead Architect (B4 / 8C)**

**Position Summary**

The Software Lead Architect owns the cloud architecture and technology roadmap for CLSS products and platforms. The core focus is scalable, secure, resilient cloud-native systems, complemented by AI-enabled development and architecture, including integration of generative AI and agents where they add product and engineering value.

As the technical authority across engineering teams, the architect partners with Product Management, Engineering, System Architecture, and Cyber Security to govern platform design, modernization, and delivery. The role balances reliability, security, performance, cost, and enterprise requirements while enabling responsible adoption of AI capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Own the end-to-end architecture of CLSS products and cloud platforms, including shared services, platform boundaries, integration patterns, deployment models, and AI capabilities where appropriate.
* Set architectural direction across engineering teams through reusable standards, frameworks, and clear domain ownership.
* Govern architecture reviews, decision rights, guardrails, exceptions, and conformance; maintain an auditable record of key decisions, risks, and trade-offs.

**Solution Design**

* Design cloud-native solutions using distributed systems, microservices, API-first and event-driven integration, containers, Kubernetes, and managed or serverless services; define data flows and architecture contracts.
* Design multi-tenant cloud services with tenant isolation, identity and access management, network security, data protection, and regional deployment; extend these controls to AI agents and tool access.
* Define scalability, availability, and performance requirements, including service-level objectives, capacity planning, disaster recovery, backup and restore, and failure testing across cloud services and integrations.
* Optimize cloud consumption through workload sizing, autoscaling, managed-service selection, FinOps, and cost-performance trade-offs, including model and tool usage costs for AI workloads.
* Enable safe platform evolution through API and service versioning, backward compatibility, data migration, and low-downtime deployment, including lifecycle management of integrated models and agents.

**Engineering Excellence**

* Accelerate cloud delivery with reusable reference architectures, platform services, infrastructure as code, and automation; enable AI-assisted development, testing, and documentation with engineering review and quality controls.
* Embed automated security and quality checks, deployment automation, and production observability into DevSecOps and CI/CD; track reliability, performance, cost, and architecture health, with evaluation gates for AI-enabled features.
* Lead production readiness and incident learning for business-critical cloud services; prioritize technical debt, platform modernization, systemic risks, and cross-team dependencies with engineering leaders.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner with Product Management, Engineering, UX, System Architecture, and Cyber Security to translate business needs into cloud solutions and enterprise integrations, identifying suitable opportunities for AI-enabled workflows.
* Communicate architecture strategy, investment options, and trade-offs to senior leadership, linking platform investments to product outcomes, risk, and total cost of ownership; serve as the technical escalation point for cross-cutting decisions.

**Technology Strategy & AI Enablement**

* Define the cloud modernization and AI-enablement roadmap for CLSS; evaluate emerging technologies and prototype generative and Agentic AI use cases, including retrieval, orchestration, and tool integration, before production adoption.
* Establish responsible AI adoption guardrails for agent autonomy, human oversight, permissions, data access, prompt and model security, auditability, and regulatory compliance.

**Mentorship & Talent Development**

Build cloud architecture and AI-enabled engineering capability through mentoring, design coaching, and reusable guidance; lead a distributed architecture community supporting technical leadership development and succession.  



**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.

**Experience & Key Skills**

* 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years in architecture, technical leadership, or solution design roles.
* Proven experience as a principal or lead architect delivering business-critical enterprise cloud platforms, with practical understanding of infrastructure as code, DevSecOps, CI/CD, observability, and disaster recovery.
* Deep expertise in public cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS, distributed systems, microservices, containers and Kubernetes, managed or serverless services, API and event-driven integration, data architecture, security, resilience, and cost optimization.
* AI-enabled development and architecture skills, including AI-assisted engineering and hands-on Agentic AI integration: large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, orchestration, tool use, lifecycle management, evaluation, and responsible AI controls within cloud platforms.
* Ability to align engineers and senior stakeholders without relying solely on direct authority, and clearly communicate architecture trade-offs, investment options, and risk decisions.
* Strong record of managing architecture decisions and technical risk when modernizing live enterprise cloud platforms and introducing new capabilities, including AI where appropriate.

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Engineering Manager - Cloud Platform
description:
**Engineering Manager – Cloud Platform Services**
=================================================

**Location:** India  
**Function:** Engineering  
**Reports To:** Sr. Director of Cloud Platform

**Are you...**
--------------

* Passionate about building, leading, and developing high-performing software engineering teams?
* Driven to stay deeply engaged in technology, guide architectural decisions, and solve complex engineering challenges?
* Excited about building reliable, scalable cloud platform services that power the industry's leading AI-native Product Intelligence Platform?

If so, we'd love to meet you.

**Why Esko?**
=============

Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. More than 25,000 customers across 140+ countries rely on Esko to design, manage, manufacture, and deliver products found on store shelves every day. Packaging for 9 out of 10 major consumer brands is managed using Esko solutions. As we enter our next phase of growth, we're making significant investments in cloud, AI, and platform engineering to build the future of product innovation.

Our vision is to create the industry's leading AI-native Product Intelligence Platform. This modern, multi-tenant cloud platform unifies product, packaging, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain data into a single intelligent ecosystem. By combining cloud-native architecture, intelligent automation, and AI-powered insights, we're helping global consumer goods, life sciences, and manufacturing companies innovate faster, improve compliance, reduce waste, and bring products to market with greater speed and confidence.

**About the Role**
==================

We are looking for a technically strong Engineering Manager to lead a team of software engineers building and evolving shared cloud platform services that power Esko’s SaaS products. This is a people leadership and engineering execution role requiring deep technical judgment, active engagement in engineering decisions, and accountability for scalable, secure, reliable, production-ready services.

You will partner closely with Product Managers and Architects to translate priorities and architectural direction into effective technical plans. You will guide system design, review critical code and implementation choices, coach engineers, and own delivery quality and operational readiness. You should be capable of writing and debugging production-quality code when needed, while empowering engineers to own day-to-day implementation rather than serving as the team’s primary developer.

**What You Will Do**
====================

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of software engineers, fostering technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Own engineering delivery and operational health of shared cloud platform services, ensuring scalability, security, reliability, and maintainability.
* Partner with Product Managers and Architects to translate requirements and architectural direction into technical plans and production-ready capabilities.
* Lead technical design discussions and architecture reviews; critically evaluate trade-offs and guide engineers through cloud-native and distributed systems challenges.
* Own predictable engineering execution through planning, prioritization, dependency management, technical debt management, and continuous improvement.
* Set and reinforce standards for code quality, code reviews, automated testing, performance, observability, security, and release readiness; remain technically engaged in critical implementation decisions.
* Lead response to complex production incidents, including technical diagnosis, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and measurable improvements in service reliability.
* Hire, coach, mentor, and manage performance and career development; empower senior engineers to own detailed designs and implementation while maintaining accountability for engineering outcomes.

**Required Experience**
=======================

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, including meaningful hands-on development experience, with at least 3 years of direct people-management experience leading and developing software engineers.
* Strong technical expertise in Java/JVM, REST APIs, microservices, and cloud-native SaaS applications.
* Experience designing, building, and operating scalable, multi-tenant applications on AWS or another major cloud platform.
* Proven ability to design and evaluate distributed systems, with a deep understanding of scalability, concurrency, consistency, resilience, and fault tolerance.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL and DynamoDB, including data modeling and performance optimization.
* Working knowledge of modern frontend technologies such as React and TypeScript, with the ability to guide software engineering teams.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and modern software delivery practices.
* Demonstrated ability to lead design and code reviews, challenge technical decisions constructively, improve engineering quality, resolve difficult production issues, and deliver complex software initiatives.
* Proven people management capability, including coaching, hiring, performance management, and effective collaboration with Product Managers, Architects, and peer engineering teams.

**Preferred Experience**
========================

* Experience building shared cloud platform services consumed by multiple SaaS products or engineering teams.
* Experience with IAM, authentication, authorization, SSO, OAuth 2.0, or OpenID Connect.
* Experience with entitlement management, usage metering, subscription management, or transaction processing.
* Experience with API Management platforms, API Gateways, API lifecycle management, and securing and exposing APIs to external consumers.
* Experience with Kafka, Redis, Akka, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, or similar distributed technologies.
* Experience modernizing legacy systems and improving engineering productivity and operational maturity.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* Shared cloud platform services are delivered predictably and meet clear expectations for scalability, security, reliability, and maintainability.
* Engineers own implementation and production outcomes, with effective technical guidance, sound design decisions, and disciplined management of technical debt.
* Engineers grow in technical capability, autonomy, ownership, and effectiveness through coaching, feedback, and career development.
* Product Managers, Architects, and engineers collaborate effectively, with clear accountability for architectural direction, detailed design, and delivery.
* Code review, automated testing, observability, incident response, and release practices demonstrate sustained improvement in quality and operational performance.
* The team becomes high-performing and self-sufficient, able to own additional shared platform services without depending on the manager as its primary individual contributor.

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. title: Software Principal Engineer - System Test & Customer Solutions Validation
description:
**Principal Software Engineer – System Test & Customer Solutions Validation (SONiC AI & Enterprise Networking)**

**Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)** builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale.

**Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.**

Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters.

We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it.

If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.

**Join us and help build the future of enterprise technology.**

**What you’ll achieve**

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will be responsible for enabling customer adoption of SONiC-based AI and enterprise networking solutions, from POCs and deployment validation to complex escalations. You will work with customers, support, pre-sales, solution architects, and engineering teams on fabric orchestration, deployment readiness, and resolution of customer issues. As a successful candidate, you will be a technically savvy, customer-focused engineer who bridges customers and engineering, resolves critical issues, and accelerates adoption of reliable, scalable, customer-ready SONiC-based networking and AI fabric solutions.

**You will:**

* Serve as the first line of escalation into engineering for support and pre-sales, troubleshooting customer issues and driving workarounds and planned resolutions.
* Define and drive system-level validation strategies for complex SONiC-based AI and enterprise networking solutions, aligned with spec-driven and test-driven development (SDD/TDD), validating customer use cases, POCs, and end-to-end workflows across network infrastructure, fabric orchestration, servers, storage, and telemetry.
* Investigate complex customer-reported issues across SONiC software, networking protocols, platform components, and orchestration systems, including link-level errors and retransmit behavior, closing field escapes through triage, debugging, and closure.
* Provide technical leadership across customer engineering, system test, product management, and software development organizations.
* Drive architectural reviews, identify solution gaps, and influence product engineering roadmaps based on customer deployment requirements, translating customer feedback and field learnings into engineering improvements using Python, SpyTest automation, and AI agents that improve execution efficiency, impact, and value.

**Take the first step towards your dream career**

Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:

**Essential Requirements**

* Customer and solution experience: working with customers, solution architects, support, and engineering teams on POCs, deployments, and escalations, and system testing complex AI, data center, and enterprise networks, including scale-up, scale-across, scale-out, rack-scale, and fabric-scale environments.
* Networking technologies: VXLAN-EVPN, MLAG, EVPN-MH, ECMP, VRF, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, SRv6, BFD, Layer 2, multicast, RoCE, QoS, DCB (PFC/ECN), lossless Ethernet, link-level retransmission, and enterprise services (DHCP, DNS, NTP, LDAP, RADIUS, TACACS+, 802.1X).
* Integrated solutions: validation of networking, compute, storage, GPU cluster, and fabric orchestration solutions, including Ansible, Kubernetes integrations, and lifecycle workflows.
* Automation and telemetry: strong Python and test automation skills, with telemetry and northbound interfaces (CLI, REST, gNMI, NETCONF/YANG), traffic generator testing (for example IXIA), and packet analysis.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering in CSE, ECE, EEE, IT, Computer Networks, Cloud Computing, or equivalent.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Experience with SONiC and SpyTest, network test automation, deployment validation, and customer-focused solution demonstrations.
* Experience building or using AI agents and AI-assisted workflows (AI models and tools, for example Claude, Devin, GitHub Copilot) for troubleshooting, solution analysis, automation, and customer issue investigation.

**Who we are**

We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you.

Dell Technologies is a unique family of businesses that helps individuals and organizations transform how they work, live and play. Join us to build a future that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us.

title: Principal Engineer - AI ML and Cloud Security
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

**Domain focus: AI Platform & Cloud Security (CSPM, shadow AI and agent risk tiering across Azure and GCP).**

**Job Purpose**:

Support the AI Platform and Cloud Security team, which governs AI tool security posture and provides cloud security advisory across Azure and GCP. Hands-on analytical work: the shadow AI register, CSPM analysis, agent risk-tiering, and the findings and reporting the team governs through.

**About the team**:

AI ML and Cloud Security is the function through which GSK is transforming security itself. The team designs and builds the agentic framework, a multi-agent platform moving security services across the Chief Security Office from rule-based to AI-driven operation. It owns AI architecture and AI engineering end to end: the agent layer, LLM orchestration, the AI and ML platform, and the data fabric pipeline that Cyber Architecture and Solutions designs, builds and tests before a managed service vendor operates it. The team also governs AI tool security posture, advises on cloud security across the Azure and GCP estate, and is the front door between GSK's business units and R&D and the technical AI function. AI security standards set here are binding on every AI initiative in GSK. Seventeen roles across the UK, India and the US.

**What makes this role different. Hands-on analytical work in a team that advises and flags but does not remediate — the Azure and GCP platform teams own every fix you identify, so your influence comes from the quality of the finding and your persistence in chasing it, not from authority. You will run CSPM analysis in Prisma Cloud, Wiz or Upwind, maintain the shadow AI register, and apply agent risk-tiering to AI deployments that are moving faster than the governance around them. Comfort with being the person who raises the problem and cannot close it is essential.**

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  

* Run CSPM analysis across Azure and GCP in Prisma Cloud, Wiz or Upwind, and produce findings clear enough for a platform team to act on without a follow-up meeting.
* Maintain the shadow AI register and run the discovery scans that populate it, across sanctioned and unsanctioned AI tooling.
* Apply agent and model risk-tiering to AI deployments and track each assessment through to a governance decision.
* Support LLM and API exposure risk assessments with analysis and evidence, referencing MITRE ATLAS and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
* Support cloud IAM and entitlement review packs, including CIEM analysis of over-permissioned identities, and track outcomes to closure.
* Track remediation owned by the Azure and GCP platform teams and business units, and escalate where it stalls — this team advises and flags, it does not remediate.
* Produce KPI data and build Power BI dashboards for cloud and AI security posture, including drift against configuration baselines.
* Improve the team's analysis and reporting through automation in Python rather than only running it.
* Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team's ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
* Design and build the automation and tooling that produces the posture, shadow AI and agent risk picture, documenting the trade-offs made rather than only operating what others built.
* Mentor junior analysts and engineers on cloud and AI posture work, and review their output before it is relied on.
* Apply GxP and data integrity expectations to posture reporting that covers validated systems.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* 10+ years in cloud or platform security in a regulated environment — domain focus: AI Platform & Cloud Security (CSPM, shadow AI and agent risk tiering across Azure and GCP)
* CSPM analysis across Azure and GCP using Prisma Cloud, Wiz or Upwind — findings platform teams can act on, with remediation they own chased and escalated
* Maintaining the shadow AI register populated by discovery programmes — classifying AI tools, copilots and LLM APIs by data exposure and risk — and tracking agent risk-tiering to decision
* Analysing LLM and AI API exposure across Azure and GCP — Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, model endpoints, keys and network exposure — and supporting cloud IAM review packs
* Python, SQL or scripting for posture data, producing AI and cloud security KPIs and dashboards with audit-ready accuracy

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Cloud security certification such as CCSP, AZ-500 or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer
* AI security posture management (AI-SPM) tooling and LLM API risk assessment
* Power BI or equivalent dashboarding
* Cloud IAM and AI/LLM security awareness

* Clear written findings and stakeholder communication with platform engineering teams
* Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Typical tools and technologies: CSPM platforms including Prisma Cloud, Wiz and Upwind, Azure and GCP native security services, cloud infrastructure entitlement management, container and Kubernetes security, shadow AI discovery tooling, model and agent risk tiering, LLM and API exposure assessment, Python for analysis and automation.

**Skills**

AI for Cybersecurity, AI Platforms, Application Security, Cloud Application Security, Cloud Security, Computer Programming, Data Security, Identity Access Management (IAM), Information Systems, Infrastructure Security, LLM Orchestration, Microsoft Azure, ML Security, Operating Systems Security, Scripting, Security Engineering, Security Technologies, Security Testing, Sonrai CSPM, Vulnerability Management

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

title: Senior Principal Architect - Security Architecture & Solution Engineering - Shared Engineering
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Position Summary**

Own Security Solution Engineering: an eight-role team — seven engineers across four squads plus you — that builds, tests and packages the solutions every architecture domain specifies, before they transfer to a managed service vendor to operate. The squads map to the Product Management domains, and vulnerability, configuration and OT work is absorbed by the squad whose tooling it touches. You are judged on build quality, test evidence and whether the vendor can run what you hand over.

**About the team.**

  

Security Architecture and Solution Engineering sets the target-state security architecture for GSK and builds the solutions that realise it. The function brings IT and OT architecture under single ownership for the first time, spanning Network and Zero Trust, Application Security, Platform Security, MDR and Detection Engineering, VM and Configuration Management, Data Security, and OT Security across a global manufacturing, laboratory and research estate. Architecture sets the standards and reference designs, Solution Engineering builds, tests and packages them, and a managed service vendor operates them. Architecture accountability never transfers: Cyber Architecture and Solutions designs and builds, the vendor runs. Twenty roles, with standards applying in more than 100 countries.

**What makes this role different.**

  

**You own build, not design — every specification comes from a domain architect and you send it back if it cannot be tested rather than building to interpretation. Seven engineers across four squads cover network, data, platform and application security, MDR, vulnerability and configuration, and OT simultaneously, so prioritisation between domain Directors is a weekly negotiation and you will disappoint someone most weeks. Everything you build is operated by someone who was not in the room when it was built, which makes handover evidence a first-class deliverable rather than paperwork.**

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

* Own build, test and packaging across all security domains, leading seven engineers across four squads.
* Own the quality of vendor handover packages: a managed service must be able to operate what you built without Cyber Architecture and Solutions present.
* Build to the specifications the architecture domains set, escalating design problems rather than reinterpreting them.
* Own acceptance against the architecture specification and the operational readiness criteria, and refuse handover where test evidence does not cover the failure modes the design depends on.
* Own engineering standards, reusable build components and the solution testing playbook library.
* Arbitrate when two domain Directors both want the same squad in the same sprint, and hold the line on test coverage when a programme date is at risk.
* Lead and develop seven engineers, including three squad leads, an engineering excellence lead and the analyst and support roles.
* Own the configuration record standard the whole function builds to, sufficient to answer a GxP audit on who changed which control and under what change.
* Send back specifications that cannot be tested — no stated success criteria, no failure mode, no rollback — rather than building to interpretation.
* Run vendor shadowing and reverse-shadowing through transition, and close the gaps their first 30 days expose back into the handover pack standard.
* Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
* Own hiring, performance management and succession across the four squads, and build the engineering bench the function will need as the vendor model matures.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* 15+ years in security engineering, including leading technical teams across geographies — domain focus: shared engineering build function for all non-AI domains, organised in four squads matching the Product Management domains
* Leading a security engineering team turning architecture into built, tested capability — four squads matching the Product Management domains one for one, each working in parallel with its domain product owner on use cases, roadmap and build priorities
* Standard builds through automated pipelines — build documentation, test evidence, configuration baselines and operational playbooks — plus a cross-domain security automation programme
* Vendor handover packs and operational-readiness sign-off before managed service takeover, and proof-of-value builds informing architecture and investment decisions
* Engineering AI-enabled security solutions and using GenAI and agentic automation to accelerate builds, testing and documentationEngineering AI-enabled security solutions, including the build, test and documentation standards that agentic automation is held to

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Infrastructure as code, CI/CD and configuration management tooling (Terraform, Ansible, GitHub Actions)
* Security certification such as CISSP, or vendor certifications across SIEM, EDR or network security platforms
* Regulated industry experience, including GxP
* Running release management for security tooling where a failed EDR or proxy change has blast radius across more than 100 countries.

* Standing up a shared security engineering function from scratch, including the first build standards and the first vendor handover pack.
* Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Typical tools and technologies: Build and test automation, infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, CI/CD pipelines, containerisation and Kubernetes, security tooling integration and API automation, Python and PowerShell, build documentation and test evidence to vendor-handover standard, ServiceNow.

**Skills**

AI for Cybersecurity, Application Security, Artificial Intelligence (AI), As Built Documentation, Cloud Security, Computer Programming, Data Security, Identity Access Management (IAM), Identity and Access Management (IAM) Operations, Information Systems, Infrastructure Security, ML Security, Operating Systems Security, Scripting, Security Engineering, Security Technologies, Security Testing, Vulnerability Management

title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering
description:
**Senior Manager, Engineering - Context Engine**

**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You'll Do**

* As the Manager of Engineering for Teradata's Knowledge Platform, you will lead engineering teams responsible for building and delivering core agentic AI-powered platform capabilities. You will drive execution of the technical roadmap, ensure engineering excellence, and partner closely with Product Management, Architecture, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable AI-driven solutions.

* You will play a key role in transforming innovative AI concepts into production-ready platform capabilities while building and mentoring high-performing engineering teams that support Teradata's next generation of autonomous and knowledge-driven products.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Organizational & People Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and develop multiple engineering teams spanning platform engineering, AI/ML, and distributed systems.

* Build and scale high-performing teams; attract, retain, and grow top technical talent in agentic AI, developer platforms, and cloud infrastructure.

* Establish a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

* Drive organizational clarity, resource planning, and cross-functional alignment across engineering, product, and platform teams.

* Coach engineering managers, technical leads, and senior engineers to maximize team effectiveness.

**Technical & Strategic Leadership**

* Lead execution of the architecture strategy for Teradata's autonomous, knowledge, and agentic AI platform capabilities.

* Oversee delivery of production-grade agentic AI functionality across the Knowledge & Data Platform.

* Guide teams build core frameworks and services that embed agentic AI into Teradata's product portfolio.

* Partner with knowledge modeling teams to industrialize proof-of-concepts into highly reliable, scalable, and secure enterprise features.

* Drive technical evaluation and adoption of technologies related to knowledge graphs, LLM orchestration, AI agents, and AI-native developer experiences.

* Proven knowledge and experience with the entire AI (Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Reinforcement Learning, LLM, etc.)

* Good statistical knowledge

* Champion engineering excellence in reliability, observability, automation, and platform scalability.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Work closely with Security Engineering to ensure AI-driven capabilities meet enterprise-grade compliance and governance requirements.

* Partner with Product Management to translate customer needs into differentiated AI and analytics platform capabilities.

* Collaborate with Architecture, R&D, SRE, and Cloud Operations teams to improve reliability, performance, and developer productivity.

* Communicate technical strategy, execution progress, and risks to senior leadership stakeholders.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

**Required Experience**

* 8+ years in software engineering with at least 5+ years leading engineering teams and managers.

* Proven track record delivering complex distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, or large-scale data platforms.

* Demonstrated experience integrating AI/ML, generative AI, or agentic AI technologies into enterprise-grade products.

* Expertise in hybrid and multi-cloud architectures across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.

* Experience modernizing applications into microservices and Kubernetes-based deployment environments.

* Strong understanding of APIs, streaming systems, observability, DevOps practices, and production-grade AI inference pipelines.

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

**What You Will Bring**

* Ability to lead managers and senior technical contributors while fostering a high-performance culture.

* Strong systems-thinking mindset coupled with a pragmatic, execution-focused approach to solving technical challenges.

* Deep understanding of platform reliability, scalability, performance, and AI platform governance.

* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Passion for building AI-native enterprise platforms and driving innovation at scale.

Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

title: Assistant Manager - Data Engineering | Quality Role
description:
**Company Description**

**WNS, part of Capgemini,** is an Agentic AI-powered leader in intelligent operations and transformation, serving more than 700 clients across 10 industries, including Banking and Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Shipping and Logistics, and Travel and Hospitality. We bring together deep domain excellence – WNS’ core differentiator – with AI-powered platforms and analytics to help businesses innovate, scale, adapt and build resilience in a world defined by disruption.  
  
Our purpose is clear: to enable lasting business value by designing intelligent, human-led solutions that deliver sustainable outcomes and a differentiated impact. With three global headquarters across four continents, operations in 13 countries, 65 delivery centers and more than 66,000 employees, WNS combines scale, expertise and execution to create meaningful, measurable impact.

**Why Join Us?**

We promise our employees to experience **role clarity, coaching and mentoring, professional development and structured career path through our 5 people promises** and keeping employee experience at the core. Experience the culture of Outperformance, engagement, celebration and enjoy wide variety of **best in class benefits including free HMO coverage for self and dependent from Day 1**; Also contribute to society through our **WNS Cares Foundation**, where you have the opportunity to support meaningful initiatives and make an impact in the community.

 **Job Description**

Data Quality Engineer  
  
We are looking for a Data Quality Engineer with 4 to 5 years of experience to build and run data quality controls for an enterprise finance data platform on Azure, Databricks and Snowflake. You will define and automate quality rules, reconciliations and matching checks so that data used for financial control, tax and management reporting can be trusted. Candidates at the upper end of the range may lead a small team of data quality engineers.  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
  
Work with business analysts and data owners to define data quality rules for finance data  
  
Build automated quality checks in Databricks pipelines for completeness, validity, consistency and timeliness  
  
Build reconciliations between source systems, the platform and reports, including general ledger to sub-ledger checks  
  
Build matching rules for bank, call account and intra-group reconciliations  
  
Set up exception handling and route failed records to data owners for correction  
  
Build data quality dashboards in Power BI  
  
Record rule definitions and results in Microsoft Purview  
  
Investigate recurring data issues and agree fixes with source system owners  
  
Support testing and production monitoring of quality controls  
  
TECHNICAL SKILLS  
  
Must-have  
  
Databricks, including PySpark and Spark SQL  
  
Advanced SQL  
  
Python  
  
Data quality rule design  
  
Reconciliation and matching logic  
  
Good-to-have  
  
Delta Live Tables expectations  
  
Great Expectations or similar tools  
  
Snowflake  
  
Power BI  
  
Microsoft Purview  
  
DOMAIN KNOWLEDGE  
  
Finance data, including general ledger, sub-ledgers and intra-group balances  
  
Balance sheet substantiation and reconciliation controls  
  
Data quality needs for month-end close, tax and management reporting  
  
CERTIFICATIONS (GOOD TO HAVE)  
  
Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate  
  
DAMA Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP)

title: Lead Technical Onboarding Engineer
description:
**About Neo4j:**

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world's largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.

Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

**Our Vision:**

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we're disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

### **About the Job**

You will play a critical, hands-on role in guiding enterprise customers through the foundational stages of their deployment journey. As a **player-coach and technical anchor for a focused four-person onboarding team**, you will split your time between directly delivering complex customer onboardings and serving as the day-to-day technical escalation point and mentor for three fellow engineers.

Sitting at the intersection of technical architecture and customer delivery, you will bridge the gap between a signed contract and a production-ready ecosystem. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor, steering customers through critical infrastructure milestones—including cloud provisioning, security hardening, networking, data modelling, and application integration.

For fully managed AuraDB cloud customers, you will leverage automation to optimise data modelling, enterprise connectivity, and application health. For self-managed environments, you will apply rigorous Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and platform engineering practices to deploy secure, resilient graph clusters across hybrid and multi-cloud architectures.

### **Responsibilities**

**Hands-on Technical Onboarding (~70–80%)**

* Lead technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers to define success criteria, milestones, architecture patterns, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Guide the provisioning of Neo4j AuraDB environments and self-managed clusters across AWS, Azure, and GCP, establishing secure network architectures using PrivateLink, Private Endpoints, and peering.
* Implement baseline system hardening, TLS/SSL termination, encryption-at-rest protocols, and enforce least-privileged access through enterprise SSO (OIDC/SAML) and RBAC configurations.
* Architect robust data ingestion pipelines (bulk imports, stream processing, Change Data Capture) and advise customer development teams on Neo4j driver optimisation, connection pooling, and retry logic.
* Assist customers in configuring enterprise observability tools (logs and metrics) and deliver best-practice guidance on Cypher query performance and backup/restore planning.
* Produce high-quality technical deliverables—including architecture diagrams, Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), and runbooks—to ensure smooth operational handoffs.

**Technical Mentorship & Team Escalation (~20–30%)**

* Serve as the senior technical point of escalation for the onboarding team, unblocking colleagues on complex customer architectures and troubleshooting edge-case issues.
* Pair with and mentor team members through design reviews, architecture discussions, and customer engagements to continuously elevate collective technical execution.
* Help balance day-to-day account coverage across the team to maintain consistent onboarding velocity and delivery quality.
* Synthesise field insights, lessons learned, and reusable blueprints to iterate and optimise our core onboarding methodologies, tooling, and onboarding automation.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role (e.g., Onboarding Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Platform Engineering, or Technical Consulting), with informal or formal experience acting as a technical lead, mentor, or escalation point.
* Proven track record of operating in a hands-on "player-coach" capacity—comfortable rolling up your sleeves on implementation while guiding peers.
* Hands-on experience architecting and deploying production workloads in at least one major cloud ecosystem (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Deep technical proficiency in core enterprise networking (VPC/VNet architectures, routing protocols, peering, and PrivateLink/Private Endpoints).
* Demonstrated experience configuring Enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM), including SSO (OIDC/SAML) and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Terraform, alongside configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible).
* Experience with Linux administration, containerisation, and orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed container services).
* Hands-on experience with graph databases (ideally Neo4j) and proficiency in query performance tuning (e.g., Cypher optimisation).
* Familiarity with modern observability stacks (Grafana/Prometheus, Datadog, CloudWatch, Splunk) and enterprise data integration/ETL/CDC tools.
* Exposure to cloud compliance standards (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA) and multi-region/data residency deployment patterns.

**Why Join Neo4j?**

Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j.

* Neo4j is one of the fastest-scaling technology companies in this industry. It recently surpassed $200M in annual recurring revenue (ARR), doubling its ARR over the past three years.
* Raised the biggest funding round in database history ($325M Series F). Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history.
* 84% of the Fortune 100 and 58% of the Fortune 500 use Neo4j. Examples include Boston Scientific, BT Group, Caterpillar, Cisco, Comcast, Department for Education UK, eBay, NBC News, Novo Nordisk, Worldline, and others.
* Co-founder and CEO Emil Eifrem has built an amazing culture that prides itself on relationships, inclusiveness, innovation, and customer success.
* Countless industry awards. Massive enterprises and individual developers/data scientists love Neo4j. A strong sense of community and ecosystem is built around the platform.
* A recent Forrester Total Economic Impact™ Study cited Neo4j as delivering 417% ROI to customers.

Research shows that members of underrepresented communities are less likely to apply for jobs when they don't meet all the qualifications. **If this is part of the reason you hesitate to apply, we'd encourage you to reconsider and give us the opportunity to review your application.** At Neo4j, we are committed to building awareness and helping to improve these issues.

One of our central objectives is to provide an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace for everyone to develop their potential and have a positive, career-defining experience. We look forward to receiving your application.

**Neo4j Values:**

Neo4j is a Silicon Valley company with a Swedish soul. We foster collaboration and each of us is empowered to contribute and put our innovative stamp on projects. We hire candidates who reflect the following Neo4j core values:
