title: Associate Director - AI ML and Cloud Security - AI Platform Engineering
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Domain focus: AI Platform Engineering and cloud security posture across Azure and GCP.**

**Job Purpose**:

Build and own the AI and ML platform infrastructure for Cyber Architecture and Solutions, and lead engineering delivery of the data fabric pipeline. You translate AI Architecture's data fabric design into built, tested and vendor-ready infrastructure. The design is owned by Architecture, this role builds it, and the vendor operates it once delivered.

**About the team:**

AI ML and Cloud Security is the function through which GSK is transforming security itself. The team designs and builds the agentic framework, a multi-agent platform moving security services across the Chief Security Office from rule-based to AI-driven operation. It owns AI architecture and AI engineering end to end: the agent layer, LLM orchestration, the AI and ML platform, and the data fabric pipeline that Cyber Architecture and Solutions designs, builds and tests before a managed service vendor operates it. The team also governs AI tool security posture, advises on cloud security across the Azure and GCP estate, and is the front door between GSK's business units and R&D and the technical AI function. AI security standards set here are binding on every AI initiative in GSK. Seventeen roles across the UK, India and the US.

**What makes this role different.** Infrastructure and data engineering rather than model or agent work. You will own Kubernetes and container orchestration, CI/CD for AI and ML workloads, and the data ingestion and transformation layers beneath the data fabric. The handover standard is the thing that matters: a vendor will operate this pipeline without you, so documentation and test evidence are part of the deliverable. If you want to be building agents, that is a different post in this team.

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  

* Own the AKS and GKE clusters, GPU node pools and model-serving tier that every Cyber Architecture and Solutions agent runs on, including capacity, upgrade and resilience planning.
* Lead engineering delivery of the data fabric pipeline, translating architecture specifications into built, tested, vendor-ready infrastructure.
* Own Kubernetes and container orchestration for AI and ML workloads.
* Own CI/CD pipelines for AI and ML delivery.
* Own data ingestion and transformation layers, and govern data ingestion into the fabric.
* Integrate security controls into the platform by design, to the binding AI security standards.
* Prepare data fabric and platform handover packages so the vendor can operate them from day one.
* Own the contract between the platform and agent layers — model-serving endpoints, vector index service levels and the token and cost budget per agent — and renegotiate it when an agent outgrows it.
* Lead the platform engineers delivering the data fabric and model-serving tier, and keep enough of your own week on the estate to make credible design calls.
* Run the shadow and reverse-shadow period where the vendor operates the data fabric under your supervision, and hold the handover gate until their runbook survives an injected failure.
* Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
* Own cloud security posture across Azure and GCP for the AI estate — posture findings, misconfiguration remediation routing and the standards the platform is held to.
* Build and maintain the platform through infrastructure as code, so every environment is reproducible and every change is traceable.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* 15+ years in platform, cloud or AI security engineering in a regulated environment — domain focus: AI Platform Engineering and cloud security posture across Azure and GCP
* Leading AI/ML platform engineering — Kubernetes and CI/CD for AI/ML workloads, GPU and compute provisioning, model serving, vector database operations, MLOps/LLMOps pipelines, model and prompt versioning and observability
* Building the data fabric pipeline to specification with security by design — encryption at rest and in transit, RBAC, audit logging and classification enforcement — and owning data ingestion governance and change control
* Managing the vendor's agentic transformation of the data fabric and vendor readiness for operations handover, ensuring GSK requirements, classification controls and resilience standards are maintained
* GPU scheduling and model-serving operations at scale — KServe or vLLM behind an autoscaled Kubernetes pool, with p95 latency and cost per thousand tokens held to a published budget.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Terraform, infrastructure as code and cloud-native tooling, with vector databases and AI platform components
* Cloud IAM, workload protection and AI workload detection controls
* Compute and data pipeline infrastructure supporting autonomous AI agent operation
* GPU and compute cost management and capacity planning for AI workloads

* Running a large-scale ingestion or data fabric pipeline in production, including backfill, schema evolution and the cost curve as volume grows.
* Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Typical tools and technologies: Kubernetes with GPU and compute provisioning, model serving using KServe or vLLM, MLOps and LLMOps CI/CD pipelines, model registries and MLflow, vector database operations, data fabric pipeline engineering, Terraform and infrastructure as code, cloud security posture management across Azure and GCP, production Python.

**Skills**

Agentic AI Security, AI Agent Identity, AI for Cybersecurity, Application Security, Cloud Security, Computer Programming, Data Security, Identity Access Management (IAM), Information Systems, Infrastructure Security, LLM Architecture, LLM Orchestration, ML Security, Operating Systems Security, RAG Pipeline, Scripting, Security Engineering, Security Technologies, Security Testing, Vulnerability Management

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

title: Manager Operations
description:

**Role Overview:**  
We are seeking an experienced and technically strong Operations Manager to lead the Subscription L3 team, responsible for managing enterprise-level Client Delivery, platform reliability, technical delivery, and continuous improvement across multiple client accounts.
  
  
The role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, operational leadership, stakeholder management, and people development. The individual will own end-to-end service delivery, drive operational excellence, establish scalable delivery practices, and ensure high availability and stability of the Subscription platform.
  
  
The candidate will work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, BSA, Client Experience, and Global Operations teams to ensure seamless service delivery and continuous platform improvement.
  
  
Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

  + Ensure platform stability, availability, reliability, and adherence to defined SLAs and operational KPIs.
  + Oversee incident, problem, change, release, and escalation management.
  + Drive effective resolution of critical production incidents, ensuring timely communication and stakeholder alignment.
  + Establish strong operational governance, including daily reviews, service reviews, and periodic business reviews.
  + Ensure adherence to ITIL-aligned service management processes and organizational standards.
* **Technical Leadership & Platform Ownership**

  + Guide teams in troubleshooting complex production issues, identifying root causes, and implementing permanent corrective actions.
  + Partner with Engineering and Product teams to drive platform enhancements, defect resolution, and technical debt reduction.
  + Drive platform upgrades, patching, migrations, infrastructure modernization, and technology transitions.
  + Establish technical documentation, knowledge management, runbooks, and operational best practices.
  + Promote engineering-led operations and reduce dependency on manual Client delivery activities.
* **Client & Stakeholder Management**
  + Act as a key escalation point for client-facing technical and operational matters.
  + Build effective working relationships with internal stakeholders, client teams, and global delivery partners.
  + Ensure transparent communication on service performance, risks, dependencies, and critical incidents.
  + Drive service improvement initiatives based on client feedback and operational performance.
  + Participate in client governance meetings and provide leadership-level updates on delivery performance.

  + Own resource planning, capacity management, utilization, and workforce optimization.
  + Identify skill gaps and drive structured technical training, cross-skilling, and succession planning.
  + Establish clear accountability, ownership, and performance expectations across the team.
  + Build a culture of collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous learning.
  + Drive effective onboarding and knowledge transitions for new client accounts.
* **Automation, AI & Continuous Improvement**
  + Identify opportunities to automate repetitive operational activities and eliminate manual interventions.
  + Champion AI-driven operations, intelligent monitoring, proactive incident detection, and automated remediation.
  + Drive adoption of approved AI tools and engineering productivity solutions.
  + Establish measurable automation goals and track productivity improvements and resource efficiencies.
  + Encourage innovation through reusable frameworks, standardized solutions, and scalable automation practices.

* **Global Operations & Transition Management**
* + Lead transition of Subscription client accounts into the Global Operations model.
  + Ensure structured knowledge transfer, operational readiness, documentation, and stakeholder sign-offs.
  + Define transition milestones, resource requirements, governance, and stabilization plans.
  + Ensure seamless handover from implementation and engineering teams into steady-state operations.
  + Drive standardization across accounts while accommodating client-specific requirements.
* **Governance, Risk & Compliance**
  + Ensure adherence to security policies, compliance requirements, access controls, and audit standards.
  + Proactively identify operational risks, recurring issues, and service delivery dependencies.
  + Establish effective risk mitigation and escalation mechanisms.
  + Maintain operational dashboards, performance reports, and management-level updates.
  + Drive accountability for audit findings and process improvement actions.

  
**Qualifications**  
**Technical Skills:**  

* 10-13 years of experience in enterprise application client delivery, technical operations, or software delivery. Strong understanding of enterprise application architecture and Client Delivery.
* Experience managing complex L3 client delivery, application integrations, databases.
* Working knowledge of SQL, APIs, scripting, workflow orchestration, and troubleshooting methodologies.
* Experience with incident management, monitoring, release management, and ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, VSTS, JIRA.
* Exposure to cloud infrastructure, DevOps practices, CI/CD, and automation frameworks is preferred.

  
**Leadership & Management Skills:**  

* Proven experience leading distributed technical teams and managing multiple enterprise client accounts.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and escalation-handling capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to manage resources, budgets, capacity, and delivery commitments.
* Experience driving delivery transformation and process standardization.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Ability to engage with senior leadership and communicate technical matters in business terms.

  
**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. ITIL certification is preferred.
* Relevant cloud, DevOps, automation, or project management certifications are an added advantage.

  
**Ideal Candidate Profile:**  
The ideal candidate is a technically strong leader who can balance day-to-day delivery execution with long-term transformation initiatives.
  
  
They should be capable of moving beyond traditional ticket-based Delivery management and building a proactive, engineering-driven delivery organization.
  
  
The individual should demonstrate:
  

* Strong ownership and accountability for service delivery.
* Ability to lead through technical complexity and delivery challenges.
* A continuous improvement mindset with a focus on automation and AI adoption.
* Ability to scale delivery across multiple clients without compromising service quality.
* Strong collaboration across Delivery, Engineering, QA, BSA, DEV and Global Operational teams.

  
**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) -** The role will be measured against the following performance dimensions:
  

* Service Delivery: SLA compliance, incident resolution, service availability

* Incident Management: MTTR, P1/P2 resolution effectiveness, RCA quality and timeliness

People Development: Training, cross-skilling, retention and succession planning

title: ASIC Infrastructure/ Digital Design Engineer
description:
**Date posted** 11/07/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19317****Date Posted** **11/07/2026**

**We Are:**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP integration, simulation and analysis solutions and design services., empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

**You Are:**

You’re an early-career engineer eager to build semiconductor design infrastructure. You value rigorous digital design and enjoy improving tool flows as much as writing code. You understand that when a designer’s environment breaks, productivity drops and milestones slip—and you care. You think in systems, not just scripts, considering dependencies, data ownership, and failure modes before automating. You can debug Linux, Python, and EDA issues independently, knowing when a workaround is acceptable versus when to fix the root cause. You take initiative, ask questions, read documentation, and test safely before deploying changes. You are keen on improving productivity of design flow using latest available AI tools and methodology. At Synopsys, you’ll keep ASIC teams productive and accelerate silicon IP delivery.

  
  

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Develop and maintain infrastructure supporting daily ASIC design, verification, test and implementation workflows.
* Install, configure, upgrade, and manage EDA tools and licenses (simulation, synthesis, timing, etc.).
* Build and maintain automation for flow setup, job submission, tracking, data management, and reporting (Python/Tcl/Bash/Perl).
* Support compute and storage platforms: filesystem management, monitoring, and ensuring capacity/availability for large datasets.
* Support HPC/compute farms and schedulers: batch submissions, resource allocation, and job scheduling.
* Troubleshoot and proactively monitor environments (tool configs, permissions, paths, licenses), and maintain clear documentation for users.
* Work with the central methodology teams to test, deploy new design flows. Use AI tools/flow to improve the execution efficiency.
  

  

**The Impact You Will Have:**

* Keep ASIC design teams productive and on track for tapeout by ensuring infrastructure uptime and stability.
Automate repetitive setup and flow tasks to* engineers significant time each week.
* Proactively monitor compute, storage, and licenses to prevent issues from blocking critical runs.
* Ensure compute farm and storage capacity scales smoothly during simulation/synthesis workload spikes.
* Deliver reliable updates, documentation, and self-serve processes that reduce troubleshooting and prevent downstream failures.
  

  

**What You'll Need:**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**Team Overview**

Our work spans a wide spectrum of problem domains — from intelligent search and autonomous planning systems to knowledge engineering, decision support, and agentic automation — reflecting the deliberate breadth of challenges we take on.

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.  
  

**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**

* **Design and build AI-powered intelligent systems:** applying classical AI concepts — search, planning, ranking, retrieval, reasoning, constraint satisfaction, and knowledge representation — to solve real enterprise business problems.

title: Director, Data Systems Software Engineering
description:
DB Fleet Central is an OCI native cloud service for database fleet management and observability. It gives enterprise customers a way to monitor fleet health and availability, understand performance and capacity trends, manage databases, and investigate operational issues across cloud, hybrid, and multicloud environments. Its roadmap includes AI-assisted SQL and AWR insights, diagnostic assistance, fleet-wide anomaly and regression detection, and the AI Agent Observability platform.

As Director, you will set the engineering direction and lead the organization responsible for delivering these customer capabilities as reliable cloud services.

title: Data Security Engineering Lead
description:
**About Astellas**

Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com

**Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?**

We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.

  

**Purpose and Scope:**

Engineer and run the Microsoft Purview platform that protects Astellas' most sensitive data. As Data Security Engineering Lead, you will turn approved protection requirements into working sensitivity labels, data loss prevention and classification controls, keep them accurate as the business and its use of AI evolve, and lead the Astellas team that takes over day-to-day operations from our implementation partner.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

* Scope: Microsoft Purview data security capabilities across Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, Windows endpoints, browsers, and Microsoft 365 Copilot and other AI tools, in a single global Microsoft 365 tenant.
* Information Protection: Design, configure and maintain sensitivity labels and label policies, container labels, client-side and service-side auto-labeling, and encryption (Rights Management and Message Encryption), keeping the label scheme simple enough for employees to apply correctly.
* Data Loss Prevention: Build and tune Purview DLP policies across email, collaboration, endpoint (via Defender for Endpoint) and browser channels, and extend protection to Copilot and AI tools using Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) for AI. Configure policy tips, user notifications and business-justification overrides.
* Classification & Detection: Turn crown-jewel and use-case inputs from the Data Protection Policy & Engagement Lead into accurate detection, using custom sensitive information types, exact data match, document fingerprinting and trainable classifiers. Validate coverage with Content Explorer and Activity Explorer, and reduce false positives using feedback from the business and the Insider Risk team.
* Policy Lifecycle & Operations: Run policy change control from simulation to enforcement and rollback; triage and escalate DLP alerts; configure approved exceptions with expiry dates; and monitor user overrides, reporting patterns back to policy owners.
* Integration & Automation: Send Purview alerts and audit data to Microsoft Sentinel and ServiceNow with the Security Operations and platform teams; automate configuration, reporting and testing with Purview PowerShell and Microsoft Graph; and work with the Insider Risk team to share data loss and insider risk signals, align detections and Adaptive Protection, and use joint findings to tune policies.
* Service Ownership: Own service levels, performance metrics and the operations and engineering runbook; lead knowledge transfer from our implementation partner; and become the Astellas operations owner for the platform by mid-2027.
* Platform Leadership: Own the Microsoft Purview data security platform roadmap and provide input to licensing decisions; oversee our implementation partner's engineering delivery and quality; and lead and mentor the Astellas engineers and analysts who take over day-to-day operations.

  

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology or a related field.
* 10+ years in security engineering or operations, including 4+ years hands-on with Microsoft Purview data security (Information Protection, DLP and data classification) in a production Microsoft 365 environment.
* Experience leading cross-functional initiatives with global stakeholders and overseeing external partners or vendors, including leading or mentoring a team.
* Experience building custom sensitive information types and tuning DLP policies to reduce false positives at enterprise scale.
* Hands-on experience with Endpoint DLP and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
* PowerShell scripting, with working knowledge of KQL and Microsoft Graph.
* Ability to explain technical behavior clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience with exact data match, document fingerprinting or trainable classifiers.
* Experience protecting Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI tools with DSPM for AI.
* Experience integrating Purview with Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR and ServiceNow.
* Experience with Zscaler CASB and Data Security products.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences or other regulated industries.
* Microsoft Certified: Information Security Administrator Associate (SC-401); SC-200 or SC-100 a plus.

**Working Environment:**

At Astellas we recognize the importance of work/life balance, and we are proud to offer a hybrid working solution allowing time to connect with colleagues at the office with the flexibility to also work from home. We believe this will optimize the most productive work environment for all employees to succeed and deliver. Hybrid work from certain locations may be permitted in accordance with Astellas’ Responsible Flexibility

  

**What awaits you at Astellas?**

* Global collaboration: Become part of a connected global business of like-minded life science leaders, all dedicated to improving patients' lives worldwide.
* Real-world patient impact: Contribute to transformative therapies that reach patients around the world, knowing your work makes a difference every day.
* Relentless Innovation: Join a company at the forefront of scientific breakthroughs, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare.
* A Culture of Growth: Chart your own course within a supportive environment that values your contributions, champions your development, and empowers you to pursue your passions.
  

**Our Organizational Values and Behaviors**

Values: Innovation, Integrity and Impact sit at the heart of what we do.

Behaviors: We come together as ‘One Astellas’, working with courage and a sense of urgency. We are outcome focused and consistently take accountability for our personal contribution.

Ability to engage and communicate effectively with **technical and business decision-makers**, connecting technology capabilities to customer requirements and business outcomes.

Strong **problem-solving, technical communication and consultative skills**, with the ability to navigate complex customer environments and collaborate across sales, engineering, partners and customer teams.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

title: Technical Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

AI Risk Engineer on Chevron’s Responsible AI (RAI) team partners with business and IT development teams to help ensure that AI and machine learning systems—including third-party tools, generative AI, and AI agents—are fair, transparent, accountable, secure, and aligned with Chevron’s ethical principles. Working at the intersection of AI/ML engineering, ethics, and policy, you will build and maintain the automation, scripts, and tooling that power Chevron’s AI impact assessment process, and help operationalize Responsible AI controls within our AI governance platform (Credo AI). You will collaborate closely with our Cybersecurity, Legal, and Data Privacy teams to ensure that AI solutions, vendors, and internal use cases adhere to Chevron guidelines, policies, and emerging regulations.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Build, maintain, and enhance the automation flows, scripts, and tooling that support Chevron’s AI impact assessment and Responsible AI review processes.
* Configure and administer Chevron’s AI governance platform (Credo AI)—adding risk scenarios, controls, and review workflows that enable teams to document mitigations, provide evidence, and track AI risks across the lifecycle.
* Design and operate review and approval checkpoints, including pre-production questionnaires and periodic re-reviews of AI use cases, streamlining through automation where possible.
* Establish and run model review processes for both pre-trained/foundation models and custom-built machine learning models.
* Assist in AI Discovery and maintain an inventory of AI models, agents, and use cases across the enterprise, ensuring proper documentation and lifecycle governance.
* Conduct ethical risk assessments and impact analyses for AI use cases, including alignment with regulations such as the EU AI Act and industry frameworks such as the IOGP Responsible Use of AI principles, and NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
* Evaluate AI vendors, models, and external AI access requests for fairness, security, and policy compliance, partnering with Cybersecurity, Legal, and Data Privacy.
* Influence the development and adoption of tools and methodologies to detect and mitigate bias, drift, and unintended consequences in machine learning and generative AI systems.
* Lead training, FAQs, and awareness campaigns—leveraging Teams and Copilot—to promote ethical AI practices and communicate process changes across business units.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to integrate Responsible AI principles into product development and deployment workflows.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of professional experience in data science, analytics, or AI/ML engineering roles.
* Proficiency in Python and experience building automation, scripts, or data pipelines that integrate with enterprise platforms and APIs.
* Demonstrated ability to reason through ethical implications of AI systems and articulate trade-offs.
* Experience working with interdisciplinary teams (e.g., cybersecurity, legal, privacy, policy) to embed Responsible AI principles.
* Strong communication and presentation skills to convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Familiarity with data governance frameworks and enterprise compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, NIST, OECD).

**Must Have Skill**
-------------------

Python,Responsible AI,AI Governance

**Good to Have Skill**
----------------------

AI for Cybersecurity

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

* Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Certifications in Responsible AI, Data/AI Ethics, Cybersecurity, or AI Governance.
* Experience developing and evaluating machine learning models using Python and libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
* Experience with generative AI or agentic AI frameworks, tools, or applications, and with governing AI agents (e.g., agent registries, Microsoft Agents 365).
* Experience with AI governance or model-risk platforms (e.g., Credo AI) and workflow automation (e.g., Power Automate, Azure DevOps).
* Knowledge of fairness, interpretability, and robustness techniques in AI.
* Experience with enterprise AI platforms (e.g., Azure ML / Azure AI Foundry, Databricks, DataRobot).
* Familiarity with emerging AI regulations and industry frameworks (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, IOGP Responsible Use of AI).

* Proven ability to work autonomously in ambiguous environments and make connections between disparate data sources.
* **Must-have:**Python; familiarity AI system implementation; familiarity with policies related to AI governance

  **Good-to-have:**certification in RAI, data/AI ethics, cybersecurity, or AI governance; Oil & Gas domain.

Responsibilities:

**Lead AI Power & Performance Engineer**
========================================

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are seeking an experienced AI Power & Performance Engineer, Lead to join our AI System Power and Performance team. The candidate will lead the evaluation, benchmarking, profiling, and optimization of AI inference workloads across modern CPU, GPU, APU, NPU, and heterogeneous computing platforms.

This senior technical role requires deep expertise in AI workload performance, platform architecture, and system-level optimization. The candidate will independently drive benchmarking strategy, complex root-cause analysis, competitive evaluation, and technical recommendations while collaborating with engineering, product, customer, and executive stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Define and drive the AI performance benchmarking and workload characterization strategy across CPU, GPU, APU, NPU, and heterogeneous platforms.

* Analyze key performance metrics, including latency, throughput, time to first token, tokens per second, memory utilization, power consumption, and performance per watt.
* Profile workloads and identify bottlenecks across AI frameworks, runtimes, libraries, drivers, operating systems, firmware, memory subsystems, and hardware.
* Lead complex root-cause analysis and recommend optimizations related to quantization, graph execution, kernels, memory usage, workload scheduling, and heterogeneous compute utilization.
* Conduct competitive benchmarking across AMD and competing CPU, GPU, APU, and AI accelerator platforms.
* Collaborate with SoC architects, framework, runtime, compiler, driver, firmware, and system software teams to improve AI workload performance.
* Develop and improve automation for benchmark execution, data collection, regression analysis, and results visualization.
* Translate benchmarking data into actionable technical recommendations that influence software optimization, hardware design, product strategy, and customer engagements.
* Present technical findings and recommendations to engineering teams, customers, executives, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
* Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and drive alignment across multiple teams.

**Required Skills & Experience**
--------------------------------

* 10 to 14+ years of relevant experience in AI performance engineering, system performance analysis, workload optimization, benchmarking, or post-silicon performance validation.
* Hands-on experience evaluating, benchmarking, and characterizing AI inference workloads on CPU, GPU, APU, NPU, or heterogeneous computing platforms.
* Strong experience with PyTorch, ONNX Runtime, vLLM, llama.cpp, TensorFlow, or equivalent AI frameworks and inference runtimes.
* Deep expertise in platform architecture, hardware performance, and system-level optimization, including CPU, GPU, NPU, memory, power, and thermal subsystems.
* Strong Linux systems expertise, including performance profiling, workload tracing, memory management, workload scheduling, automation, and system-level debugging.
* Experience with profiling tools such as Linux perf, AMD uProf, ROCm Profiler, Nsight Systems, VTune, Perfetto, or equivalent tools.
* Strong understanding of hardware architecture, memory hierarchy, data movement, power and thermal behavior, and performance trade-offs.
* Experience with AI optimization techniques such as quantization, mixed-precision inference, graph optimization, operator fusion, kernel tuning, and memory optimization.
* Proficiency in Python and Bash for benchmark automation, data analysis, and reporting.
* Working knowledge of C or C++ for performance debugging and low-level workload analysis.
* Ability to independently drive benchmarking strategy, competitive analysis, root-cause investigation, and technical recommendations.
* Excellent executive, customer-facing, and cross-functional communication skills.
* Ability to convert complex performance data into clear technical reports, dashboards, presentations, and actionable recommendations.
* Proven ability to provide technical leadership and drive complex initiatives across multiple engineering teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with ROCm, Ryzen AI Software, Vitis AI, MIGraphX, or related AI technologies.
* Experience with MLPerf Inference or comparable AI benchmarking methodologies.
* Knowledge of INT8, INT4, FP16, BF16, and mixed-precision execution.
* Experience with large language model inference, including batching, KV-cache management, model parallelism, and memory optimization.
* Experience with Docker, virtualization, and containerized AI environments.
* Exposure to post-silicon bring-up, early silicon testing, competitive benchmarking, or customer-facing performance analysis.
* Experience influencing platform architecture, software roadmaps, product strategy, or customer solutions through data-driven performance analysis.

**Education**
-------------

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical field.

title: Junior Data Scincetist
description:
**Job Requirements**  

**Role:**

To contribute to the end-to-end development and product lifecycle management of artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) systems as part of an R&D organization. The Junior Data Scientist supports the definition of intended algorithm performance, the development and curation of representative data and annotations, the development of AI/ML algorithms, and the generation of scientific evidence demonstrating stand-alone algorithm performance.

The candidate is expected to:

* Apply scientific, statistical, machine learning, and software engineering methods to develop and evaluate AI/ML algorithm components for defined product use cases.
* Work with experienced Data Scientists, product management, clinical or domain experts, software developers, and quality and regulatory functions to translate customer needs and the intended use into measurable algorithm performance targets.
* Support the definition, sourcing, curation, documentation, and maintenance of representative data cohorts and annotations required for training, tuning, and evaluation.
* Plan and execute reproducible scientific evaluations that provide objective evidence of algorithm performance, limitations, and suitability for the intended use.
* Contribute the Data Science work products and evidence required for integration of AI/ML algorithm components into products and for their verification, validation, regulatory release, and lifecycle monitoring.

**What are my responsibilities?**

As a Junior Data Scientist, you are required to:

* Support the finalization of product and algorithm concepts by translating customer needs, intended use, clinical or technical requirements, and applicable regulatory considerations into measurable state-of-the-art performance targets.
* Contribute to the definition of the AI/ML development and scientific evaluation strategy for assigned algorithm components under the guidance of experienced Data Scientists.
* Perform exploratory data analysis and data risk assessments to identify data gaps, quality issues, potential bias, confounding factors, outliers, and limitations that may affect algorithm development or evaluation.
* Define and document data needs for training, tuning, and evaluation, including relevant subgroups and acceptance criteria, so that data cohorts are representative of the intended use and aligned with the product and regulatory strategy.
* Support the specification of annotations, acceptance criteria, and quality controls; collaborate with qualified internal or external suppliers on sourcing data and annotations.
* Curate, version, maintain, and document representative data cohorts and ensure data provenance, traceability, quality, and fitness for purpose together with data management stakeholders.
* Design, implement, train, tune, and technically characterize AI/ML algorithm components using appropriate machine learning, deep learning, statistical, or generative AI methods.
* Define scientifically justified metrics, evaluation methods, test cases, and acceptance criteria to assess stand-alone algorithm performance, including relevant aspects such as accuracy, robustness, reliability, generalizability, explainability, bias, and subgroup performance.
* Implement and execute reproducible bench tests on representative evaluation cohorts and relevant subgroups as part of the verification and validation strategy.
* Analyze and interpret evaluation results, investigate failure modes, document residual limitations, and derive evidence-based recommendations for algorithm improvement and product decisions.
* Document development and evaluation activities and contribute to Data Science work products such as data management information, annotation specifications, scientific evaluation test cases, and scientific evaluation reports.
* Provide scientific evidence and technical input for product reviews and regulatory submissions and support responses to questions concerning data, annotations, evaluation methods, and stand-alone algorithm performance.
* Support the design and execution of clinical investigations, reader studies, or other studies when additional evidence is required by the product or regulatory strategy.
* Collaborate with software engineering and MLOps functions to establish reproducible pipelines, versioned artifacts, automated tests, controlled deployment, and integration of algorithm components into the product.
* Help define and implement monitoring metrics for detecting data anomalies, outliers, and algorithm performance drift across the product lifecycle.
* Regularly review advances in Data Science and AI and assess their applicability to the development and evaluation of AI/ML products.

**Qualification:**

Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Biomedical Engineering, Medical Informatics, or a related quantitative or engineering field. A Ph.D. is welcome but not required. The candidate should have completed university-level coursework or equivalent practical training in:

* Probability, statistics, and experimental design
* Artificial intelligence, machine learning, and deep learning
* Linear algebra, optimization, and numerical methods
* Data structures, algorithms, and software programming
* Model evaluation, scientific methodology, and interpretation of empirical results

**Experience level:**

This is a junior R&D position. Relevant experience may have been gained through academic research, a thesis, internships, working-student assignments, or up to approximately three years of professional work in Data Science, machine learning, AI research, or AI/ML product development. Demonstrated hands-on experience in developing and scientifically evaluating AI/ML models is more important than a specific number of years.

**Desired Knowledge & Experience:**

* Sound understanding of machine learning, deep learning, statistical analysis, experimental design, and model evaluation.
* Active programming skills in Python and practical experience with libraries and frameworks such as NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras.
* Hands-on experience with the development workflow of AI/ML models, including data preparation, training, tuning, evaluation, error analysis, reproducibility, and documentation.
* Ability to define meaningful performance metrics, evaluation cohorts, subgroup analyses, test methods, and acceptance criteria for the intended use of an AI/ML algorithm.
* Understanding of data quality, representativeness, bias, annotation quality, data provenance, and traceability in AI/ML development.
* Knowledge of Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) concepts and tooling, including source and data versioning, reproducible pipelines, experiment tracking, automated testing, CI/CD, deployment, and monitoring.
* Hands-on exposure to current Large Language Models and Generative AI, including foundation models, prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, and model adaptation or fine-tuning.
* Knowledge of Agentic AI, including tool-using models, multi-step workflows, orchestration, memory, and autonomous or semi-autonomous decision paths, is an advantage.
* Experience or strong interest in the systematic evaluation of LLM, Generative AI, and Agentic AI systems, including task-specific benchmarks, groundedness and factuality, robustness, reproducibility, human evaluation, safety and guardrail testing, tool-use correctness, and analysis of failure modes.
* Experience with databases and query languages such as SQL; knowledge of Kusto Query Language, Snowflake, or graph databases such as Neo4j is an advantage.
* Exposure to cloud-based data and AI environments, preferably Microsoft Azure, such as Azure Blob Storage, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Monitor, or Azure DevOps.
* Experience with structured and unstructured data, for example machine logs, event data, Parquet files, text data, or multimodal data.
* Knowledge of healthcare, medical technology, clinical data, or interoperability standards such as DICOM is preferred.
* Basic project management skills and familiarity with working in cross-functional R&D or product-development teams.

**Required Soft Skills & Other Capabilities:**

* Scientific mindset, strong analytical ability, and attention to detail.
* Commitment to objective evidence, reproducibility, traceability, data integrity, and responsible AI development.
* Curiosity and resilience to investigate unexpected results, challenge assumptions, and improve models based on evidence.
* Collaborative approach to working with Data Scientists, domain experts, software engineers, product management, and quality and regulatory stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently within an agreed scope and to seek guidance when technical, scientific, product, or regulatory implications require alignment.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to explain methods, results, uncertainties, limitations, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:

title: Product Software Engineering Architect
description:

The Ad Platform Engineering organization within Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is responsible for building, enhancing, and operating a high-performance, distributed, microservice-based digital advertising platform. This platform powers billions of real-time ad decisions daily across Disney’s video-on-demand and live TV properties, including Hulu, Disney+, ESPN, and more.

Within Ad Platform Engineering, the Programmatic teams build and maintain Disney’s programmatic advertising suite of products and services that comprise Disney's Real-time Ad Exchange (DRAX). DRAX is an award-winning, proprietary supply-side platform (SSP) that enables programmatic deal configuration and integrates demand from multiple third-party sources into Disney’s ad server in real time.

**Job Summary:**

As a Full-Stack Product Software Engineering Architect, you will be a hands-on technical leader, setting the standard for engineering excellence as you drive the architecture, design, and delivery of resilient, large-scale, distributed platforms. You’ll impact technical direction and architecture across the organization, mentor fellow engineers, and ensure our systems are robust, secure, and future-ready.

Daily, you should bring:

* Vision and passion for building, owning, and evolving mission-critical systems at scale.
* Deep expertise in full stack engineering, microservices, and modern cloud architectures.
* A growth mindset—committed to mentoring, continuous learning, and thriving in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
* Exceptional communication skills to collaborate across product, design, business, and engineering teams, and to represent engineering in strategic discussions.
* Ability to define and drive adoption of technical and operational metrics, ensuring system health and managing risk.
* Strategic thinking with a pragmatic approach to technical challenges, balancing innovation with practical execution.

**Responsibilities and Duties of the Role:**

* Architect, design, implement, and support secure, highly scalable, distributed, and decoupled backend and frontend systems for programmatic advertising.
* Set technical direction and ensure alignment with best practices in code quality, maintainability, observability, and performance.
* Establish, champion, and evolve standards for system design, testing, monitoring, and deploying low-latency microservices.
* Act as a technical mentor, sharing knowledge, conducting code and design reviews, and helping engineers grow.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners, translating business and product requirements into technical roadmaps and robust solutions.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, identifying optimizations and enhancements to systems and processes.
* Support platform reliability by enhancing observability, promoting automated alerting, and participating in on-call rotations as needed.
* Ensure compliance with Disney's best practices and security policies, including use of AI and automation technologies.
* Serve as a domain authority and point of contact for technical stakeholders inside and outside engineering.

**Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training:**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience with a leadership track record.
* Advanced proficiency in Java and Typescript.
* Expertise in JavaScript libraries and frameworks including React and Node.js.
* In-depth experience building and scaling RESTful APIs and microservice architectures (preferably with Spring Boot).
* Strong hands-on knowledge of relational databases (MySQL, Postgres, etc.), including schema and query design, as well as NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB) database technologies.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a track record of project ownership, technical leadership, and organization-wide influence.
* Strong foundation in computer science principles, including data structures, algorithms, and system design.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Proven ability to influence engineering strategy and technical direction beyond the immediate team.
* Experience promoting best practices for security, code quality, and operational excellence in a large-scale, distributed environment.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* PhD degree in a STEM field (e.g., Computer Science, Mathematics, or Statistics) or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience with one or more general purpose programming languages: Python, C/C++, or Java, etc. and training deep learning models in frameworks such as JAX, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
* Research experience in machine learning or AI techniques (e.g., open source project(s), campus lab experience, research internship(s), or publication(s)).
* One or more scientific publication submission(s) in AI conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, CVPR, ICCV, ICLR).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* PhD and Master’s degree in a STEM field (e.g. Computer Science, Mathematics, or Statistics) or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands-on experience with one or more general purpose programming languages: Python, C/C++, or Java, etc and training deep learning models in frameworks such as JAX, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
* Extensive research experience in machine learning or AI techniques (e.g. open source project(s), campus lab experience, research internship(s), or publication(s)).
* Ability to work and collaborate across multiple teams and work with ambiguity.
* A strong publication record in top-tier conferences/journals.

**About the job**
-----------------

The Post-doctoral Researcher role is a 12 to 24-month role designed to explore challenging problems for pushing frontiers of AI, while collaborating with DeepMind scientists and engineers. Your role will entail conducting human-computer interaction (HCI) research on how people interact with, oversee, and provide feedback to increasingly autonomous AI agents, designing and building novel interfaces and interaction techniques for human-agent collaboration, and evaluating them through rigorous user studies. Insights from your work will inform how agents learn from human feedback and remain safe and aligned with human intent, with potential application to products that might have a positive impact on billions of users.

At DeepMind, we're a team of scientists, engineers, machine learning experts and more, working together to advance the state of the art in artificial intelligence, and fulfill our mission of building AI responsibility to benefit humanity. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, and collaborate with others on critical challenges, ensuring safety and ethics are the highest priority.

In particular, our AQUA team at DeepMind India works at the frontier of AI agents, focusing on autonomous self-improvement, reinforcement learning, and the safety and alignment of agents. We build agents that continually improve themselves by learning from their own experience, interactions, and feedback, and we develop methods to ensure that increasingly capable and autonomous agents remain safe, reliable, and aligned with human intent and values. We aim to bring our research into Google's cutting-edge models and products, while also disseminating our findings through publications at top ML conferences/journals.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Work with research mentors to formulate research projects or novel applications of machine learning aligned with the team's mission. Conduct research and publish high quality work.
* Design and execute large-scale experiments, writing high-quality, reusable code, and contributing to a production-ready system using frameworks such as JAX. Learn and understand research in machine learning algorithms.
* Understand how to use research to drive design decisions. Design and conduct user studies (e.g. interviews, surveys, controlled experiments, and field deployments) to understand how people interact with, oversee, and provide feedback to AI agents.
* Prototype novel interfaces and interaction techniques that help people steer, supervise, and collaborate with increasingly autonomous agents. Develop human-centered evaluation methods and metrics for the helpfulness, trustworthiness, safety, and alignment of agents.
* Translate insights from human studies into improvements in how agents learn from human feedback and improve themselves (e.g. reward modeling, preference elicitation, and human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning).

title: Engineer I, Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About the Role:**

GSK’s Enterprise AI team builds AI solutions that prove value fast and scale to production. Forward Deployed Engineers are the builders at the front of the delivery pipeline — embedded with business unit teams, prototyping AI ideas at a days-to-weeks cadence and handing proven solutions off cleanly for scale-up.

The Engineer-I is a mid-level individual contributor in the FDE team. This role contributes to FDE engagements under the direction of more senior FDEs, learning the practice through hands-on work. Most prototyping is AI-augmented: AI coding assistants and multi-agent workflows handle the bulk of routine code, and learning to use them fluently is part of the role. The FDE does not carry use cases to long-term operations — clean handoff is part of the job.

**Why This Role Exists:**

Enterprise AI needs engineers who can contribute to embedded prototype work alongside domain experts. The role builds the pipeline of senior FDE capability the function needs as its portfolio grows.

* **Contributes to prototyping** under the direction of Lead and Senior FDEs — shipping working AI proofs of concept with BU teams.
* **Builds AI-native fluency** using AI coding assistants and multi-agent workflows as the default mode of work.
* **Learns the FDE practice** from more senior team members through hands-on engagements and direct mentorship.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**FDE Engagement Contribution**

* **Contribute to BU use case engagements** — prototyping, demoing, refining — under the direction of more senior FDEs.
* **Embed with BU teams** alongside the Lead or Senior FDE, building working relationships with BU engineers and product owners.

**AI-Native Engineering**

* **Operate AI agent workflows** under guidance — contributing to multi-agent prototype delivery.
* **Use AI coding assistants** as the default mode of building; develop genuine fluency with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and Databricks AI Assistant.

**Delivery & Handoff**

* **Contribute to clean handoff packages** for the Solutions Engineer — documentation, runbooks, and working software.
* **Apply existing patterns** from the FDE pattern library; contribute small refinements to patterns as experience develops.

**Governance & Learning**

* **Support Code Orange, Responsible AI, and Accountability Report** conversations during prototyping alongside more senior FDEs.
* **Actively learn the FDE practice** from more senior team members; seek feedback and apply it rapidly.

**Required Experience**

* At least 5+ years of full-stack or AI/ML engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to take ideas from sketch to working software.
* Working proficiency in Python and at least one of TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, or similar.
* Hands-on experience with GenAI patterns: agents, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, and prompt engineering.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Data Cloud, Google Cloud
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, solution architecture, machine learning, or technical consulting, including coding experience in Python and SQL.
* Experience with data cloud ecosystem products, technologies, or languages (e.g., Apache Spark, PySpark, BigQuery, Spanner, Data Catalog, and AlloyDB).
* Experience taking production-grade data cloud solutions from conception to launch, including architecting data systems on cloud platforms (e.g., GCP) and building structured/unstructured pipelines.
* Experience training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models in production.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
* Knowledge of large language model (LLM)-native metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.
* Experience in prompt developing, model evaluation, and the creative application of AI.
* Experience building applications on LLM over enterprise data (e.g., Gemini, agents, RAG, vector search) and evaluating them for quality, latency and cost.
* Experience migrating analytics, Spark or database workloads between platforms with measured cost or performance outcomes.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google Cloud’s Data Cloud team builds the data platform behind Google’s agentic AI offerings: BigQuery, Managed Spark, borderless Lakehouse, Spanner, AlloyDB and Knowledge Catalog, integrated with Gemini Enterprise.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) on the Data Cloud team, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier data solutions and production-grade reality for customers. You will function as an "innovator-builder," working directly within customers’ environments to move data and machine learning workloads from idea to production on Google Cloud, leveraging experience with programming languages (e.g. PySpark, SQL, Python) and the data cloud ecosystem (e.g. BigQuery, Managed Spark, Spanner, AlloyDB). You will build the data foundations that agents depend on, and train and evaluate machine learning models on customer data. By embedding with strategic accounts, you serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment of complex systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Build and ship production data and machine learning workloads with customers, writing, testing, and performance-tuning PySpark, SQL and Python on BigQuery, Managed Spark, Spanner and AlloyDB.
* Present working proofs with customers’ data, including de-identifying sensitive data (e.g., PCI, PHI).
* Build the data foundation for agentic solutions, including lakehouse architectures, metadata, semantic context, and the access controls that let custom agents act on trusted data.
* Train, evaluate and deploy machine learning and agentic components where they improve the customer’s business metric, with evaluation and monitoring in place.
* Refactor and migrate high-cost analytics, Spark and operational database workloads from other platforms onto Google Cloud engines, with measured price-performance results.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

title: Senior Lead Analysts - Data Management and Modeling
description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

We are looking for a Lead Data & AI Engineer to build trusted data and semantic foundations that turn enterprise AI into scalable business capability. You will combine data engineering, data-product thinking, dimensional and semantic modelling, application development, AI engineering, and practical data science. You will own delivery from raw data to AI-enabled decisions. This covers medallion architecture, reusable data products, semantic models, agents, and applications.

You will partner early with business, product, Data & Analytics, and technology stakeholders to define outcomes, success measures, and data needs. You will turn ambiguous challenges into technical designs, prototypes, and production solutions, and you will stay involved through adoption and improvement. This is a hands-on technical leadership role with mentoring responsibilities. It has no direct people management.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Deliver production-ready Data & AI solutions, staying hands-on in investigation, architecture, coding, modelling, testing, and implementation.
* Build AI-ready data foundations and agentic solutions grounded in structured data, governed measures, semantic metadata, and enterprise knowledge.
* Build production-ready Agentic AI, LLM, RAG, and tool/API orchestration patterns using enterprise engineering standards.
* Build analytical and AI-enabled applications using Fabric application capabilities, Rayfin, or comparable frameworks, integrated with semantic models, APIs, agents, and enterprise security.
* Build robust ELT/ETL pipelines using Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, SQL, Python, dbt, Apache Airflow, or comparable technologies.
* Implement bronze, silver, and gold medallion layers with lineage and auditability. Integrate lakehouse, warehouse, and semantic assets using batch, streaming, Direct Lake, or API patterns.
* Deliver reusable, domain-aligned data products with clear ownership, data contracts, quality controls, documentation, and consumption interfaces.
* Design dimensional models with explicit grain, conformed dimensions, facts, hierarchies, slowly changing dimensions, and bridge and relationship patterns.
* Build and optimize Fabric and Power BI semantic models with governed measures, DAX, relationships, and metadata, so analytics, applications, and AI share consistent business context.
* Explore data, frame hypotheses, engineer features, and apply segmentation, forecasting, classification, or anomaly detection where they support a business decision.
* Evaluate analytical and machine-learning approaches against suitable baselines using statistical reasoning, validation, and business-relevant measures. Explain limitations and integrate useful results into data products or applications.
* Collaborate with data scientists on deeper modelling needs. This is not a dedicated data scientist role.
* Lead end-to-end technical delivery: define scope, estimate and plan work, manage dependencies and risks, coordinate stakeholders, and own release readiness, adoption, and operational handover.
* Mentor engineers through architecture, design, and code reviews, debugging, testing, and production-readiness practices.
* Build data quality, observability, automated testing, lineage, security, privacy, responsible AI, version control, and CI/CD into every stage of delivery.
* Turn successful solutions into reusable data products, semantic assets, agent capabilities, and engineering accelerators.
* Start with the business decision or workflow, and co-shape outcomes, success measures, data needs, and adoption with stakeholders.
* Move from discovery to prototype to production, validating assumptions with real enterprise data and early feedback.
Measure success by business value, trusted metrics, adoption, engineering quality, and reuse. Solve immediate needs while strengthening reusable enterprise foundations.  

  

**Required Qualifications:**
----------------------------

* 8+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, AI engineering, or closely related technical roles.
* Hands-on experience with Agentic AI, LLMs, agents, RAG, and tool/API integration or orchestration.
* Experience building data-driven or AI-enabled applications using Fabric, Rayfin, or comparable frameworks.
* Experience with Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, or comparable analytical platforms, including lakehouse and warehouse patterns.
* Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience delivering production-grade data solutions.
* Experience delivering data products through bronze, silver, and gold layers, with quality controls, lineage, and clear consumption interfaces.
* Strong dimensional modelling skills, including grain, facts, dimensions, star and snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, and many-to-many patterns.
* Proven enterprise semantic modelling experience, including governed business definitions and reusable measures. Proficiency in Power BI, DAX, and performance optimization, or equivalent technologies.
* Working knowledge of exploratory analysis, statistical reasoning, feature engineering, and practical predictive methods such as forecasting, classification, or anomaly detection.
* Ability to frame hypotheses, select baselines and evaluation measures, validate results, communicate uncertainty, and work with data scientists on modelling approaches.
* Experience with orchestration, automated testing, version control, CI/CD, data quality, and operational support.
* Ability to lead technical workstreams as a hands-on senior individual contributor and mentor engineers through design and code reviews.
* Experience managing scope, estimates, dependencies, risks, releases, and operational handover, taking solutions from concept through adoption.
Clear communication with technical, business, and senior stakeholder audiences.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with dbt, Apache Airflow, Git/GitHub, and automated deployment frameworks.
* Broader Power BI and Fabric experience across OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Notebooks, Direct Lake, and application capabilities.
* Experience with AI solutions grounded in semantic models, metadata, knowledge graphs, or governed enterprise data.
* Experience with agentic frameworks, model evaluation, observability, and responsible AI practices.
* Exposure to machine-learning experimentation, feature pipelines, and operationalizing lightweight predictive solutions.
* Knowledge of governance, privacy, security, lineage, and enterprise architecture.
* Experience delivering reusable data products and platforms in Agile or iterative models.
* Experience designing data contracts and consumption interfaces that enable reuse across analytics, applications, and AI solutions.
* Experience integrating lakehouse, warehouse, and semantic assets through batch, streaming, Direct Lake, or API-based patterns, with end-to-end lineage and auditability.
* Experience optimizing dimensional and semantic models with conformed dimensions, hierarchies, bridge tables, and complex relationships.
* Experience evaluating analytical and AI-enabled solutions against suitable baselines and business-relevant measures, communicating limitations, and incorporating stakeholder feedback.
* Experience partnering with business and product stakeholders to take ambiguous needs from discovery and prototyping through production adoption and operational handover.
Experience creating reusable engineering accelerators and guiding engineers through architecture reviews, debugging, and production-readiness practices.
