title: Director- Digital Platforms and Integration
description:
**About the Team:**

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

**Job Purpose**

The Director, Digital Platforms & Integration is accountable for defining, delivering and continuously evolving the foundational digital platforms, integration capabilities and information frameworks that enable GSK's future smart manufacturing, supply chain and CMC digital ecosystem.

The role leads the strategy, execution and operational performance of the Factory Integration Layer (FIL) as a critical enterprise capability connecting manufacturing systems, laboratory platforms, engineering applications, cloud services and business processes. The position ensures that platform and integration investments create reusable, scalable and technology-agnostic capabilities that accelerate business outcomes across sites, functions and products.

The Director is accountable for the Azure Local migration strategy, establishing a modern, secure and resilient hybrid foundation for digital products, analytics, AI and industrial data solutions across the manufacturing network.

As a key leader within the CMC Acceleration Program, the role owns delivery and integration of enterprise ontologies, knowledge-management capabilities, data pipelines and information architectures that transform fragmented data into connected, contextualized and actionable knowledge. The position enables digital thread capabilities across development, technology transfer, manufacturing, quality and supply chain operations.

Working with Product Leaders, Business Process Owners, Architects, Data & AI teams, Manufacturing Technology leaders and strategic partners, the Director aligns multiple transformation initiatives while ensuring solutions remain scalable, compliant, supportable and aligned to enterprise standards.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Define and execute the strategy, roadmap and lifecycle for the Factory Integration Layer, creating a scalable digital backbone connecting manufacturing, laboratory, quality, engineering, data and enterprise platforms.
* Establish FIL as a reusable enterprise capability through standard integration patterns, event-driven services, APIs, information models and repeatable site-onboarding approaches.
* Lead Azure Local migration across relevant manufacturing and operational workloads, ensuring secure cutover, continuity, validation, resilience and sustainable product and service ownership.
* Own Digital Platforms & Integration deliverables for the CMC Acceleration Program, translating development, technology-transfer and manufacturing priorities into integrated platform outcomes.
* Lead the creation and operational adoption of enterprise ontologies, semantic models and common information definitions that connect product, process, material, equipment, recipe and manufacturing knowledge.
* Lead the team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and ensuring compliance with GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
* Integrate knowledge-management capabilities across scientific, development and manufacturing domains to improve information discoverability, reuse, traceability and knowledge continuity.
* Define platform governance, architecture guardrails, decision rights and performance measures covering adoption, reliability, throughput, latency, data quality, service effort, security and value realization.
* Scan emerging platform, integration and edge capability (vendor roadmaps, new releases), pilot the most promising and bring a ranked opportunity list into the investment forums.
* Own material delivery and operational risks, ensuring appropriate governance for cyber security, data protection, quality, validation, regulatory compliance and business continuity.
* Sponsor operational readiness for major releases and migrations, integrating support models, training, documentation, deployment, monitoring, service transition and user adoption.
* Shape strategic supplier contributions and resolve delivery, quality, commercial or capability issues affecting multiple platforms, products, sites or programs.
* Represent digital platforms, integration health, dependencies, risks and investment impacts in senior product, architecture, data, cyber and transformation governance forums.
* Build a high-performing, inclusive community of platform, integration and data professionals, strengthening engineering excellence, product ownership and continuous improvement.

**Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Life Sciences or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Professional qualifications in cloud, enterprise architecture, integration, data management, product management, agile delivery, service management or cyber security are desirable.
* Typically 15+ years of experience in enterprise technology, digital manufacturing, integration platforms, cloud technologies, data platforms or digital transformation, including leadership of complex or regulated capabilities.
* Proven accountability for enterprise-scale platform strategy, roadmap, delivery, adoption and lifecycle management with material business, operational and risk impact.
* Experience leading Factory Integration Layer, industrial integration, OT/IT convergence, edge computing or comparable manufacturing-platform capabilities.
* Experience leading Azure Local, hybrid-cloud or edge-infrastructure migration, including architecture, security, validation, cutover, operational readiness and service transition.
* Demonstrated delivery of ontologies, semantic models, knowledge graphs, knowledge-management integrations, data pipelines or digital-thread capabilities.
* Experience leading multiple Product Owners, Architects, Engineers, Data specialists or delivery workstreams and establishing clear decision rights and technical guardrails.
* Demonstrated ability to resolve strategic trade-offs across value, cost, capacity, architecture, data, cyber security, compliance and business continuity.
* Experience influencing Director and VP stakeholders and representing platform delivery in investment, architecture, data, risk and transformation forums.
* Strong experience managing cross-platform dependencies, supplier contributions, complex migrations and global release sequencing.
* Experience strengthening ways of working, coaching technical talent and building sustainable platform, integration and knowledge-management capabilities.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Enterprise architecture and systems thinking, with the ability to connect business capability, information, integration, infrastructure and service views.
* Executive communication and confidence operating in senior governance forums.
* Deep understanding of integration patterns, APIs, event streaming, industrial connectivity and contextualized data flows.
* Working knowledge of Azure Local, hybrid infrastructure, edge computing, containers and platform engineering practices.
* Knowledge of ontologies, semantic technologies, knowledge graphs, metadata and knowledge-management principles.
* Analytical judgement to balance value, risk, cost, complexity, urgency and operational impact.
* Strong organisation, traceability, documentation and decision-management discipline.
* Ability to lead global, cross-functional and supplier teams through ambiguity and complex dependencies.
* Commitment to user-centred, capability-led and technology-agnostic solutions.
* Passion for engineering excellence, responsible AI enablement, smart manufacturing and continuous improvement.

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, DevOps, Prioritization, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), Software Development, Strategy Deployment, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Team Lead - Platform Monitoring Engineer
description:

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You'll Do: Shape the Way the World Understands Data**

Teradata is building the next generation of AI-native analytics, enabling customers to deploy production-grade Generative AI systems directly where enterprise data lives. We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to play a key role in building the LLM, agent and ModelOps capabilities of Teradata’s cloud and SaaS platform, taking them from prototype to secure, observable, multi-tenant production services.

This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of LLMs, agentic systems and cloud-native engineering, and wants to work on core platform capabilities, not just application demos.

You will:

* Design and build key components of Teradata’s agentic AI platform, delivered as a secure, multi-tenant, cloud-native SaaS service.

* Design and build **agent runtimes and harnesses**: tool calling, planning, memory, context management, multi-agent orchestration, sandboxed execution and human-in-the-loop controls.

* Design, build and secure **MCP servers and clients**, and other agent and tool protocols, that expose Teradata capabilities to agents through governed, well-documented APIs.

* Integrate and serve **LLMs**, both hosted APIs and self-hosted open-weight models: model gateway, routing, caching, fallbacks, token budgets, latency and cost control.

* Build **ModelOps / LLMOps** pipelines: model, prompt and agent registries and versioning, CI/CD with evaluation gates, canary releases and rollback, and quality and drift monitoring.

* Build evaluation and observability frameworks for LLM and agent systems: offline evals, LLM-as-judge, tracing, regression suites, and quality, safety, latency and cost metrics.

* Implement AI guardrails and responsible-AI controls: prompt-injection defense, PII handling, permissions, policy enforcement and audit trails for regulated industries.

* Run AI services as SaaS on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud: tenant isolation, authentication and authorization, quotas, usage metering, SLOs, and production and on-call readiness.

* Drive scalability, performance, reliability and cost efficiency of AI workloads, using Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code.

* Where use cases call for it, apply RAG, vector search and semantic retrieval patterns, including Teradata’s vector store.

* Contribute to technical design reviews and architectural decisions; identify risks early and drive solutions for your area.

* Collaborate with product, research and platform teams to turn customer use cases into scalable features, and benchmark against cloud and open-source alternatives.
  

**Who You'll Work With: Join Forces with the Best**

You’ll collaborate with a world-class team of AI architects, ML engineers and domain experts **across India and Silicon Valley**, working together to build the next generation of enterprise AI systems.

You’ll also work cross-functionally with:

* Product managers and UX designers to craft agentic workflows that are intuitive and impactful.

* Domain specialists to ensure solutions fit real business problems in regulated industries.

* Cloud, SaaS and infrastructure teams responsible for deploying, evaluating and scaling AI workloads.

This is a rare opportunity to shape foundational AI capabilities within a global, data-driven company. This is a deeply collaborative environment where technical innovation meets real-world application, where your ideas are not only heard but implemented to shape the next generation of data interaction.

  

**Minimum Requirements**

* BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field.

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production systems, and 2+ years building LLM-based applications or platforms in production.

* Strong cloud engineering on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud: Kubernetes and containers, infrastructure-as-code (for example Terraform), and CI/CD.

* Experience building and operating SaaS services: multi-tenancy, API design, authentication and authorization (OAuth/OIDC), observability, SLOs and reliability engineering.

* Hands-on LLM experience: prompt and context engineering, function and tool calling, structured outputs, and working with both commercial and open-weight models.

* Experience designing agentic systems: planning, memory, orchestration and custom agent harnesses, plus familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain or equivalent.

* Experience with **ModelOps / LLMOps**: deploying, versioning, evaluating and monitoring models, prompts and agents in production.

* Working knowledge of methods for evaluating LLM and agent quality, safety, latency and cost.

* Proficiency in **Python** (and/or Java or Go), with experience shipping production-grade systems.

* Experience with large-scale data and performance-sensitive distributed systems.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with LLM inference and serving optimization (for example vLLM or Triton, quantization, GPU scheduling).

* Experience with fine-tuning and post-training of open-weight models (for example LoRA, preference optimization, distillation).

* Experience implementing **AI guardrails**, red-teaming and security controls for agents, such as prompt-injection defense.

* Familiarity with agent-to-agent protocols and tracing standards such as A2A and OpenTelemetry for GenAI.

* Experience with analytics platforms, data warehouses and SQL-based workloads.

#LI-PG1

We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. title: Sr AI Engineer
description:
**About the team**

Rubrik secures and accelerates the world’s AI transformation. As AI agents reshape the enterprise, Rubrik’s Enterprise AI Incubation team proves it on Rubrik itself. We're building a thinking enterprise: applications that don't just record the business but help run it. They learn from our data, act through our own agents, and improve with every decision. Fully backed by executive leadership, this team drives meaningful, large-scale enterprise transformation.

  

**About the role**

We want senior engineers who have already shipped agents that real people rely on, and who are ready to do it again at higher stakes. You will drop into the real work, redesign it around agents that carry it end to end, and ship it as the new way that part of Rubrik operates.You’ll own your agent systems end to end: understanding the workflow, designing the architecture, writing the code, deploying, and running it in production. Rather than simply querying an API, you engineer robust, production-grade infrastructure around model endpoints, integrating custom tooling, context pipelines, automated evaluations, and defensive guardrails to ensure resilience against unstructured real-world data.

You also decide whether a problem needs an agent, a simpler automation, or nothing at all, and you have explicit authority to stop or re-scope work that won’t deliver impact. You thrive in ambiguous environments with a low-ego mindset, leveraging AI coding tools as core collaborative partners in your engineering workflow.

  

**What you’ll do**

* Lead product discovery alongside Product Managers and domain experts to understand real workflows, map them out, and define clear problems, baselines, and success criteria as the foundation for building agentic solutions.
* Design, build, test, and deploy production agents, automations, and internal tools using coding agents, LLM APIs, and agent frameworks, integrated with Rubrik’s internal agent platform and business systems.
* Turn complex processes into multi-agent workflows that carry real work and make decisions: orchestrators that qualify and routes deals, workers that move orders through approval and fulfillment under business rules, agents that monitor signals and recommend actions for customer health, or coordinated agents that handle hire-to-retire steps across HR, IT, and managers with shared state and clear handoffs.
* Engineer agents for autonomy with reliability, including tool and orchestration flows, context management, caching, retries, and failure handling.
* Leverage full-stack engineering across backend services, APIs, data models, interactive screens, approval UIs, and chat interfaces as the complete medium to deliver high-ownership, user-facing agent systems.
* Apply solid software engineering practices to AI systems, treating prompts, skills, configs, and specs as versioned artifacts, with code review, tests, CI or CD, and staged rollouts.
* Implement evaluation, guardrails, and quality control: derive evals from workflow data, establish quality gates and guardrails, integrate human-in-the-loop approvals where needed, and monitor production runs to refine agents over time.
* Use measured results to decide how to evolve or retire agents, and turn successful systems into patterns and libraries that can be reused.

**Experience you’ll need (must haves)**

* Around 7 or more years of professional software engineering experience in production systems, and around 2 or more years of professional, hands-on experience building AI agents and agent powered production applications with measurable outcomes.
* Strong full stack engineering background, with a track record of designing, building, and owning services end to end, including backend APIs and integrations, data models, and user facing interfaces such as approval UIs, dashboards, or chat surfaces.
* A builder mindset: comfortable defining baselines and metrics, reporting results in business terms, working in a fast moving environment, and closing the loop by building, demoing, learning, and building again. If you like seeing improvements in hours saved, errors avoided, and teams unblocked, you will have plenty of chances to measure that here.

**Software engineering skills and best practices**

* System design: break down complex problems, design APIs and data models, reason about latency, throughput, and failure modes, and choose simple, robust architectures.
* Algorithms, data structures, access control permissions, and data provenance.
Spec driven development: turn vague requirements into clear problem statements, write or refine design docs, and use a Spec Plan Task Code* Converge flow so work is traceable from design to code, including when you use AI coding agents.
* Execution discipline: use version control, code review, automated tests, CI or CD, staged rollouts and rollbacks, logging, metrics, and tracing, and improve systems based on issues and signals from production.

**AI engineering skills and best practices**

* Build agents in code using LLM APIs, SDKs, and libraries, not just no code or low code tools, and have shipped agentic systems that real users rely on.
* Design robust agent harnesses and multi agent orchestrations: model tools and resources, manage context and state, and keep runs reliable under real world data and load.
* Establish continuous evaluation and safety mechanisms: turn production failures into test cases, gate changes on eval suite results, and enforce guardrails across agent workflows.
* Exercise clear judgment on AI fit: decide when a problem needs an agent versus a simpler automation or no build, and make tradeoffs around model choice, latency and cost, context strategy, and autonomy using data rather than intuition.

**Preferred qualifications (nice to haves)**

* Knowledge/context graphs: entities and relationships, GraphRAG, hybrid retrieval.
* Agent frameworks and runtimes: Google ADK, LangGraph, OpenAI style, cloud or container platforms.
* Backend: Python, FastAPI or similar stacks.
* Tools integration: MCP, Slack or Teams bots, REST APIs, webhooks.
* Data systems: Snowflake, Salesforce, graph stores.
* UX: conversational flows, chat surfaces, guided forms, simple dashboards for agent output.

title: ASIC Engineer, Physical Design CAD
description:
Meta's silicon engineering team is building custom infrastructure silicon to power the compute demands of AI, data center, and next-generation hardware platforms. The Infra Silicon Implementation CAD team owns the physical design flows and automation that take our designs from RTL handoff through synthesis, place and route, timing closure, and physical signoff. As a Physical Design CAD engineer, you will be responsible for building and owning the flow infrastructure used daily by PD engineers across concurrent tapeout programs. This is a high-leverage role: the automation you build directly determines how quickly a chip organization converges.  
  
  

### **ASIC Engineer, Physical Design CAD Responsibilities:**

* Develop, maintain, and own stages of the digital physical design flow — synthesis, floorplanning and design planning, placement, CTS, routing, extraction, timing ECO, and STA signoff
* Build and extend flow automation in Python and Tcl, integrated with Meta’s internal build, job-scheduling, and continuous integration infrastructure
* Partner with PD engineers and design leads to debug flow and Quality of Release (QoR) issues on active tapeout programs, and convert recurring workarounds into supported flow features
* Qualify and integrate commercial EDA tools, drive issues to resolution with vendor application-engineering teams, and manage tool version migrations across programs
* Build constraint and netlist validation capability so design-intent errors are caught in-flow rather than at sign-off
* Develop QoR tracking, metrics, and dashboards that give design teams and program leadership visibility into convergence across blocks and subsystems
* Write and maintain user-facing flow documentation and training, and support designers as part of a shared on-call rotation
* Collaborate with external design partners and foundry or ASIC vendors on flow alignment and design handoff criteria

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, and/or equivalent practical experience
* 2+ years of experience in either ASIC physical design or CAD, including hands-on work with automation, flow development, drafting methodologies, solutions, and/or hands-on work with placement, clock tree synthesis, routing, and timing closure
* Experience with digital physical design implementation on advanced process nodes, including synthesis, place and route, and timing closure
* Hands-on experience with industry physical design tools, such as Fusion Compiler, Genus, Innovus, PrimeTime, Tempus, or StarRC
* Proficiency in Tcl and Python for EDA flow development and automation
* Experience debugging flow, timing, or physical verification issues on a production tapeout
* Experience with version control and collaborative code review

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working across geographically distributed teams and with external design partners
* Experience with power integrity and EM/IR analysis, and/or physical verification and logic equivalence sign-off
* Experience with timing constraint development and validation methodology, including SDC generation and constraint checking
* Experience building or owning a production CAD or physical design flow used by multiple design teams
* Experience building data pipelines or dashboards for design metrics and QoE analysis
* Experience with compute and license capacity management for large EDA workloads
* Experience applying AI or LLM-based tooling to engineering workflows
* Experience with hierarchical design planning and block-level partitioning on large SoCs

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

**About the Role:**

GSK’s Enterprise AI team, a highly skilled applied AI group, translates the promise of AI into measurable impact across every major group at GSK — R&D, Medical, Commercial, Supply Chain, HR, Legal, Finance, and beyond. Bionic pods — AI product managers, forward deployed engineers, full-stack engineers, data engineers, and digital workers — embed directly with scientific and business teams to build AI products that change outcomes.

We are hiring a Staff, AI Product Manager (Director level equivalent role) to own a major slice of our Global Functions portfolio and act as the strategic counterpart to the engineers and digital workers in your pod, setting the forward deployed strategy they execute against. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can identify and shape high-value AI opportunities across the key areas of Global Functions - HR, Legal, Compliance, Procurement, or Finance, build the case to fund and deploy against them, and ensure FDEs are working on what matters most. You will not manage engineers; you will shape what they build in your domain and how we measure whether it worked.

**Why This Role Exists:**

Forward deployed teams are most powerful when paired with sharp opportunity selection. Enterprise AI has no separate strategy layer: the AI Product Manager sets the forward deployed strategy, and the pod executes it. This role closes that gap at this level by ensuring the engineers we deploy are working on the right things.

In this role you will be the person who:

* Owns a clear domain or capability area within the Enterprise AI opportunity portfolio.
* Identifies, sizes, and shapes the highest-value AI opportunities in that domain.
* Partners daily with forward deployed, full-stack, and data engineering leads to scope and steer engagements end-to-end.
* Builds the business and executive alignment the pod needs to land and scale.

**How This Differs from Traditional Product Management:**

This is not a traditional enterprise product role managing a source system’s roadmap, releases, and backlog. As an AI Product Manager in Enterprise AI, you:

* Build new AI products from ambiguous, unsolved business problems rather than evolving an established platform.
* Work with probabilistic systems — defining evaluations, acceptable error, and human oversight instead of fixed functional requirements.
* Help lead a bionic pod, deciding which work goes to engineers and which to digital workers, and how they hand off.
* Prototype hands on and are measured on business outcomes, not features shipped or system uptime.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Opportunity Identification & Value Sizing:**

* **Hunt for high-value AI opportunities** within your assigned domain at GSK; develop a structured pipeline of opportunities ranked by impact, feasibility, and time-to-value.
* **Quantify value rigorously.** Build credible business cases that survive finance and senior business unit scrutiny — cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, cost avoided, scientific productivity gained.
* **Develop deep domain pattern recognition** so you can spot AI-shaped problems in workflows the business itself hasn’t yet articulated.

**Strategic Prioritization & Portfolio Shaping:**

* **Shape the opportunity portfolio in your domain.** Maintain a living view of in-flight, queued, and de-prioritized opportunities, with the rationale for each decision, and feed it into the broader Enterprise AI portfolio.
* **Make trade-off recommendations.** When two business sponsors both want an FDE pod, defines the success metrics, run the analysis and recommend where engineers go.
* **Protect engineering focus.** Push back — with evidence — on opportunities that won’t move scalable outcomes.

  

**Engineering Partnership & Enablement**

* **Be the strategic counterpart to forward deployed, full-stack, and data engineering leads in your domain.** Translate ambiguous business problems into crisp problem statements, prototypes, success metrics, and decision frameworks engineers can build against.
* **Shape engagements end-to-end.** Define scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways before kick-off, then stay close as engineers execute.
* **Surface re-use and platform leverage** when a one-off solution should become a reusable capability.
* **Design the human–digital split.** Decide which tasks the pod’s digital workers own, where engineers and business users stay in the loop, and how evaluation and oversight make that safe.

**Stakeholder Alignment & Communication**

* **Operate fluently with VP-level business and scientific leaders.** Run conversations that turn fuzzy ambitions into concrete, fundable AI engagements.
* **Build sponsor coalitions** that secure data access, change-management commitment, and air cover for your engagements.
* **Communicate impact clearly** in language that connects AI work to patients, science, and enterprise outcomes.

**Measurement, Learning & Iteration**

* **Apply Enterprise AI’s value-realization framework** to every engagement in your domain and improve it with what you learn.
* **Run honest post-mortems** and feed lessons back into how your domain selects opportunities.

**Required Functional Experience:**

* 18+ years of progressive experience spanning some combination of pharma/life sciences, AI/ML product strategy, and senior product management or strategy roles in technology-led organisations.
* Demonstrated track record of identifying, scoping, prototyping, and shepherding high-value technology or AI initiatives from problem framing through funding into delivery.
* Strong working knowledge of at least one part of the pharma value chain — R&D, clinical, medical, manufacturing, commercial, or an enterprise function — including the data, decisions, and constraints inside it.
* Solid technical fluency in modern AI/ML — LLMs, agentic systems, and digital workers, ML lifecycle, data and evaluation patterns — sufficient to leverage evidence from rapid prototyping to challenge engineers, scope realistically, and avoid hype-driven choices.
* Experience operating as a senior individual contributor — leading through influence, frameworks, and quality of thinking rather than headcount.
* A product management or product-strategy heritage: discovery, opportunity sizing, roadmap shaping, prototyping, and stakeholder alignment — ideally on products whose core behaviour is AI rather than conventional software.

**Skills**

AI Platforms, AI Product Management, Generative AI, Machine Learning (ML), Production Strategy, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Roadmap, Statistical Analysis, User Needs Analysis

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Staff/Principal Robotics Validation Engineer
description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**Staff/Principal Robotics Validation Engineer**

Join AMD’s PAVS team as a Robotics Developer experience Usecases Validation Engineer where you will Validate and Execute diverse Robotics platforms, variants and customer usecases for advanced robotics systems across software, hardware, and integrated platforms. Your work will ensure safety, reliability, and performance through rigorous testing in simulation, Gazebo, Isaac sim, SIL/HIL environments, and real-world deployments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Validation Strategy & Usecases : Define Usecases and execute validation plans for robotics software stacks (perception, planning, control) and hardware subsystems.
* Validate AI frameworks and runtimes (**PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX Runtime**)
* Execute and optimize workloads on **ROCm/HIP, CUDA, OpenCL, and heterogeneous accelerators**
* Automation & Frameworks: Develop automated test suites for ROS2 nodes, navigation stack (Nav2), and fleet APIs using Python/C++, pytest, gtest/gmock.
* Simulation & Scenario Testing: Build simulation environments (Gazebo/Ignition, Isaac Sim) for warehouse layouts; author scenarios for obstacle avoidance, dynamic traffic, and multi-robot coordination.
* SIL/HIL Validation: Set up Software-in-the-Loop and Hardware-in-the-Loop rigs for AMR controllers, LiDAR emulators, and safety sensors; automate provisioning and logging.
* Sensor QA: Validate LiDAR, depth cameras, IMU, wheel encoders, and odometry accuracy under varying conditions.
* Navigation & Fleet QA: Test SLAM, localization robustness, path planning, and fleet orchestration (traffic management, task allocation, VDA5050 compliance).
* Safety & Compliance: Execute safety protocols for AMRs (emergency stop, zone monitoring, speed limits) aligned with ISO 3691-4, ISO 13849, ANSI/RIA R15.06.
* Performance & Reliability: Measure latency, throughput, and stability under high-load scenarios; validate battery management and docking behaviors.
* CI/CD Integration: Embed automated tests into pipelines for continuous validation; monitor KPIs like defect escape rate and scenario coverage.
* Leadership: Act as a strong individual contributor and mentor for robotics validation teams; collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure customer experience is prioritized.

**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years in QA/Validation, with 9+ years in robotics or AMR systems.
* Strong Python for automation and C++ for ROS2 integration.
* Hands-on experience with ROS2, Nav2 stack, colcon, and simulation tools (Gazebo/Ignition, Isaac Sim).
* Expertise in LiDAR, depth cameras, IMU, odometry, and sensor calibration.
* Familiarity with fleet management systems, traffic control, and VDA5050 protocol.
* CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Jenkins; Docker-based test environments.
* Knowledge of functional safety standards for mobile robots (ISO 3691-4, ISO 13849).

**Preferred Skills**

* Multi-robot coordination, dynamic obstacle handling, and SLAM algorithms.
* Robotics AMR safety PLCs, zone scanners, and emergency stop circuits.
* Warehouse automation workflows, WMS integration, and OPC-UA.
* Performance benchmarking, reliability testing, and telemetry dashboards.

**Success Metrics**

* Automated coverage of navigation and fleet scenarios.
* Reduction in field defect escape rate.
* Stability and reliability under multi-robot deployments.
* Compliance with safety standards and successful audits.

**Academic Credentials:**

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in **Robotics**, **Electronics**, **Mechatronics**, **Computer Science**, or a related field.

We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.*

title: Solution Builder (Technical Builder)
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**The Experience**

  

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You’ll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.

  
  

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

  
  

What You'll Actually Be Doing

* Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
* Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
* Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
* Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output
* Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
* Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
* Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
* Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
* Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.
  

  

You're Our Person If...

* Total experience of 8-12years and with latest 5+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you’d be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
* You’re fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
* You’ve been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you’d change.
* You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
* You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
* You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
* You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what’s coming next.
* You thrive in the group chat that’s building something, not just talking about it.
* You’re excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.
  

  

Even Better If...

* Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
* Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
* Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
* Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Senior AI/ML Trainer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a passionate Senior Technical Trainer with good hands-on to join our expert team. Candidate will drive knowledge adoption across customers, partners, and internal teams delivering high-impact training in AI/ML, Deep Learning, and the rapidly evolving Generative AI & Agentic AI landscape.**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct engaging in-person and virtual training sessions across a range of learner profiles
* Deliver workshops and bootcamps on AI/ML, Deep Learning, Generative AI, RAG pipelines, and Agentic AI systems and LLMOps.
* Design and develop training materials, including slide decks, hands-on labs, demo notebooks, video walkthroughs, and assessments aligned towards current industry trends and customer needs.
* Build modular, reusable learning content covering GenAI application development, RAG architectures, LLM fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and multi-agent orchestration, LLMOps.
* Integrate real-world use cases and project-based learning into every module, ensuring practical applicability.
* Work closely with internal and external Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to draft training proposals and curate content aligned with enterprise skilling goals.
* Train and mentor internal trainers and partner faculty to scale delivery across regions and formats.

**Requirements (Must- have):**

* ML and Deep learning frameworks: Scikit Learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras
* Neural network architectures: CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs, Transformers
* ML workflows: data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, and optimization
* Working knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs): GPT, Llama, Mistral, Gemini, Claude, etc.
* Prompt Engineering: zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought, and advanced prompting patterns
* RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate), embedding models, chunking strategies
* LLM Fine-tuning: LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, RLHF

Agentic AI & Frameworks:

* Building and teaching AI Agents — tool use, memory, planning, and reasoning loops
* Hands-on familiarity with at least two or more Agentic AI frameworks: LangChain/LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen (Microsoft), OpenAI Agents SDK or Anthropic Claude SDK
* Hands-on knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol), tool calling, and function calling patterns
* Hands-on knowledge of Multi-Agent system design and its nuances and LLMOps

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field or equivalent practical experience
* Demonstrated hands-on experience in AI/ML model development, GenAI application building, or data science workflows
* Proven track record of delivering technical training, workshops, or bootcamps especially in AI/ML or GenAI domains
* Experience with cloud-based AI/ML platforms (AWS Sagemaker, Azure AI Foundry, GCP Vertex AI, etc.) is highly recommended.
* Having any of professional cloud certifications is a plus
* Prior experience developing content for professional certifications or enterprise skilling programs is a plus
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences
* Strong facilitation skills - comfortable engaging beginners as well as seasoned engineers in the same session
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for real-world applicability

**Good to have:**

* Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or public learning resources (blogs, notebooks, talks)
* Experience with AI governance, responsible AI practices, or bias/safety considerations in LLMs
* Active community presence (LinkedIn, Hugging Face, GitHub, etc.)

Pay: ₹665,000.00 - ₹1,940,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: MS Teams with Enterprise Voice Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your role**  
As an Infrastructure Architect, you’ll draw upon the full breadth of your talent and experience. This is a technical leadership role, so we want you to bring your vision, knowledge, and leadership to each project. To the client, you’re the subject matter expert – consulting early, gathering inputs, understanding what they need from our solution. You define what Kyndryl can do to meet this solution. You design the best solution for the job. And finally, you’re the tech leader for implementation.
  
  
At Kyndryl we support all major cloud platforms, so you’ll get the chance to use everything you know – and then some. You’ll also become expert at knowing when and how to call on other SMEs outside your wheelhouse. Thinking your way around pre-existing limitations will grow your creativity and flexibility. You’ll learn a lot here, and if you want to work toward certifications there are plenty of opportunities. The rewards for all this are many. You’ll get to influence, create, and deliver something from start to finish. You will have the power to delight our clients.
  
  
**What you will do**

As a Microsoft Teams Administrator with Enterprise Voice skills, you will:

* Design, configure, and manage Microsoft Teams Enterprise Voice solutions, including Direct Routing, Calling Plans, and Operator Connect.
* Deploy and integrate Session Border Controllers (SBCs) with Microsoft Teams.
* Troubleshoot and resolve voice-related issues in Microsoft Teams, including call quality, routing, and interoperability with PSTN providers.
* Manage and support Microsoft Teams policies, configurations, and voice-enabled features.
* Collaborate with network and security teams to ensure compliance and optimal performance.
* Perform migrations from legacy PBX systems to Microsoft Teams.
* Work with external vendors and telecom providers to ensure seamless voice connectivity.
* Monitor Teams Voice infrastructure using analytics and reporting tools to optimize call performance.
Provide end-user support and training on Microsoft Teams Phone features.  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise:**

  

* 5+ years of experience in Microsoft Teams Voice and Telephony Solutions.
* Experience in PBX to Microsoft Teams migrations.
* Knowledge of Power Automate and Power Apps for workflow automation in Teams.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Teams Enterprise Voice, including Direct Routing, Calling Plans, and Operator Connect.
* Strong understanding of SIP, VoIP, PSTN connectivity, and SBC configurations (AudioCodes, Ribbon, etc.).
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), PowerShell scripting, and Teams Admin Center.
Knowledge of E911 compliance, call routing policies, dial plans, and number management  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience:**

  

* Microsoft 365 Certified: Teams Administrator Associate (MS-700).
* Microsoft Certified: Teams Voice Engineer (MS-721).
Session Border Controller (SBC) certifications (AudioCodes/Ribbon).  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Staff AI Engineer
description:
**Our Company:**

**What You'll Do: Shape the Way the World Understands Data**

Teradata is building the next generation of AI-native analytics, enabling customers to deploy production-grade Generative AI systems directly where enterprise data lives. We are looking for a Staff AI Engineer to play a key role in designing and building the LLM, agent and ModelOps capabilities of Teradata’s cloud and SaaS platform, taking them from prototype to secure, observable, multi-tenant production services.

This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of LLMs, agentic systems and cloud-native engineering, and wants to work on core platform capabilities, not just application demos.

You will:

* Own the architecture and technical direction of Teradata’s agentic AI platform, delivered as a secure, multi-tenant, cloud-native SaaS service.

* Design and build **agent runtimes and harnesses**: tool calling, planning, memory, context management, multi-agent orchestration, sandboxed execution and human-in-the-loop controls.

* Design, build and secure **MCP servers and clients**, and other agent and tool protocols, that expose Teradata capabilities to agents through governed, well-documented APIs.

* Integrate and serve **LLMs**, both hosted APIs and self-hosted open-weight models: model gateway, routing, caching, fallbacks, token budgets, latency and cost control.

* Build **ModelOps / LLMOps** pipelines: model, prompt and agent registries and versioning, CI/CD with evaluation gates, canary releases and rollback, and quality and drift monitoring.

* Build evaluation and observability frameworks for LLM and agent systems: offline evals, LLM-as-judge, tracing, regression suites, and quality, safety, latency and cost metrics.

* Implement AI guardrails and responsible-AI controls: prompt-injection defense, PII handling, permissions, policy enforcement and audit trails for regulated industries.

* Run AI services as SaaS on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud: tenant isolation, authentication and authorization, quotas, usage metering, SLOs, and production and on-call readiness.

* Drive scalability, performance, reliability and cost efficiency of AI workloads, using Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code.

* Where use cases call for it, apply RAG, vector search and semantic retrieval patterns, including Teradata’s vector store.

* Lead technical design reviews and influence cross-team architectural decisions; identify risks early and drive solutions.

* Collaborate with product, research and platform teams to turn customer use cases into scalable features, and benchmark against cloud and open-source alternatives.
  

**Who You'll Work With: Join Forces with the Best**

You’ll collaborate with a world-class team of AI architects, ML engineers and domain experts **across India and Silicon Valley**, working together to build the next generation of enterprise AI systems.

You’ll also work cross-functionally with:

* Product managers and UX designers to craft agentic workflows that are intuitive and impactful.

* Domain specialists to ensure solutions fit real business problems in regulated industries.

* Cloud, SaaS and infrastructure teams responsible for deploying, evaluating and scaling AI workloads.

**How we work at Philips**  
Our newly-adopted hybrid work concept fuses flexibility with collaboration to deliver great outcomes for our people and our customers. Hybrid work flexibility means people can meet the changing demands of work and home in the most balanced, productive, and healthy way.

Our hybrid working model is defined in 3 ways:
  
*We believe in the importance of impactful collaboration:* There's a certain energy when everyone’s in the same room that can heighten idea generation and creative friction needed for problem-solving.
  
*We embrace flexibility:* Choosing where, when and how to work can vary according to task and team schedules. Flexibility isn’t office or online, it means choosing the space that works best for you, your teams and our customers on a case-by-case basis.
  
*We want to be at our best:* The way we work and our workspaces are designed to support our well-being, offer career advancement opportunities, and enable us to be at our best.

  

**Why should you join Philips?**  
Working at Philips is more than a job. It’s a calling to create a healthier society through meaningful work, focused on innovative, customer-first health technology solutions. Help us improve the health and well-being of billions of people, every year. Ultimately creating a career that no one could have planned for. Even you.

title: Dist Engr-AI Science
description:
### **When you join Verizon**

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

We are seeking a visionary **Distinguished Engineer, AI Science** to lead the technical strategy, research, and development of our next-generation AI architecture focused on Customer Base Management (CVM). As a Distinguished Engineer, you will be the foremost technical authority in the organization, driving the evolution from traditional machine learning to advanced Agentic, Predictive, and Prescriptive AI systems.

You will design autonomous, AI-driven engines that maximize the lifetime value of our customer base, architecting systems that not only predict customer behavior but prescribe dynamic, real-time interventions and execute them autonomously via multi-agent frameworks.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Visionary Technical Leadership & AI Strategy**

* Serve as the chief technical architect and visionary for all AI science initiatives related to Base Management, Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV), churn mitigation, and cross-sell/upsell monetization.
* Define the multi-year roadmap for integrating Agentic AI (autonomous agents, LLM-driven decision engines) into our core base management platforms.
* Bridge the gap between foundational AI research and enterprise-scale commercial impact, advising C-level executives on AI investments and technology bets.

**2. Advanced AI Modeling & Agentic Architecture**

* **Agentic AI:** Architect multi-agent systems and LLM-backed autonomous pipelines capable of executing complex customer lifecycle interventions without human-in-the-loop dependencies.
* **Predictive AI:** Oversee the development of state-of-the-art predictive models (deep learning, sequence modeling, probabilistic models) for extreme-accuracy forecasting of churn, propensity, and customer lifecycle events.
* **Prescriptive AI:** Design large-scale optimization and reinforcement learning (RL) engines that determine the "Next Best Action" (NBA), Next Best Offer (NBO), and dynamic pricing strategies in real-time.
* Pioneer the use of Generative AI for hyper-personalized base communication, ensuring safety, compliance, and brand alignment within agentic workflows.

**3. Base Management Innovation**

* Transform traditional Customer Value Management (CVM) into a continuous, real-time, AI-native discipline.
* Develop scalable algorithms for causal inference and uplift modeling to ensure AI interventions generate true incremental value (A/B testing at scale).
* Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, and Operations leaders to deploy AI solutions that fundamentally alter the economics of customer retention and growth.

**4. Mentorship & Eminence**

* Act as a technical mentor and sponsor for Principal Scientists, Senior Machine Learning Engineers, and Data Scientists across the organization.
* Drive a culture of engineering and scientific excellence, establishing rigorous standards for model validation, MLOps, AI safety, and ethical AI.
* Represent the company in the broader AI community through conference presentations, whitepapers, open-source contributions, and patent filings.

### **Required Qualifications**

* **Education:** Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or a closely related highly quantitative field.
* **Experience:** 12+ years of applied R&D experience in AI/ML, with at least 5+ years in a senior technical leadership role (Principal Engineer, Chief Scientist, or equivalent).
* **Domain Expertise:** Deep understanding of Base Management, Customer Value Management (CVM), algorithmic marketing, and lifecycle optimization.
* **Technical Mastery:**Expertise in **Predictive AI** (Deep Learning, NLP, Time-Series forecasting, Graph Neural Networks).Expertise in **Prescriptive AI** (Reinforcement Learning, Contextual Bandits, Mathematical Optimization, Operations Research).Cutting-edge knowledge of **Agentic AI** (LLMs, LangChain/LlamaIndex, multi-agent frameworks like AutoGen, tool-augmented language models).
* **Engineering Prowess:** Proven track record of architecting and deploying ultra-low latency, high-throughput AI systems into production. Fluency in Python, C++, or similar, and deep familiarity with scalable cloud architectures (AWS/GCP/Azure) and MLOps platforms.
* **Impact:** Demonstrable history of driving hundreds of millions of dollars in enterprise value through the application of AI to customer bases.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Recognized industry eminence (e.g., highly cited publications at NeurIPS, ICML, KDD, ACL, or strong portfolio of impactful patents).
* Experience transitioning legacy rule-based business logic systems into fully autonomous RL or Agentic AI decision engines.
* Deep expertise in Causal ML and Double Machine Learning for uplift modeling.

### **Where you’ll be working**

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

### **Scheduled Weekly Hours**

40

### **Equal Employment Opportunity**

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: threat detection engineer
description:
**what is CRED?**

CRED is an exclusive community for India’s most trustworthy and CREDitworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. CRED was born out of a need to bring back the focus on a long lost virtue, one of trust, the idea being to create a community centered around this virtue. a community that constantly strives to become more virtuous in this regard till they finally scale their behavior to create a utopia where being trustworthy is the norm and not the exception. to build a community like this requires a community of its own; a community special in its own way, working towards making this vision come true

here’s a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better

### **what you will do ?**

* work across a diverse information security domain, with a strong focus on threat detection, response, and security telemetry across infrastructure, cloud, and data
* identify and investigate security threats (internal and external), partner with stakeholders on remediation, and design preventive controls for recurring or systemic issues
* design, build, and continuously improve high-fidelity detection use cases across cloud, endpoint, identity, and network telemetry
* formulate new detection ideas based on adversary research, emerging attack techniques, industry incidents, and threat intelligence
* lead and participate in incident response, performing root-cause analysis and driving preventive improvements post-incident
* develop and enhance the CRED’s detection, monitoring and response capabilities
* automate incident response workflows using playbooks and orchestration to reduce manual effort
* build in-house security analytics solutions using open source tools (log parsing, event correlation and threat detection)research/conduct threat hunting operations using known adversary tactics, techniques and procedures to detect advanced threats
* assist with creating security awareness and maintaining prudent security engineering culture within an organization
* enable compliance in teams and help them achieve some of the industry’s best practices (e.g. PCI DSS, ISO 27001)

### **you should apply if you have:**

* 2 to 6 years of experience in information security with a strong focus on threat detection and response
* hands-on experience detecting and responding to threats across cloud (aws preferred), endpoint (windows/linux/macOS), and network telemetry
* exposure to EDR, IDS/IPS, and SIEM / centralized logging platforms (splunk, ELK, sentinel, or similar), including building high-fidelity detection pipelines
* proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (python, go, or bash)
* solid understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, cyber kill chain, and diamond model
* ability to design and tune detection rules using MITRE ATT&CK and threat intelligence with a focus on signal quality
* experience with threat hunting, automation and enrichment, regex creation, and false-positive reduction
* experience handling the complete incident response lifecycle, from detection through remediation and reporting
* strong data-driven mindset with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* ability to act as a go-to person, communicating clearly with engineering, product, and business teams
* proactive approach to staying current with security news, breach reports, tools, and attacker research
* strong learning agility and passion for exploring diverse security domains, demonstrated via github, blogs, research, or talks
* exposure to the AI-driven threat landscape, digital forensics, or malware analysis is a strong plus

**how is life at CRED?**

working at CRED would instantly make you realize one thing: you are working with the best talent around you. not just in the role you occupy, but everywhere you go. talk to someone around you; most likely you will be talking to a singer, standup comic, artist, writer, an athlete, maybe a magician. at CRED people always have talent up their sleeves. with the right company, even conversations can be rejuvenating. at CRED, we guarantee a good company.

hard truths: pushing oneself comes with the role. and we realize pushing oneself is hard work. which is why CRED is in the continuous process of building an environment that helps the team rejuvenate oneself: included but not limited to a stacked, in-house pantry, with lunch and dinner provided for all the team members, paid sick leaves and a comprehensive health insurance.

to make things smoother and to make sure you spend time and energy only on the most important things, CRED strives to make every process transparent: there are no work timings because we do not believe in archaic methods of calculating productivity, your work should speak for you. there are no job designations because you will be expected to hold down roles that cannot be described in one word.

since trust is a major virtue in the community we have built, we make it a point to highlight it in the community behind CRED: all our employees get their salaries before their joining date. a show of trust that speaks volumes because of the skin in the game.

there are many more such eccentricities that make CRED what it is but that’s for one to discover. if you feel at home reading this, get in touch.
