description:
**Role description**

**Role Overview**  
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Automation Engineer to take ownership of our automation ecosystem. The ideal candidate will design robust test strategies and spearhead the integration of AI-driven workflows to accelerate development, improve code quality, and increase the velocity of our CI/CD pipelines. You will serve as a force multiplier for the team, balancing deep technical execution with the architectural oversight of AI-assisted development.  
Success Metrics  
Success in this role will be defined by a measurable reduction in software delivery cycle time and a consistent increase in automated test coverage across our core services, ultimately enhancing the reliability and release velocity of the product.

**Required Experience:**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in automation engineering.

* **AI Agent Tooling:** Proven, hands-on experience utilizing AI agents such as Devin and Codex to accelerate code generation, complex refactoring, and automated debugging cycles.

* Proven expertise in web service/API automation and white-box testing.

* Demonstrated ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

**Technical Skills:**

* **Languages:** Strong proficiency in Java and Groovy.

* **Frameworks:** Playwright (preferred) or Selenium; TestNG.

* **CI/CD & DevOps:** Deep familiarity with Jenkins, Maven, and Git.

* **Cloud:** Experience with AWS or Azure.

* **OS:** Proficient in Linux-based environments.

**Key Competencies:**

* **Analytical Rigor:** Excellent debugging skills for complex system issues.

* **Time Management:** Ability to prioritize effectively to "automate at the speed of development."

* **Proactive Learning:** A commitment to staying at the forefront of emerging tools and technologies.

* **Communication:** Clear, concise communication to explain complex automation strategies to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **1. AI-Driven Engineering & Innovation**

* **AI Collaboration:** Partner with AI coding agents to accelerate test development by translating requirements into scaffolded code, navigating complex codebases, and iterating through rapid debug cycles.

* **AI Governance:** Author and maintain "AI Skill Guides" that define codebase conventions, reusable utility libraries, and established framework patterns for AI agents to follow.

* **Quality Oversight:** Review all AI-generated code for correctness, domain accuracy, and architectural alignment with existing systems.

* **Domain Expertise:** Leverage AI for boilerplate generation and iterative debugging, providing the critical human context, design decisions, and risk assessments that models cannot infer independently.

* **Impact Reporting:** Audit and refine AI-generated impact reports and test cases, ensuring comprehensive coverage and challenging risk ratings where necessary.

* **Strategic Mindset:** Utilize AI as a force multiplier, ensuring it remains an accelerator for high-quality outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering judgment.

#### **2. Automation Development & Strategy**

* Develop and maintain scalable automation frameworks for web service/API testing and non-UI systems.

* Author, execute, and evolve manual test plans into robust, reusable automated test suites.

* Build custom internal tools to bridge gaps in DevOps processes and optimize development pipelines.

#### **3. Testing, Debugging, & Performance**

* Own features end-to-end; identify and resolve failures stemming from coding errors, environment instability, or application bugs.

* Execute performance testing initiatives using tools such as Apache JMeter or LoadRunner to ensure system resilience.

* Maintain accurate test reporting, including coverage metrics, pass/fail trends, and defect analysis.

#### **4. Cloud, CI/CD, & Collaboration**

* Deploy and test applications in cloud environments (AWS/Azure) with a focus on automated infrastructure.

* Manage and support CI/CD environments (Jenkins) to ensure reliable, high-speed build-to-deployment cycles.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Development, QA, DevOps) to align automation efforts with the broader product lifecycle.

 **Skills**

**Mandatory Skills :** Playwright Python Testing  
**Good to Have Skills :** Python Data Automation Testing, Selenium-Python -Testing

 **About LTM**  
LTM is an AI-centric global technology services company and the Business Creativity partner to the world’s largest and most disruptive enterprises. We bring human insights and intelligent systems together to help clients create greater value at the intersection of technology and domain expertise. Our capabilities span integrated operations, transformation, and business AI — enabling new ways of working, new productivity paradigms, and new roads to value. Together with over 87,000 employees across 40 countries and our global network of partners, LTM — a Larsen & Toubro company — owns business outcomes for our clients, helping them not just outperform the market, but to Outcreate it. Please also note that neither LTM nor any of its authorized recruitment agencies/partners charge any candidate registration fee or any other fees from talent (candidates) towards appearing for an interview or securing employment/internship. Candidates shall be solely responsible for verifying the credentials of any agency/consultant that claims to be working with LTM for recruitment. title: Technical Consultant – Power BI Tenant Migration
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

As a Power BI Migration Engineer, you will execute runbooks to move Power BI artefacts and operational configurations between tenants, validating outcomes and resolving standard errors with playbooks. You will support wave execution, perform post‑migration checks (access, refresh behaviour, workspace settings) and maintain disciplined evidence capture and ticket updates. You will be part of a 24x7 factory team and measured on throughput, quality and the ability to resolve defects quickly and cleanly.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Execute migration runbooks for assigned Power BI scope: workspace artefacts, access remapping tasks, post‑migration validation checks.
* Run validation for reports/datasets and complete functional smoke tests; document findings and attach evidence.
* Support refresh and gateway reconfiguration steps where in scope; validate connectivity and scheduled refresh behaviour.
* Resolve standard defects using playbooks; escalate appropriately with complete diagnostics.
* Maintain high‑quality ticket hygiene and evidence capture per wave.
* Participate in shift handovers and ensure work can be continued seamlessly.
* Support reporting: throughput counts, defect categories, recurring issues.
* Provide hypercare support post‑cutover, resolving incidents and contributing to runbook improvements.

  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Minimum exp- 7 years
* Hands-on experience in Power BI tenant-to-tenant migration execution in production.
* Strong working knowledge of Power BI Service, including workspaces, permissions, datasets, reports, and operational issues.
* Experience executing repeatable migration runbooks with strict evidence capture and closure standards.
* Experience with post-migration validation and resolving access, refresh, and missing dependency issues.
* Experience working in shift-based environments with formal handovers and queue/backlog management.
* Strong documentation skills for tickets, handovers, and escalations.
* Ability to work under time-sensitive cutover pressure while maintaining quality and compliance.
* Strong communication, collaboration, risk identification, and escalation skills.
Willingness to work in a three-shift 24x7 Factory model.  

  

**Preferred Skills**

* PL-300 certification or equivalent.
* Experience with third-party Power BI tenant migration tools.
* Knowledge of Power BI data source connectivity, gateways, and operational monitoring.
* Experience supporting enterprise cutovers and hypercare models.
Experience improving shared migration runbooks and operational playbooks.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior Business Operations Specialist
description:
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

**Overview:**

  
  

As a leading global aerospace company, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. As a top U.S. exporter, the company leverages the talents of a global supplier base to advance economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. Boeing’s team is committed to innovating for the future, leading with sustainability, and cultivating a culture based on the company’s core values of safety, quality and integrity.

  
  

**Technology for today and tomorrow:**

  
  

The Boeing India Engineering & Technology Center (BIETC) is a 5500+ engineering workforce that contributes to global aerospace growth. Our engineers deliver cutting-edge R&D, innovation, and high-quality engineering work in global markets, and leverage new-age technologies such as AI/ML, IIoT, Cloud, Model-Based Engineering, and Additive Manufacturing, shaping the future of aerospace.

People-driven culture

  
  

At Boeing, we believe creativity and innovation thrives when every employee is trusted, empowered, and has the flexibility to choose, grow, learn, and explore. We offer variable arrangements depending upon business and customer needs, and professional pursuits that offer greater flexibility in the way our people work. We also believe that collaboration, frequent team engagements, and face-to-face meetings bring together different perspectives and thoughts – enabling every voice to be heard and every perspective to be respected. No matter where or how our teammates work, we are committed to positively shaping people’s careers and being thoughtful about employee wellbeing.

  
  

With us, you can create and contribute to what matters most in your career, community, country, and world. Join us in powering the progress of global aerospace.

  
  

The **BGES (Boeing Global Enterprise Services) Business Operations Specialist** will be responsible to support the Global Workplace Strategy & Operations team by driving operational excellence, enabling safe and efficient workplace services, and ensuring consistent execution of business processes across India region. The role is a key connector between cross‑functional partners, site operations, sustainability programs, and all leadership initiatives.

  
  

The **Business Operations Specialist** , will assist in the development and integration of programs, plans, strategies and processes to meet business goals such as sourcing strategy, cost imperatives, deployment analysis and impact mitigation. Will coordinate with various teams and leads to collect data, analyze the data and support development of business cases and performance analytics to meet long range business goals. Coordinates the commitments with internal and external organizations to fulfill strategies where BGES plays either a supporting or leading role. Identifies risk and opportunity potential, develops mitigation planning and refines the business case. Collects, organizes and provides data according to established processes within the management system to maintain status of programs, customer and supplier commitments and compliance. Ensures follow up action for issue resolution. Provides coaching and guidance to less experienced personnel.

  
  

**Position Responsibilities:**

  
  

**1. Operational Excellence & Process Improvement**

* Support implementation of the BGES Operating Model focused on *cost‑effective operations, people & leadership, and service excellence*
* Program manages the operational excellence projects for the region
* Coordinate PMBP/CI workshops, problem‑solving sessions, and performance reviews as and when applicable
  

  

**2. Business Performance & Governance**

* Maintain Tiered scorecards, operational dashboards, and service performance metrics associated with BGES service delivery and governance routines.
* Responsible and accountable for global reporting
* Assist in value engineering initiatives and cost‑driver analysis to meet BGES Enterprise Operational Excellence (EOE) priorities.
* Track risks, mitigation plans, and project actions for site and enterprise programs (as seen in BGES India project governance templates).
  

  

**3. Cross‑Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with HR, Finance, GREF, PMCM, IT Ops, ISC, Ethics, GSA, and business units to ensure aligned service delivery and project execution.
* Responsible to manage the operating rhythms for the region and cross functional governance including tier 5 reporting
* Support stakeholder communication and engagement across regions and service lines
  

  

**4. Program & Project Support**

* Assist with planning, tracking, and reporting for operational programs, transition plans, walkthroughs, and readiness activities across Boeing sites.
* Coordinate cross‑regional efforts including sustainability initiatives, energy‑tracking activities, Green Team engagement, and compliance reporting (EED, MEES, renewable energy milestones).
  

  

**5. Workplace Strategy & Site Operations Support**

* Provide structured business support for day‑to‑day site operational needs including onboarding, services coordination, and vendor alignment.
* Contribute to global workplace strategy execution by capturing requirements, supporting major projects, and ensuring alignment to business priorities.
* Works with the manager to develop people engagement plans
  

  

**6. Communication & Reporting**

* Prepare leadership updates, governance decks, and operational summaries for monthly BGES councils and governance meetings such as:
* Provide structured communication to stakeholders during transitions, audits, readiness reviews, and implementation cycles.
  

  

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**

* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills; ability to interpret operational and financial data.
* Experience in Lean, Kaizen, PMBP, or continuous improvement tools (preferred).
* Excellent cross‑functional communication and stakeholder management.
* Ability to work in a fast‑paced, multi‑region operational environment.
* High proficiency in MS365 tools (Excel, Power BI, SharePoint, PowerPoint).
* Understanding of workplace services, facilities operations, or sustainability programs is a plus.
* Knowledge of management of ServiceNow working with IT development teams

**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):**

  
  

* **Builds Positive Relationships**

Develops and uses collaborative relationships within and outside the organization to facilitate the accomplishment of work goals. Builds rapport and trust among stakeholders and leverages the organization's dynamics to promote program goals by focusing on a shared vision.

  
  

* **Business Acumen**

Knowledgeable of how the business and organization operates; knowledgeable of policies, practices, trends, and information affecting the business and organization; understands the competition and the marketplace. Understands how to accomplish tasks through formal channels and informal network; understands the cultures of organizations. Applies this information in a way that contributes to the organizations strategic plan and bottom line.

  
  

* **Digital Literacy**

Initiates process improvements that are enabled and supported by technology. Understands that technology and process functionality has an interconnected relationship and that each helps transform the other.

  
  

* **Global Perspective**

Develops and incorporates an understanding of the competitive global business environment as well as an awareness of economic, social, and political trends that impact the organization's global strategy

  
  

* **Project Management**

The ability to achieve desired outcomes on projects, on-time and within budget. Ability to define the project, design and plan the project, and manage the project team. Ability to control and deliver project deliverables, project accounting and appraisal, and optimize the contribution of the people involved.

**Technical Competencies**

  
  

* **Systems Thinking**

Ability to understand the big picture and the inter-relationships of all positions and activities in the system, including the impact of changes in one area on another area. This includes the ability to see and understand the inter-relationships between components of systems and plans, anticipate future events, and apply the principles of systems thinking to accelerate performance.

  
  

* Postgraduate from a grade A business school
* Lean six sigma practioner (will be added advantage)
* Change mgmt. specialist (will be added advantage)
* MCR from CoreNet Global US
* Operational Excellence practitioner
  

  

**Typical Education & Experience:**

  

**E**ducation/experience typically acquired through advanced education (e.g. Bachelor) and typically 10 or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience (e.g. Master+8 years' related work experience, 14 years' related work experience, etc.).

  
  

**Relocation:**

This position does offer relocation within INDIA.

  
  
  

Applications for this position will be accepted until **Oct. 29, 2026**

  
  

**Export Control Requirements:**

This is not an Export Control position.

**Relocation**

This position offers relocation based on candidate eligibility.

**Visa Sponsorship**

Employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status.

**Shift**

Not a Shift Worker (India)

  
  

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not accept unlawful discrimination in our recruitment or employment practices on any grounds including but not limited to; race, color, ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military and veteran status, or other characteristics covered by applicable law.

We have teams in more than 65 countries, and each person plays a role in helping us become one of the world’s most innovative, diverse and inclusive companies. We are proud members of the Valuable 500 and welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. Applicants are encouraged to share with our recruitment team any accommodations required during the recruitment process. Accommodations may include but are not limited to: conducting interviews in accessible locations that accommodate mobility needs, encouraging candidates to bring and use any existing assistive technology such as screen readers and offering flexible interview formats such as virtual or phone interviews.

  

**Your Benefits**
-----------------

No matter where you are in life, our benefits help prepare you for the present and the future.

* Competitive base pay and incentive programs.

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Forward Deployed AI Engineer
  
JLL | Full-Time
  
About the Role
  
**JLL is rolling out AI agents directly into the business:** automating workflows, supporting decision-making, and integrating with the systems that run them.
  
You will own your assigned business area as a one-person engineering team. The Center of Excellence in our central AI team gives you the methodology, the platform, and the patterns; the business gives you the problems, the SMEs, and the appetite for change. Your job is to turn that into shipped agents and MCP integrations, then hand mature work off to platform and operations as it stabilizes.
  
We expect engineers at this level to operate with AI tools as a primary part of their workflow. Your leverage comes from the hooks, skills, workflows, and automations you install to ship safely to production. The leverage in this role is AI, not headcount.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
Build and ship agents for the business, in close partnership with business SMEs and operators.
  
**Stand up MCP servers and connectors:** pre-production first, then through CDR into production.
  
Bootstrap skills, integrations, and evals on top of JLL's AI platform (LLM gateway, shared RAG services, MCP toolchain).
  
Run workshops with business teams, teach them to use Claude Code, and translate their workflows into agent skills.
  
Hand mature systems off to platform and operations teams once they outgrow the bootstrap phase.
  
Feed patterns, anti-patterns, and platform gaps back into the Center of Excellence so the next FDE moves faster.
  
  
Must Have Experience
  
Shipped production agents using Claude Agent SDK, MCP, or an equivalent stack.
  
Production code in at least one of Python, Node, or .NET, with comfort moving across the others.
  
**Worked with diverse data stores:** relational, NoSQL, object/blob, vector, and document.
  
**Operated end-to-end as a one-person team:** design, ship, support, hand off.
  
  
Traits
  
Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable in the room with non-engineers.
  
Pragmatic judgment on when to ship, when to harden, and when to hand off.
  
Systems thinking with a focus on failure modes; AI writes most of the code, you own it.
  
Comfort with tasking and ability to run multiple agents in parallel as part of daily workflow.
  
  
Why This Role
  
JLL. A Fortune 200 company and a global leader in commercial real estate, with the stability of a $20B+ business and the resources to invest seriously in AI.
  
The team. You sit at the seam of the business, product, and engineering, with a direct line into JLL's central AI platform via the Center of Excellence. The work is visible from business leadership on down.
  
**The role. The highest-leverage seat in the company:** you ship things real users feel within weeks, not quarters, and the systems you bootstrap become the agents thousands of JLL employees rely on every day.
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
At JLL, we harness the power of artificial intelligence (AI) to efficiently accelerate meaningful connections between candidates and opportunities. Using AI capabilities, we analyze your application for relevant skills, experiences, and qualifications to generate valuable insights about how your unique profile aligns with the specific requirements of the role you're pursuing.
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Sr Staff Engineer - AI Engineering
description:
GE Vernova is embracing cutting-edge technologies to streamline operations, improve customer experiences, and drive growth. As part of this vision, we are building a dedicated team to leverage Generative AI and redefine how we engage with our industry. The ultimate goal of the team is to automate prompting, develop a framework for prompting across use cases to maximize reuse as well as sharing across businesses.We are seeking a highly motivated and talented AI Engineer to join our dynamic team. The successful candidate will be responsible for creating and optimizing prompts for LLMs, collaborating with domain experts and end users to develop software solutions that address both internal and external needs. This position offers a great opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced technology and traditional industry, making a tangible impact on our business processes.

**Job Description**
===================

Collaborate with domain experts to understand business needs and translate them into clear and effective LLM prompts.

* Develop, test, and refine prompts for a variety of use cases, ensuring high accuracy and relevance in generated outputs.
* Work closely with software developers to integrate LLM solutions into existing or new applications.
* Contribute to the development of a scalable framework for prompt engineering, promoting reuse and knowledge sharing across different business units.
* Assist in gathering and analyzing user feedback to continually improve prompt effectiveness.
* Stay up-to-date with advancements in LLM technology and contribute to strategic decisions on tool and platform selection.
Document prompt engineering processes, best practices, and use case outcomes to build a comprehensive knowledge base.  

**Qualifications/Requirements:**

* **Master's/ PhD degree** in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field with **10+ years' relevant experience.**
* Experience with prompt engineering and familiarity with tools such as OpenAI’s GPT models, Hugging Face, etc.
* Proficiency in Python or other programming languages commonly used in AI/ML development.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and adapt to changing project requirements.
Candidate must be willing to travel a minimum of 2 weeks per year  

**Ideal Candidate Characteristics:**

* PhD or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI Engineering, or related field
* Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch) and data processing libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy).
* Previous experience or internships involving NLP or machine learning projects.
* Familiarity with version control systems like Git.
* Understanding of traditional industry operations and challenges.

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: Digital CX Tech Specialist
description:
**About the Role**

  

The Digital CX Technology Analyst prepares and manages the data, systems and processes that power our digital customer success strategy. The role identifies, collects and prepares data, primarily from Snowflake, and enables its effective use across Gainsight CS, Gainsight PX and Journey Orchestrator. Working closely with functional leaders, the analyst supports projects spanning planning, reporting, goal setting, customer health, business process optimisation and the operational metrics required to scale Customer Success. The role owns platform data integrity, helps design business rules that analyse customer data and trigger digital customer success actions, and contributes to a scalable customer lifecycle from onboarding through renewal. This is a cross-functional role partnering with Customer Success Operations, Sales Operations, Corporate Technology Data Enablement and Sales Technology, Marketing, Product, Support, Sales Strategy and Execution, and other teams to ensure technology initiatives are prioritised against Customer Success objectives. It combines solution design with hands-on work across backend data systems and customer-facing journey orchestration, and provides development towards a solution architecture career path.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Develop and maintain the roadmap of systems, tools and data capabilities needed to support Customer Success, including resource planning, project management, customer health tracking and operational business metrics.

* Identify opportunities to improve Customer Success effectiveness, efficiency, scalability and financial performance, and translate those opportunities into practical technology and process improvements.

* Own platform data integrity and coordinate the sources, metrics, frequency and level of data required for digital customer success use cases.

* Identify, extract, transform and prepare data, primarily from Snowflake, so it can be used effectively within Gainsight CS, Gainsight PX and Journey Orchestrator.

* Configure and deploy Gainsight and Salesforce capabilities for internal users, including system configuration, integrations, reports, dashboards, workflows and business rules.

* Design and manage rules that analyse customer data and trigger scalable digital programmes across the customer lifecycle, from onboarding through adoption, health management and renewal.

* Partner with Sales Operations and Customer Success Operations to establish and maintain role-based metrics and insights, including customer health indicators, renewal performance, territory and account planning, organisational performance, customer lifecycle measures and Voice of Customer feedback.

* Enable colleagues to use customer data effectively within Gainsight, particularly through Journey Orchestrator, and prepare Customer Success teams for new processes, tools and functionality.

* Coordinate delivery of Customer Success enablement programmes, tools and processes, clearly communicating priorities, activities, dependencies and outcomes to stakeholders.

* Establish practical processes that help CSMs work effectively with cross-functional teams, including onboarding plans that bring new CSMs up to speed efficiently.

* Translate data into scalable customer journeys and product messaging, balancing technical design, customer experience and operational requirements.

* Structure data and solutions in an efficient, lean and cost-conscious way so digital journeys can scale across Data & Analytics and Risk Intelligence product suites.

* Recommend and support adoption of best practices and standardised procedures that improve consistency and reduce manual effort.

* Provide second-line platform support and coordinate issue resolution with Gainsight Support, the Gainsight Technical Account Manager and Corporate Technology partners.

Manage multiple strategic and operational projects in a fast-paced environment, adapting priorities as business needs evolve and supporting the team’s ambition to operate natively with AI.  

  

**Qualifications and Experience**

  

* Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.

* Experience in a SaaS or recurring-revenue business, ideally within Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations or a related operational function.

* Hands-on Gainsight administration experience, including Gainsight CS and Gainsight PX, with experience maintaining a Gainsight and Salesforce Customer Success platform model.

* Gainsight Administration certification required; Salesforce Administration certification preferred.

* Experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse, including extracting and preparing data for downstream use.

* Strong SQL skills and experience working across backend data systems, integrations, reports, dashboards and workflows.

* Experience with Journey Orchestrator or a similar journey or workflow orchestration tool.

* Strong data analysis, reporting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn business requirements into scalable technology solutions.

* Demonstrated ability to understand and meet internal or external customer needs.

* Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple and competing priorities.

* Sound business judgement, with the ability to see the bigger picture, prioritise effectively and act in an environment of change and ambiguity.

* Comfort working with high-performing teams in an indirect and matrixed capacity, taking initiative and maintaining disciplined execution.

Interest in solution architecture and in designing data and technology structures for long-term scalability, not only immediate delivery needs.  

  

**Working at LSEG**

  

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

title: Software Development Engineer 1
description:
**About the Team & Role**

Team builds the infrastructure that keeps commercial drivers and fleets moving from fuel payments at the pump to the apps and backend services that power authorizations, loyalty, and real-time transaction data. As an SDE I, you'll join one of two full-stack engineering teams within WEX's Mobility organization.

  
  

Both teams own their systems end to end. The 10-4 (OTR) team builds the over-the-road platform customer-facing APIs, event-driven microservices (Java/Spring Boot, Python), Kafka-based async

processing, payment and identity integrations (Fiserv, Okta), and the Android and iOS apps that drivers use in the field. The NA Mobility Platform team builds and owns the shared frontend infrastructure that product teams across the organization depend on Angular micro-frontends with NestJS BFFs, Module Federation, a shared component library (Theseus UI), brand theming, and app scaffolding via Theseus Builder. In both cases, you'll work across layers of a real production stack, ship to real users, and be supported by engineers who care about doing the work well. We value clean APIs, strong testing habits, and engineers who improve the systems they touch. You'll work closely with the product, other OTR teams, and your peers on features from design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.

  
  

**How You'll Make an Impact**

* Build specific components within an established architecture.
* You'll follow the patterns your team has set, whether that's microservices, event-driven design, or component-based frontend, and implement features correctly within those structures rather than redefining them.
* Write clean, compilable code with unit tests that meet the team's quality standards.
* Before you start building, you'll ask the right questions about acceptance criteria and error states so you're solving the right problem, not just writing code.
* Identify and fix bugs in well-defined tasks.
* You'll reproduce issues, pinpoint where in the code they're happening, and work with senior engineers to land the right fix rather than just patching the symptom.
* Handle low-priority support tickets as a first responder and participate in on-call rotations under supervision.
* During incidents, you'll run specific checks and scripts as directed, building your confidence with live systems gradually and safely.
* Contribute to basic observability by adding error and info logging that helps the team debug issues.
* You won't be expected to triage complex production problems alone, but your logs should make it easier for others to do so.
* Keep the team's process running smoothly. That means updating Jira daily, following the
* Definition of Done, moving tickets through the right stages, and raising a flag immediately if something is at risk.
* You don't deviate from the team's agreed process without checking first.
* Show up fully in team rituals like standups, backlog grooming, and demos.
* You'll listen to stakeholder feedback during demos to understand how your work actually lands with users, not just whether it passed the acceptance criteria.
* Use AI tools like Cursor or similar to reduce boilerplate, get unstuck faster, and understand error messages more quickly. You own the quality of everything you ship though, which means validating AI-generated output rather than passing it through unchecked.
* Update documentation when you find something inaccurate or missing. Good documentation is part of the job, and you'll be expected to keep it honest as you learn the system.
  

  

**Experience You'll Bring**

* You have a solid grounding in data structures, algorithms, and software design from a B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science from a reputed institution, with 0 to 1 year of professional experience.
* You're comfortable writing clean, compilable, tested code in at least one of Java, Python, or TypeScript/JavaScript, and you understand what makes code maintainable, not just functional.
* You understand the testing pyramid and have written unit tests as part of coursework, an internship, or a personal project. You see tests as part of the feature, not an afterthought.
* You know never to hardcode secrets, you have a basic understanding of IAM and role-based access control, and you're willing to learn which compliance requirements like PCI or SOC apply to the systems you work on.
* You know your way around Git and pull requests, can deploy to an existing CI/CD pipeline, and can tell when your specific commit caused a build failure.
* When you're blocked, you ask focused questions and explain what you've already tried. You flag a deadline risk the moment you see it, not the day before it's due.
* You receive code review feedback without getting defensive, you actively learn your team's standards and tools, and you're comfortable switching between tasks within a project when priorities shift.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A degree in computer science software engineering from a reputed institution.
* Internship or co-op experience where you shipped real code to a production or staging environment as part of a team.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team.
* Familiarity with cloud basics even through coursework or personal projects.
* Exposure to containerization through Docker. Reading and running existing Dockerfiles counts, you don't need to have written them from scratch.
* Some experience working in an existing codebase, contributin improvements, and navigating code you didn't write yourself.
* Awareness of AI tools beyond code completion, such as experimenting with prompt design or modifying a simple AI-powered script or agent.
* A genuine interest in the domain. Payments, fleet operations, or developer platform work are exciting problem spaces and it helps to be curious about the industry, not just the technology.

title: Associate Director — PR&D Delivery & Operations
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
At Lilly, the data and digital capability that underpins every regulatory submission, batch investigation, and process decision across CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls) is being rebuilt rather than maintained. Time-to-insight for scientists and process engineers, audit- and inspection-readiness, and the cost of running PR&D's platforms all depend on these capabilities. This role is the mechanism by which the portfolio moves from sustaining the current estate to reshaping it: from request-taking to business partnership, from manual data and process work to AI- and agent-supported execution, and from vendor dependence to retained Lilly capability.
  
The Associate Director, PR&D Delivery & Operations leads broader delivery teams across CMC data platform modernization (structured and unstructured data, platform operations), scientific workflow automation (LIMS, MES, ELN), data governance and business alignment, and AI & Analytics (AI-use-case delivery) — accountable for delivery, technical direction, team capability and measurable business outcomes across all three. The role sits where CMC scientific and data process meets engineering: credible enough to lead a design review and challenge an architecture, fluent enough in regulated CMC data work to shape how a scientific or process team actually works. Split roughly 60% delivery and technical leadership and 40% strategy, business partnership and vendor leadership, it owns the demand relationship with PR&D business owners, directs the partner teams delivering a material share of the work, and supports the portfolio's AI and agentic capability agenda as one part of a broader delivery mandate.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Portfolio Delivery Ownership — own delivery across the portfolio — scope, schedule, quality, dependencies, release readiness and production health — for CMC data and semantic infrastructure (knowledge graph, ontology, document and structured-data ingestion), platform modernization and operations, and AI-use-case delivery, directing the broader teams accountable for each track. Run delivery on real signals: flow, predictability, defect escape and adoption by scientific and process teams, not status reporting.
* Technical Direction & Engineering Standards — set and defend the technical direction of the portfolio, contributing to how CMC data platforms support the goals of the wider PR&D business area; review architecture and design, challenge weak decisions, and own standards for APIs, data contracts, ontology and knowledge-graph modeling (RDF/OWL/SPARQL, property graphs), and tool-calling interfaces (MCP) across CMC data platforms. Raise the engineering bar on test automation, CI/CD, observability and the deliberate reduction of technical debt, staying close enough to the work to judge trade-offs credibly.
* AI & Agentic Delivery Support — support delivery of AI and agentic use cases already on the portfolio roadmap — document and schema intelligence, retrieval over CMC content, and knowledge-graph-powered Q&A or summarization agents — ensuring these initiatives get the same delivery rigor, resourcing and release discipline as any other workstream. Help the team bring new use cases forward for evaluation, and support them through validation and into production with appropriate guardrails and human-in-the-loop review. Build AI-assisted engineering into the team's everyday practice, in step with the broader AI strategy set elsewhere in the portfolio.
* Business Partnership & Stakeholder Management — act as the technology partner for PR&D business owners and domain product managers across the portfolio's data, platform and AI-use-case tracks — the person they call first, and the person who tells them when an idea will not work. Capture and challenge incoming demand, agree priorities against capacity, and keep one honest view of the roadmap and what has been traded away. Translate CMC and scientific need into technical options and constraint, risk and cost into language a business owner can act on; set a rhythm of business reviews and early warning so there are no surprises at release; and build the case for modernization investment, with the benefit measurement that follows it.
* Vendor & Partner Delivery Management — get the work done through partner teams: define scope, outcomes and acceptance criteria, and hold suppliers to the same engineering, quality and GxP standards as internal teams. Shape the sourcing mix for the portfolio, plan partner ramp-up and ramp-down against the roadmap, manage supplier performance on predictability, quality and knowledge retention, and work with sourcing, legal and finance on statements of work, capacity models and change requests. Integrate partner engineers into one team, one backlog and one set of standards, and protect institutional knowledge through documentation, code ownership and cross-training.
* Quality, Risk & GxP Compliance — deliver in a GxP-regulated environment — computer system validation, 21 CFR Part 11, data integrity, inspection and audit readiness. Design for security and data privacy from the start, meet architecture and security review obligations early rather than at release, and own incident response and service levels for the products the teams run.
* People Leadership & Capability Building — manage, coach and grow broader delivery teams spanning multiple sub-teams and disciplines: clear expectations, specific feedback, honest check-ins and a development plan each person recognises as their own. Hire for the capability the portfolio needs next — engineering depth across data, knowledge-graph and AI-use-case delivery, product thinking, CMC domain fluency — address underperformance without delay, build bench strength and succession, and remove single points of failure. Hold high standards and psychological safety at the same time across a distributed team.
* Decision-Making Authority — make design, tooling, sequencing and sourcing decisions within the guidelines set by architecture, engineering and validation standards; challenge product, engineering or vendor approaches where delivery or compliance risk exists; forecast resource needs across the portfolio and manage the allocated budget against plan; contribute to PR&D's business-area plans by translating the modernization roadmap into resourced, executable delivery cycles; and escalate policy-level or cross-platform decisions with a recommendation rather than a question.

Technical & Capability Areas
  
  
CMC Data Systems (LIMS, MES, ELN) · Data Engineering & Data Platforms · Knowledge Graph & Ontology Engineering (OWL/RDF/SPARQL, Neo4j/property graphs) · Semantic Layer & Retrieval (Vector Databases, Hybrid/Graph-RAG) · AI/ML & Agentic Systems (LLMs, Multi-Agent Orchestration, Model Context Protocol) · Modern Software Development Practices (SDLC, CI/CD, Test Automation) · Cloud Platforms (Azure/AWS) · API & Integration Architecture · Clinical/Scientific Data Standards & Governance · Agile & Product Operating Model · Security & Compliance (GxP, CSV, 21 CFR Part 11) · Vendor & Delivery Governance · Business Stakeholder Management · People Leadership & Coaching
  
  
Basic Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field (Master's preferred).
* 10+ years in technology delivery or technical leadership, including 4+ years of direct people management across broader or multi-team delivery organizations.
* 4+ years supporting CMC, pharma R&D, or manufacturing data and process technology — LIMS/MES/DMS/ELN systems, batch records, process or regulatory submission data.
* Demonstrated ownership of delivery for a portfolio or platform across multiple concurrent programmes, including work delivered through vendors.
* Broad technology awareness and working strength across cloud platforms, APIs and enterprise integration patterns, data engineering, AI/ML, and agentic systems — enough to review a design, engage credibly with technical teams across all these areas, ask the right questions, and spot delivery or quality risk, without requiring hands-on ownership of any single one.
* Working familiarity with AI, machine learning or agentic solutions and how they move from proof of concept into governed production use.
* Experience operating in regulated (GxP) environments, including computer system validation and inspection-readiness practices.
* Demonstrated success owning a senior business relationship — shaping demand, negotiating priorities and capacity, and holding credibility through difficult delivery news.
* Demonstrated success governing multi-vendor or managed-service delivery, with clear separation of Lilly-owned and vendor-executed responsibility, and command of the commercial mechanics.
* Strong communication skills, translating technical trade-offs into business, scientific and regulatory language for senior stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of Agile-at-scale and product operating model practices (backlog governance, value-stream mapping) applied to a regulated portfolio.
* Track record of hiring, coaching, performance management and retention across broader, distributed delivery teams.

Additional Qualifications / Competencies
  
  

* Experience with knowledge graph or ontology engineering platforms (Neo4j, GraphDB, Protégé, or comparable), or semantic layer/retrieval tooling; platform training or certification.
* Exposure to CMC, manufacturing, or process data domains — batch records, equipment/material master data, or regulatory submission content.
* Strategic and analytical thinking — preparing decisions ahead of delivery rather than reacting to them.
* Strong vendor governance and negotiation skills; ownership mindset managing multiple priorities, stakeholders and concurrent programmes.
* Influence with internal and external customers and management — with business stakeholders who do not report to them and partner teams they do not employ; comfort driving clarity in ambiguity.
* Learning agility and continuous-improvement leadership — challenging the status quo and growing technical capability around them.
* Experience of shared ownership models between India-based and global organisations.

title: Principal Digital Design Engineer
description:
**About Analog Devices**

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X .

  

**Description:**

The Digital IP team within Analog Devices Inc. is responsible for developing, curating, and providing reusable strategic IPs to Business Units to accelerate product development across the company. The team is looking for an experienced **Digital Design Lead** who will be responsible for providing technical leadership to the digital design team, while managing IP development and delivery.

The ideal candidate would be someone with strong technical background combined with management acumen and demonstrable ability to handle ambiguity while still finding creative ways to make things happen.

A key focus area for this position includes interacting and engaging with internal customers to communicate, identify, improve, and maintain developed IP, as well as scout for 3rd party IPs and evaluate them on a regular basis for future requirements.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* **Provide technical leadership and expertise to a team of design engineers on all aspects of digital design & quality assurance** (CDC, Low Power design, Synthesis & timing closure, Design for Test improvements, silicon debug etc)
* **Architect and Design** **key digital blocks** such as accelerators/ data path IP in Verilog/ System Verilog with built-in configurability to allow Power/ Performance/ Area tradeoffs
* **Demonstrate strong understanding of heterogenous processor cores & subsystems** (A55/ M55/ M4/ U55/ RISC-V/ DSP core, and associated infrastructure such as caches, interconnect fabric, GIC, DMA, MMU, Coresight Debug & Trace, TZC, SMPU, SPU) and their integration requirements
* Work closely with all stakeholders, including product teams, project managers, senior managers & leadership team to align team schedules, milestones, commitments, deliverables
* **Conduct detail-oriented design reviews** and drive adherence to quality metrics
* Create and manage a streamlined workflow for the design team that enables them to work collaboratively and efficiently. This includes creating a project visibility system and setting up design review processes to establish a clear scheme of design delivery
* **Drive efforts towards development of Design Management and IP Centric infrastructure and flows** across different tools such as Methodics / Perforce / Github / IP catalog creation etc
* **Develop and maintain catalog of digital IPs** to enable ease of information sharing to customers across different BUs
* **Lead the way to build deep expertise on complex interfaces** , peripherals & protocols such as DDR, Ethernet, eMMC/ SD, MIPI, Display Port, HDMI, PCIe, high speed D2D
* **Package Digital IP for seamless integration** into design flow at different stages – RTL/ constraints/ CDC waivers, timing wavers, DFT DRCs and waivers, software programming sequence etc.

title: Cyber Manager - Threat Exposure Management (Infrastructure)
description:
**Job Role- Cyber Manager**  
The Cyber Manager for Threat Exposure Management is responsible for leading [as a people manager] the enterprise-wide operations, and continual evolution of the organisation’s threat exposure management lifecycle and reduction programmes within a given scope, and reports to the *Senior Cyber Manager – Threat Exposure Management* . This role ensures that exposures across infrastructure, applications, identities, cloud, OT/IoT, AI, and third-party ecosystems are proactively identified, prioritised, validated, and remediated in alignment with business risk and operational resilience requirements.

The successful candidate must demonstrate a strong track record in leading [also as a people manager] high-performing technical teams and fostering a culture of technical excellence. They will bring market-proven know-how to establish industry-driven threat exposure management practices, whilst effectively influencing stakeholders across the organisation. The candidate must also bring advanced technical expertise in threat exposure, vulnerability management and defensive and offensive security, with the ability to lead deep technical discussions and conduct complex analysis across some of the following technologies: IT, OT, Cloud, Applications, Data, Identities, Code and AI-driven environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the technical direction and operational governance of Threat Exposure and Vulnerability Management across heterogeneous environments, including enterprise IT, OT/ICS systems (PLC, SCADA, DCS), multi-cloud architectures (such as Azure, AWS, GCP), container platforms, Kubernetes clusters, application stacks, CI/CD pipelines, Data, Identity, source-code repositories and AI/ML ecosystems.
* Oversee the full threat exposure lifecycle: continuous asset discovery, authenticated scanning, passive/active enumeration, exploitability analysis, threat correlation, prioritisation logic, risk acceptance workflows and exception governance.
* Ensure end-to-end integration with asset intelligence platforms, CMDB, CSPM, vulnerability scanners, code-security toolchains (SAST, SCA, DAST, IaC, secret scanning), and ASM/EASM technologies, establishing high-fidelity visibility across all attack-surface domains.
* Collaborate with Threat Intelligence to operationalise threat-led prioritisation, mapping exploit campaigns, adversary TTPs and industry-specific threat trends to internal exposure data. Align Vulnerability Management (VM) and Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) with predictive models and real-time intel feeds.
* Direct technical coordination with Red Team and Incident Response to validate exploit paths, confirm actual attack feasibility, and translate validation findings into actionable remediation and control enhancements, partnering with Protect capability and Issues Engineers.
* Govern cloud exposure management across CSPs, ensuring deep visibility into misconfigurations, identity privileges, network paths, storage exposures, API endpoints and container orchestration layers.
* Extend VM and CTEM coverage into OT/ICS environments with risk-aware, non-disruptive methods. Coordinate with OT Security teams to identify vulnerabilities, weak configurations, outdated firmware, and unmanaged assets.
* Manage Vulnerability and Threat Exposure Management across Identity services, including account hygiene, privileged-access pathways, directory health, DNS/DHCP configurations, PKI integrity, authentication flows, domain controller posture, and any identity-linked misconfigurations that create exploitable attack paths.
* Oversee AI/ML exposure across data ingestion pipelines, model training and deployment layers, ensuring identification of risks such as model inversion, data poisoning, prompt injection, insecure model APIs and ungoverned LLM integrations. Operational Excellence & Quality Obsession · Maintain functional metrics and KPIs, delivering performance at or above agreed targets to support operational excellence.
* Develop and uphold operational dashboards, SOPs, workflows, playbooks and service definitions, ensuring high-quality, consistent, standards-driven service delivery.
* Lead remediation governance, risk-acceptance workflows, escalation pathways and exception management processes.
* Enable effective cross-team coordination across Cyber Functions such as Identity, Respond, Detect, Protect, Strategy, Delivery, Platform Engineering, Threat Intelligence, Architecture, Risk, Issues Engineers and Portfolio Cyber Leads. Reporting, Analytics & Metrics
* Deliver comprehensive operational dashboards and KPIs covering key areas of the attack surface such as scanning coverage, vulnerability spread, backlog trends, survival and churn rates, threat posture, exposure windows, exploitability indicators, and Critically Exposed Assets (CEA) pipeline performance.
* Ensure reporting is accurate, timely and aligned to leadership expectations, enabling data-driven decision-making and clear visibility of exposure and progress.
* Maintain structured analytics frameworks to measure remediation effectiveness, prioritisation accuracy and overall functional performance across all attack-surface domains.
* Partner with Operational Insights to provide insights and trend analysis that support continuous improvement, strategic planning and operational excellence across Cyber Operations.

**Relevant Services**

* Threat Exposure Management (TEM)
* Vulnerability Management (VM)
* Attack Surface Management (ASM)
* External Attack Surface Management (EASM)
* Enterprise Surface Discovery (ESD)

**Professional Background**

8–10+ years of progressive experience in enterprise cyber security with demonstrable in-depth technical expertise across Threat Exposure Management, Vulnerability Management, Defensive and Offensive Security, Application Security, Cloud Security, OT/ICS Security, Data and Identity Security, and AI/ML Security. Experience must span large-scale, heterogeneous environments with complex technology stacks. Certifications such as CISSP, CISM and GIAC (GMON, GICSP, GWEB, GCSA) are advantageous, but equivalent hands-on technical capability, advanced analytical proficiency, and a strong record of continuous learning and practical security training are essential.

**Leadership & Communication**

* Proven experience in directly managing a team of Threat Exposure and Vulnerability Management Analysts, including mentoring, developing and guiding security professionals within a collaborative, high-performing environment.
* Strong strategic and visionary capabilities, with the ability to co-develop and drive the function’s technical vision, strategy and roadmap in alignment with business objectives and the organisation’s threat appetite. Technical Expertise
* Deep knowledge of vulnerability management, threat exposure management, exploit development concepts, exposure validation, and remediation governance.
* Strong understanding of common security vulnerabilities, attack vectors, and security testing frameworks, such as OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK, CVE / CVSS, and NIST SP 800-53.
* Robust expertise across technical domains such as IT, OT, Cloud, network security, container environments, and identity-centric security. · Proven capability in AppSec, secure coding practices, CI/CD and IaC security, and DevSecOps tooling.
* Solid understanding of AI/ML architecture, AI security threats, LLM exposure risks, and secure integration patterns.
* Hands-on expertise with tooling in different landscapes: VM, ASM/EASM, AppSec, Cloud, OT, Data, Identity, AI. Stakeholder Engagement & Culture
* Serve as the advisor and central point of contact for all Threat Exposure and Vulnerability Management matters across the organisation within a given scope.
* Build strong relationships with industry partners, vendors, and the wider technology ecosystem to incorporate external expertise, benchmark performance, and stay ahead of emerging threats and vulnerability trends.
* Develop trusted relationships across Cyber, Portfolio teams, Engineering, and Business functions, anchored in transparency, accountability, and the organisation’s core values.
* Lead by example in strengthening collaboration, breaking down silos, and cultivating high-performing cross-functional networks.
* Promote a values-driven culture that embraces diversity, inclusion, and collective ownership of cyber risk.
* Champion staff education, awareness, and secure behaviours to embed a proactive, cyber-aware mindset across the organisation.
* Foster a responsive, delivery-focused culture that partners effectively with Technology and Business units to drive timely resolutions and value-led security outcomes.

Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. title: Engineering Manager
description:
#### **About us**

Camascope India is part of Person Centred Software (PCS) Group, a fast-growing technology group focused on empowering the care and medication sector. Following PCS's acquisition of Camascope, our India team continues to build the products that connect pharmacies, care homes and doctors, now as part of a larger, international engineering organisation serving thousands of care professionals every day. This role is dedicated to Camascope eMAR, working closely with our UK product engineering teams.

#### **What you will work on**

As Engineering Manager, you will lead an existing team of engineers in India delivering Camascope eMAR, working closely with a counterpart engineering team in the UK. This is a hands-on role: you will contribute directly to system design and the delivery of features, whether that means writing code, shaping architecture or unblocking the team on complex problems, while also mentoring engineers, raising engineering standards and strengthening delivery practices.

#### **Responsibilities**

* Lead and grow an existing engineering team in India, developing its capability through mentoring, coaching and career development
* Teach and embed engineering best practices across the team, including code quality, testing, code review, design and delivery habits
* Remain hands-on throughout, contributing directly to system design and the delivery of features alongside the team
* Own day-to-day team operations: sprint delivery, 1:1s, performance management and career development
* Work closely with the UK product engineering team to align on delivery scope, priorities and technical direction for the shared product
* Champion continuous delivery, with testing and security embedded in CI/CD pipelines, and promote DevSecOps practices across the team
* Make significant contributions to technical and architectural decisions, keeping systems, standards and practices coherent with the wider PCS engineering organisation
* Identify and remove blockers, process inefficiencies and technical debt proactively
* Be accountable for the full software development lifecycle, from design through to production, monitoring and support
* Foster a learning and mentoring culture, helping engineers grow in both technical depth and ownership
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers, QA and Design to achieve shared product outcomes.

#### **Requirements**

* 8+ years of software engineering experience, including experience as an Engineering Manager or senior technical lead of a team, with a strong portfolio of C#/.NET applications
* Deep understanding of the C#/.NET ecosystem, including building and maintaining .NET backend services, and experience with cloud platforms (Azure and/or AWS) and cloud-native development
* Experience with modern DevOps/CI-CD practices
* Strong understanding of RESTful API design, security (e.g. OWASP API Security) and system architecture at scale
* Proven experience leading, mentoring and upskilling an engineering team, and establishing or improving delivery practices and engineering standards
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience collaborating across distributed or international teams
* Capable and comfortable working with Agile/Scrum methodologies, and coaching a team on them
* Good understanding of database technologies, message queues, and data security
* Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills, with a fix-forward, learning mindset
* Bachelor's/master's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field
* Experience working with, or managing engineers who use, AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot).

#### **Bonus points**

* Hands-on experience with React (web) and/or Flutter (mobile)
* Experience taking over and developing an existing team, or scaling an engineering organisation
* Prior experience in healthcare, care or pharmacy technology, or another highly regulated environment
* Experience with cloud migration projects or multi-cloud environments
* Prior experience in a post-acquisition or newly integrated engineering organisation.

title: Mainframe zOS Administration Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients-which means some of the biggest in the world.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-class z/OS storage solutions to ensure reliability, scalability, and performance.
* Lead the architecture and governance of DFSMS and SMS environments, including Storage Groups, Data Classes, Storage Classes, Management Classes, and ACS routines.
* Manage DASD capacity planning, storage optimization, hardware upgrades, and long-term growth strategies.
* Administer and support VTOC, VTOCIX, catalogs, DFSMShsm, and DFSMSdss, ensuring efficient data lifecycle management and recoverability.
* Monitor storage performance, analyze I/O workloads, troubleshoot complex issues, and drive root cause resolution for critical incidents.
* Ensure high availability, resiliency, backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities across the storage environment.
* Collaborate with security teams to maintain compliance with audit, regulatory, and access control requirements.
* Lead strategic initiatives including storage modernization, hardware refreshes, data center migrations, z/OS upgrades, cloud integration, automation, and disaster recovery enhancements.
* Develop and implement automation solutions using REXX, JCL, ISPF, and vendor tools to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Serve as the highest level of technical escalation for storage-related issues, providing expert guidance and operational leadership.
* Partner with application, infrastructure, security, and vendor teams to deliver storage services that align with business objectives.
Mentor junior engineers and system programmers, promote knowledge sharing, and contribute to the development of standards, procedures, and best practices.  

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior Administrator to Architect. We have training and upskilling programs that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with customers in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

* 10+ years of experience in Mainframe z/OS system programming, with extensive hands-on expertise in z/OS installation, configuration, maintenance, and support.
* Skills in applying patches, managing third-party software and ensuring system reliability.
* Hands-on expertise in SYSRES builds, applying PTFs, performing disaster recovery drills and updating license keys.
* Proficiency in product maintenance, upgrades and compatibility checks for z/OS 3.1 and IBM z16 hardware.
* Adept at troubleshooting any system failures, freeze, job abends and performance issues.
* Willingness to provide 24/7 oncall support to resolve any system issues.
* Working knowledge of mainframe GDPS.
* Good understanding of flip and stay disaster recovery model.
* Experience of working on many migration projects as part of mainframe modernization.
Should provide recommendations on optimizing system performance.  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* Experience in z/OS administration.
* Experience in mainframe modernization initiatives.
* Experience of supporting the IBM z16 and IBM z17 mainframe systems.
Any leadership and mentoring experience will be an added plus.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. optimize next-generation search platforms for a large-scale eCommerce ecosystem.  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, Vector  
Search, Semantic Retrieval, Generative AI, Amazon Bedrock, and Retrieval  
Augmented Generation (RAG). This role will focus on enhancing product discovery, search  
relevance, recommendations, conversational commerce, and AI-powered customer  
experiences.  
The engineer will partner with Product, Data Science, Merchandising, and Engineering  
teams to deliver scalable search architectures that combine traditional keyword-based  
retrieval with modern semantic and GenAI-powered search capabilities.

* Optimize search relevance, latency, aggregations, and query performance.

**Vector Search & Semantic Retrieval**

* Develop semantic search capabilities using embedding models.

o Backup & Recovery  
o Disaster Recovery

* Automate deployments using CI/CD pipelines.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
**About Plotline**
------------------

Plotline is a 1:1 personalisation platform helping brands treat every user like the only user, turning generic, one-size-fits-all apps into experiences that feel personally made.  
  
Product and growth teams at Meesho, SBI, Dream11, CoinDCX, BharatPe and Upstox use Plotline to move the metrics that matter. Behind the scenes, we power over 5 billion API calls a month and reach more than 150 million users and are growing fast internationally.
