title: Staff Digital Verification Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.  
  
Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world.

 **Job Description**

**Job Description:**

Renesas is seeking a Staff Digital Design Verification Engineer to join our team developing complex power management SoCs. These products integrate digital control, telemetry, fault management, communication interfaces, configurable peripherals, and advanced power-control functions for AI, datacenter, enterprise computing, networking, and high-performance power delivery applications.

You will independently own verification of significant blocks and features from planning through closure. The role combines hands-on UVM development, coverage-driven verification, complex debug, and close collaboration with architecture, RTL design, firmware, analog, validation, and systems teams.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own verification of complex digital blocks or major SoC features from requirements analysis through coverage closure.
* Develop feature-based verification plans from product, architecture, and microarchitecture specifications; identify gaps, ambiguities, corner cases, and risks.
* Build and extend reusable SystemVerilog/UVM environments, including sequences, monitors, scoreboards, checkers, assertions, and coverage models.
* Develop constrained random and targeted tests for normal operation, error handling, recovery, and system-level interactions.
* Drive functional, code, toggle, FSM, and assertion coverage closure using regression and coverage data.
* Debug RTL, testbench, assertion, integration, and regression failures; collaborate with design and firmware teams to isolate issues and verify fixes.
* Automate regression, triage, reporting, and analysis workflows using scripting and modern engineering tools.
Communicate status, risks, dependencies, and closure evidence clearly; provide technical guidance to less-experienced engineers.  

  
  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* 7 or more years of relevant digital design verification experience, or equivalent directly applicable experience.
* Demonstrated ownership of a complex block, subsystem, or major feature from verification planning through closure.
* Strong proficiency in SystemVerilog, UVM, constrained random verification, functional coverage, and SystemVerilog Assertions.
* Experience translating specifications into test plans, test scenarios, checkers, scoreboards, assertions, coverage models, and closure criteria.
* Hands-on experience developing and debugging reusable UVM environments and analyzing complex regression failures.
* Strong RTL and testbench debug skills, with the ability to distinguish design, environment, test, firmware, and specification issues.
* Working knowledge of digital design fundamentals, including state machines, clocks and resets, interrupts, register interfaces, memories, and clock-domain crossings.
* Proficiency in Linux and at least one scripting language such as Python, Bash, Perl, or Tcl.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across architecture, design, firmware, analog, validation, and systems teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience verifying complex SoCs, power management ICs, voltage regulators, digital controllers, or mixed-signal products.
* Experience verifying RTL interfaces to embedded processors, memory-mapped peripherals, and firmware-controlled hardware features.
* Familiarity with PMBus, AVSBus, SVID or SVI3, I2C, SPI, or similar control and communication protocols.
* Understanding of telemetry, fault and alert handling, power sequencing, multiphase regulation, or digital control loops.
* Experience with Cadence Xcelium, SimVision, vManager, JasperGold, Synopsys VCS, Verdi, or comparable tools.
* Experience with formal verification, gate-level simulation, silicon bring-up, or pre-silicon-to-silicon correlation.
Experience improving regression infrastructure, coverage analytics, failure triage, or verification automation.  

What You Bring

* Strong technical ownership and a disciplined approach to verification completeness.
* Ability to reason beyond directed requirements and identify meaningful corner cases and feature interactions.
* Clear communication of technical risk, progress, and signoff evidence.
A collaborative mindset and interest in improving verification methodology and productivity.  

  
  
**Additional Information**

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, **To Make Our Lives Easier**. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Are you ready to join our team and **shape the future** with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. Department Name & No.: 50736 - WRD Tech QuIC Tech BT Host SW - BDC

Supervisor: Rahul Chauhan

Project Code:

CVs to be submitted to: Rahul Chauhan, Paras Kumar

Hire Type: Regular

Telephone Interview Panel: Rahul Chauhan, Paras Kumar, Girish Sadananda

Available to New or Recent Graduate: No

Onsite Interview Panel: Rahul Chauhan, Paras Kumar, Girish Sadananda

**Business Justification as to why this hire is required, is this a backfill or additional headcount:**

  

Additional senior engineering capacity is required to execute the architectural transition of the Synergy Bluetooth host stack from APSS to the Q6 low-power domain. The role will strengthen full-stack Bluetooth ownership, accelerate architecture and product problem solving, and enable scalable development across XR and Wearables programs.

**Job Overview - Dept Description and Job Duties:**

  

The Bluetooth Common IP team is seeking a highly analytical and hands-on Senior Engineer to design, develop, port, integrate, and sustain Bluetooth host software across APSS and Q6/LPI environments. The engineer will be a key contributor to the full-stack architecture in which Bluetooth host protocols, profiles, application services, and supporting platform interfaces progressively evolve to meet Days of Use (DOU) targets for our products in XR & Wearables.

  

This is an implementation-focused role for an exceptional developer who can work from Bluetooth specification and system architecture through detailed design, efficient C code, integration, debugging, and productization. The engineer is expected to use AI-assisted engineering responsibly to accelerate understanding, development, reviews, test creation, failure analysis, and documentation while independently validating all outputs.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Bluetooth stack development: Develop and maintain Bluetooth Classic, Bluetooth Low Energy, and LE Audio host protocols, profiles, services, and product-specific use cases.

* Platform adaptation: Port or redesign OS, memory, threading, timer, storage, security, IPC, transport, logging, and diagnostic dependencies for a resource-constrained low-power execution environment.

* Architecture and interfaces: Define clean, scalable module boundaries and APIs between the Bluetooth stack, controller transport, audio services, offload framework, OEM applications, Android/APSS services, and Q6 platform components.

* End-to-end ownership: Own features from requirements and feasibility through design, implementation, unit testing, integration, interoperability, performance optimization, issue resolution, and release support.

* Protocol analysis: Translate Bluetooth Core and profile specifications into robust implementations and use protocol-level reasoning to diagnose failures across host, controller, transport, peer device, and application layers.

* Performance and robustness: Optimize memory footprint, compute utilization, latency, concurrency, power behavior, and recovery paths for embedded and low-power targets.

* AI-assisted engineering: Use approved AI coding and analysis tools to accelerate code comprehension, solution exploration, test generation, log triage, documentation, and repetitive development tasks. Apply engineering judgment, security discipline, source review, and thorough validation before adoption.

* Collaboration and technical leadership: Partner with Bluetooth firmware, audio, systems, platform, application, test, product, and customer engineering teams. Drive design reviews, mentor engineers, identify risks early, and communicate decisions and trade-offs clearly.

  

Qualifications needed

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

* 6+ years of embedded software development experience, with strong hands-on development in C/C++ for wireless connectivity or comparable embedded products.

* Strong working knowledge of Bluetooth architecture, host-controller interactions, and Bluetooth Classic/BLE protocols, with the ability to scale rapidly into unfamiliar protocols, profiles, specifications, and product use cases.

* Excellent C programming, data-structure, concurrency, memory-management, and defensive-programming skills.

* Strong analytical problem-solving ability, including decomposition of ambiguous system issues, hypothesis-driven debugging, trade-off evaluation, and root-cause isolation across software and hardware boundaries.

* Experience with IPC, multithreading, synchronization, transport interfaces, embedded storage, logging, and debugging of distributed or multi-processor systems.

* Ability to read specifications, architecture documents, code, traces, and logs and convert them into clear designs and reliable implementations.

* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including design documentation, technical presentations, and cross-functional reviews.

Minimum Qualifications:

* At least 3-6 years’ experience in embedded SW development using the C programming language for Wireless connectivity products

* Demonstrated ability to design, port, debug, and optimize complex software on Linux and/or RTOS environments.

* Experience porting a protocol stack to MCU, or RTOS-based low-power execution environments.

* Practical experience using enterprise-approved generative AI or coding assistants, with a strong understanding of validation, confidentiality, licensing, and secure-development expectations.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Hands-on experience with Bluetooth host stack.

* Understanding of Bluetooth controller transports and arbitration, including UART, SPI/I3C or comparable inter-processor/controller interfaces.

* Experience integrating Bluetooth audio and connectivity services, including A2DP, AVRCP, HFP, LE Audio, audio routing, and session control.

* Familiarity with Bluetooth SIG qualification, specification interpretation, interoperability events, and contribution to standards or technical working groups.

* Experience with Bluetooth sniffers, air traces, HCI snoop logs, protocol analyzers, embedded debuggers, crash dumps, and performance/power profiling.

* **Educational Requirements:**

Bachelor’s Degree in Electronics or Computer Science from an internationally recognized institution.

  

**Keywords:** C Programming, Bluetooth host Protocols, Bluetooth Profiles, LE Audio (LEA), BT, Sniffer, Air logs

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 1+ year of experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

* 1+ year of experience with Database Management Software.

* 1+ year of experience with API.

* 1+ year of work experience with Git, Perforce, or Source Code Management System.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Applies Software knowledge to assist and support the design, development, creation, modification, and validation of embedded and cloud edge software, applications, and/or specialized utility programs.

* Analyzes user needs and software requirements.

* Designs and implements small software features for products and systems.

* Participates in the design, coding for small features, unit testing, minor debugging fixes, and integration efforts to ensure projects are completed on schedule.

* Assists in performing code reviews and regression tests as well as the triaging of issues to ensure the quality of code.

* Collaborates with others inside project team to accomplish project objectives.

title: Senior AI Evals Engineer
description:
**About the Role**
------------------

The **Senior AI Evals Test Engineer** is a hands-on technical role responsible for defining, developing, and executing robust evaluation frameworks and test strategies for AI agents built using the **Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or similar sort of agentic frameworks**. This role bridges AI development and reliable deployment — ensuring our agents are safe, ethical, effective, and meet high-quality performance standards. A significant focus of the role is on Responsible AI and Safety Evals, including **adversarial testing, red-teaming, bias detection, and toxicity measurement**. The engineer will **design scalable evaluation pipelines**, build synthetic test environments, and work closely with AI/ML Engineers, Researchers, and policy teams to ensure agents are production-ready and compliant with regulatory and ethical standards. The role is **70% Automation and 30% Manual Testing**, and sits within the **Applied AI: Test Engineering team** as a key technical authority.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Design and build agent evaluation frameworks** — create end-to-end infrastructure for evaluating LLM-based agents across correctness, latency, cost, safety, and task completion rate
* **Build synthetic testing environments and simulation strategies** to stress-test AI agents under diverse real-world conditions, with specific focus on agents built on Google ADK and related Google AI/ML services (e.g., Vertex AI, Gemini models)
* **Build golden datasets and test harnesses** — curate domain-specific evaluation sets for Rubrik's product verticals (data security, SaaS protection, cyber recovery, compliance)
* **Establish eval-as-a-service** — build and enhance centralized evaluation platform that any IT team members can self-serve to test their agents against standardized and custom benchmarks
* **Automate regression and drift detection** — implement CI/CD-integrated eval pipelines that catch regressions on every model or prompt change before production deployment
* **Define eval taxonomies and rubrics** — establish structured scoring criteria for agentic workflows (tool use accuracy, multi-step reasoning, hallucination rate, policy adherence, error recovery)
* **Instrument production observability** — build real-time monitoring for agent quality in production: success rates, user corrections, fallback triggers, escalation patterns
* **Benchmark and select models** — run structured model comparisons (cost, quality, latency trade-offs) to inform model selection decisions across agent use cases
* **Analyze and interpret evaluation results**, providing clear, actionable quality and safety reports to stakeholders and development teams, with specific focus on risk metrics, trend analysis, and mitigation recommendations
* **Define comprehensive end-to-end QA strategies** — functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT) — tailored for conversational and goal-oriented AI agents with tool-use, memory, and multi-turn reasoning capabilities
* **Develop and maintain detailed test artifacts** (test plans, test cases, test scenarios, automated test suites) covering agent features, tool invocation, memory persistence, and reasoning accuracy across evolving model versions
* **Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects**, performance regressions, and alignment failures using Jira, collaborating closely with Applied AI Engineers to analyze root causes and validate fixes
* **Evaluate new technologies and patterns** (e.g., new tools for Agent Evals), run proofs-of-concept, and influence the platform roadmap
* **Partner with policy and legal teams** to ensure agent evaluations systematically cover regulatory compliance, fairness objectives, and emerging AI governance requirements
* **Provide technical leadership to engineers**, including solutioning, design reviews, code reviews, pair programming, and mentoring of junior and contract engineers
* **Collaborate cross-functionally** — work closely with ML engineers, product teams, platform engineers, and security to embed eval-driven quality gates into the agent development lifecycle

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

### **Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* **8+ years of overall software Test engineering experience**, with 5+ years focused on test engineering, QA automation, or developer tooling, and demonstrated ability to build evaluation systems across multiple AI/ML domains, conversational agents, or Large Language Models (LLMs)
* **2+ years working with ML/AI systems, building**, testing, or evaluating models in production environments, including hands-on experience with LLM-based applications, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or agentic workflows
* **2+ years as a senior/lead, owning evaluation strategy,** quality frameworks, and technical decisions for complex AI agent systems in an enterprise product environment
* **1+ years** in designing or operating evaluation frameworks specifically for generative AI / LLM agents, including benchmarking, red-teaming, and production quality monitoring in the AI ADLC model

### **Technical Skills**

* **Deep hands-on experience with LLM evaluation** — familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as LangSmith, DeepEval,LLM as a Judge, Promptfoo, RAGAS, Hugging Face evaluation tooling, custom eval harnesses
* **Strong understanding of agentic AI patterns** — tool use, function calling, multi-step planning, ReAct/CoT reasoning chains, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
* **Production experience with eval pipelines** — building automated, CI-integrated evaluation infrastructure (not just notebooks)
* **Proficiency in Python** — strong scripting and tooling skills; experience with pytest, async patterns, and data processing at scale
* **Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or any Cloud Service** relevant to AI/ML (e.g., Vertex AI) and experience integrating testing into MLOps workflows
* **Statistical literacy** — ability to design experiments, interpret eval metrics with appropriate confidence, and avoid common pitfalls (overfitting to benchmarks, metric gaming)
* **Enterprise product sensibility** — understanding of how AI quality translates to customer trust in a B2B/enterprise context (security, compliance, reliability SLAs)
* **Excellent communication** — ability to present eval results and quality trade-offs to engineering leadership, articulate risks and safety findings to non-technical audiences, and drive alignment on ship/no-ship decisions
* **Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based workflows**, including automated testing, static analysis, deployment automation, and environment configuration for our DevTestOps

### **Tech Stack:**

* **Languages:** Python(Must), TypeScript, Java (Optional)
* **Test Automation:Selenium, Playwright**
* **LLM Providers:** Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, open-source models
* **Eval Tooling:** DeepEvals(Must), LLM as a Judge (Must), Promptfoo/RAGAS/LangSmith/ Custom harnesses
* **Agent Evals Frameworks/libraries:** LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, custom orchestrators
* **Infrastructure:**DevOps (Basic), Kubernetes, CI/CD (Jenkins/GitHub Actions), observability stacks (Datadog/Grafana)

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* **Deep Learning/NLP Knowledge**: Fundamental understanding of how LLMs work, including concepts like RAG, prompting, and the technical challenges related to alignment
* **Data Analysis:** Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Pandas, SQL) for analyzing evaluation and safety results
* **Policy Background:** Familiarity with AI ethics principles and industry standards for responsible AI development
* **Garbage-in/Garbage-out (GIGO) Tools**: Any tool or framework that specializes in testing the model's response to highly ambiguous, misleading, or malformed inputs to test for robustness and safety failures
* **Experience testing complex APIs,** especially for tool-integration and function-calling scenarios in agentic workflows
* **Experience with prompt injection (Must)** and data poisoning skills is a plus
* **Certifications in AI/ML**, cloud platforms (GCP, AWS), AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Google Professional ML Engineer, DeepLearning.AI specializations and software testing methodologies

**Soft Skills**
---------------

* **Proven ability to lead without direct authority**, influencing cross-functional teams and driving technical decisions through clarity and data rather than hierarchy.
* **Experience working in agile environments**, collaborating closely with product owners, scrum teams, and distributed stakeholders across time zones.
* **Excellent communication and documentation skills**, comfortable presenting solutions and trade-offs to engineers, managers, and senior business stakeholders.
* **Strong architectural thinking and problem-solving skills**, including the ability to decompose complex business processes into simple solutions

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience evaluating agents in cybersecurity, data protection, or infrastructure domains
* Familiarity with Rubrik's product portfolio or similar enterprise data management platforms
* Hands-on with human-in-the-loop eval workflows (annotation platforms, inter-rater reliability)
* Experience with model fine-tuning evaluation (pre/post quality comparison)
* Background in building internal developer platforms or tooling teams
* Contributions to open-source eval frameworks or published work on AI evaluation methodology
* Drive red-teaming and adversarial testing — design adversarial evaluation suites for jailbreak resistance, data leakage prevention, and boundary enforcement in enterprise-grade agents

**Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation**
----------------------------------------------------------------------

Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real-time guardrails, fine-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes.

  

**Inclusion @ Rubrik**
----------------------

At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.

Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.

### **Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:**

* Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.
* Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.
* Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.

**Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled**
------------------------------------------------

Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants in all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, promotion, compensation, training, leave, and termination.

Rubrik provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application process or to perform your job, please contact hr@rubrik.com. Accommodations may include changes to the application process, documents in an alternate format, a sign language interpreter, or specialized equipment.

description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your role**  
As a System Engineer, you will play a key role in the configuration, maintenance and optimization of core Mainframe z/OS infrastructure that support mission critical enterprise workloads. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to respond to system issues and implement solutions, while also contributing to root cause analysis and continuous improvement efforts.
  
  
**What you will do**  

* Configure, maintain and optimize the z/OS customer environment.
* Take required actions to maintain availability, reliability, and security.
* Troubleshoot and resolve system issues, including escalated incidents that require deep technical analysis.
* Support change management processes; including testing and implementing approved system changes.
* Collaborate with other zOS teams to deliver integrated solutions.
* Document system configurations, procedures, and resolutions to support consistent operations.

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
Becoming a Project Manager at Kyndryl is an excellent gateway to many different paths. You’ll be creating a well-rounded skillset while gaining professional certifications and qualifications.You can evolve horizontally into other technical or non-technical areas such as Technical Service Architect, or you can move vertically to become a Senior Project Manager or program manager. There are many different types and flavors of project manager roles, so everyone can find the opportunity that suits them best.

  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required skills and experience**

* Key skills including knowledge of ISPF, JES2, JCL, REXX, SMP/E, PCOMM, Parallel Sysplex, Disaster Recovery and product maintenance/upgrades.
* Hands-on experience troubleshooting and resolving complex system / infrastructure issues.

* Experience working within structured processes such as incident, problem, change and inventory management.
* Demonstrated focus on delivering reliable outcomes for customer environments.

  
**Preferred skills and experience**  

* Experience with automation tools or scripting for system programming tasks.
* Familiarity with zcloud platforms and hybrid infrastructure environments.
* Experience working in multi-vendor or enterprise-scale IT environments.
* Relevant technical certifications.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

title: Technical Consulting Engineer
description:
Job Description
  
  
Who We Are
  
**The name ThousandEyes was born from two big ideas:** the power to see things not ordinarily possible and the ability to collect insights from a multitude of vantage points. As the world continues its digital transformation and relies more on cloud services and the Internet, the"network" which is now both public and private, has become a black box our customers cannot see or understand.
  
  
Our Internet and cloud intelligence platform delivers the only collectively powered real-time view of the Internet and private networks, cloud, and SaaS platforms, helping enterprises and service providers identify problems before they impact revenue, damage brand reputation, or halt employee productivity.
  
  
In August 2020, Cisco Systems completed the acquisition of ThousandEyes, which now forms the ThousandEyes Business Unit within the Cisco Networking Business Group and is the Network Assurance solution for Cisco across the Cisco Networking Cloud and Cisco Security Cloud. ThousandEyes is also a foundational component of Cisco’s growing Full-Stack Observability "FS") business.
  
  
About The Role
  
We're all familiar with the technology, but have you ever wondered how the Internet actually works? At ThousandEyes, we spend every day working to help customers understand the gotchas of Internet-based service delivery: how to identify problems, how to resolve, and how to avoid them in the future. Our Customer Engineering team is tasked with empowering our customers with ThousandEyes to ease their performance monitoring pains.
  
  
If you enjoy variety in job responsibilities, this is the job for you. A day may involve helping a customer identify network loss in an undersea cable, diagnose the cause of a route leak impacting significant portions of internet traffic, scripting an approach to monitoring a website's login flow, spinning up a lab environment to reproduce a strange set of behaviors seen in a customer's environment, saving a company hours of bridge time during a significant outage impacting their infrastructure by finding the smoking-gun in a network outage, or simply helping someone understand the way that our applications work. The job is highly variable and requires both the ability to make data-driven decisions, and draw conclusions based on incomplete information. We're looking for out-of-the-box thinkers who can complement and extend the already formidable talents of our Customer Engineering organization.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  

* Provide advanced technical expertise and leadership in solving complex, high-impact customer issues
* Lead the creation, refinement, and delivery of technical documentation, training materials, and knowledge content
* Partner closely with Engineering and Product teams to address systemic product issues and influence roadmap decisions
* Guide and mentor junior engineers, fostering technical growth and team development
* Submit and manage effective escalations, coach others on how to engage with Engineering and Product teams
* Utilize advanced software skills to configure, troubleshoot, or automate ThousandEyes product workflow
* Drive serviceability, usability, and product improvement efforts through customer feedback and technical insights
* Represent the support function in cross-functional meetings and customer engagements
* Contribute proactively to digital transformation by creating scripts, automation tools, and reusable assets
* Promote ThousandEyes' culture of collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence
* Timely interaction with customers and internal teams requesting support via online-chat, email and phone
* Active participation in 24x7 Support Coverage model

Qualifications
  

* A standout"customer firs" attitude
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 4-7 + years of experience in a technical support, engineering, or related customer-facing role
* Specialist-level certifications (e.g. CCNP) or equivalent advance technical credentials preferred
* Experience with Cloud/SaaS software products is highly desirable
* Familiar with core networking principles - TCP/IP, DNS, web technologies, proxies and VoIP
* Working knowledge of virtualization technology - containers, virtualBox, VMware, HyperV, Xen
* Working knowledge in security - authentication, permissions, SSO
* Knowledge of one computer languages and programming (Java, Python, XML, RESTAPI) frameworks desirable
* Experience with the administration of Linux based Operations Systems a plus
* Experience in technical writing is a plus
* Ability to prioritize& complete tasks in a timely fashion
* Ability to communicate clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical users
* Proven troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Expert in one or more technical domains; broad knowledge across ThousandEyes and networking technologies
* Proficient in automation, programmability, orchestration, virtualization, and/or security
* Reads and applies industry standards, RFCs, and architectural documents
* Mentors team members and drives team goals into actionable initiatives
* Influences product development through trends analysis and cross-functional collaboration
* Regional or global impact; regularly interacts with customers, leadership, and product teams
* Leads original and creative initiatives that are critical to organization success

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

title: Staff Compiler Performance Engineer
description:
**Falcon** is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

We are looking for a **Staff Compiler Performance Engineer** to set the technical direction for Falcon performance. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: Falcon is mature and runs in production at large enterprises. You will decide where the next significant performance gains come from, lead the design of the optimizations that deliver them, and make sure the compiler architecture supports the product roadmap.

You will be the senior technical voice on a distributed team of compiler experts and a key partner for runtime, GC and product teams.

### **What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)**

* Define the performance strategy for Falcon: identify the largest opportunities across benchmarks and customer workloads and turn them into a technical roadmap
* Lead design of complex, cross cutting optimizations in the optimizer and code generator, and of the interfaces between the compiler, the runtime and the garbage collector
* Make architectural decisions on the Falcon optimization pipeline, compile time budget and tiering strategy
* Lead enablement of Falcon on new hardware platforms and new Azul products
* Mentor senior engineers, review critical designs and code, and set standards for performance methodology and validation
* Represent Azul in the LLVM community: drive upstream design discussions and contributions that benefit managed language compilers

### **What You'll Bring (aka Experience, Skills)**

* 8+ years of professional experience developing optimizing compilers or JIT compilers
* Track record of technical leadership: owning the design of major compiler components or optimization frameworks used in production
* Expert C++ skills and experience in large, long lived codebases
* Deep expertise in compiler optimization and code generation, with a clear view of the tradeoffs between peak performance, compile time, warmup and code size
* Expert performance analysis skills down to the microarchitecture level

### **Nice to Have**

* Recognized contributions to LLVM or another major compiler: code owner, maintainer or author of significant upstream work
* Deep experience with JIT compilers for managed languages: HotSpot C2, Graal, V8, .NET RyuJIT or similar
* Experience working closely with runtime and GC teams on speculation, deoptimization and barrier design

title: Mechanical Engineering Technical Leader
description:
**Meet the Team:** -
  
The mechanical& thermal team is an integrated part of HW organization, responsible for varieties of complex electro-mechanical designs, which includes but are not limited to central office networking products (product ranges from 1RU to 40RU sizes), outdoor mobility equipment, high performance thermal solutions and complex PCB assemblies.
  
  
**Your Impact:**  

* May lead small scale mechanical engineering projects (one to two features) with manageable risks and resource requirements and may take on project management responsibilities
* Collaborates with multiple stakeholders to support assembly, fabrication and manufacturing of products by using an understanding of manufacturing process for plastic, diecast, sheet metal, interconnect and power delivery and conducts failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA)
* Performs stack up tolerance analyses to ensure designs meet six sigma quality for high volume mass production
* Assists senior engineers with test plans, mechanical design testing, failure analysis, reliability, environmental testing and verification plans for developed design elements, materials, parts and products.
* Verifies the quality of the design, resolves issues and advances as needed
* Performs moderately complex simulation with supervision from senior engineers
* Reviews and compiles the BoM for large teams or across multiple products
* Contributes to design improvements and assembly cost savings and avoidance by helping identify the right materials
* Monitors scope, schedule and budgets for projects
* Collaborates with multiple stakeholders to conduct design feasibility testing and prototyping, including working with marketing teams directly to ensure feature and requests from customers are achievable
* Ensures that feasibility and prototyping guidelines are met
* Performs simple mechanical simulations such as FEA analysis to support design features
* Optimizes thermal solutions with thermal engineers prior to prototype

**Minimum Qualifications:**  
Bachelors + 10-14 years of related experience, or Masters + 8-10 years of related experience, or PhD + 6-8 years of related experience
  
  

* Hands on thermal design and validation experience in electro-mechanical equipment that would be deployed in different environments ranging from central office (controlled environment) to outdoor (uncontrolled environment).
* Expertise in concept/architecture, establishing thermal boundaries and optimized cooling solutions which allow to maximise the performance of equipment with minimal power budget for cooling.
* Expertise in design and verification of latest heatsink technologies (Heat pipes, Chill/Cold plates, 2D/3D vapor chambers) which include air and liquid based medium for cooling.
* Strong validation background and ability to plan a comprehensive test plan with minimal iterations.
* Strong command on simulation tools and modelling of complex thermal environment.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Strong communication skills with c/f collaboration and problem-solving abilities.
* Good knowledge of Mechanical design and manufacturing processes.
* Experience in product design validation, particularly in thermal and mechanical areas, is required.
* Good knowledge of Fan/TIM/Heatsink types of selection and verification.
* Experience in generating automation tools, Python scripting for data management and smart design and review.
* Hands on Experience with Electronics cooling tools like Flotherm, Flotherm XT, Ansys Icepak, Ansys CFX
* Hands on experience in Liquid cooling technology, wrt both testing and design tools and manufacturing techniques.
* ASIC level knowledge on handling detailed thermal models containing core details like power maps, TIM1, TIM1.5, TIM2 Bond line thickness, Lidded/Lidless, Silicon 2D/2.5Detc.,
* Hands on Experience in using AI tools in day-to-day work.
* Hands on knowledge on using Thermal testing tools with available DAQ’s in the market, Environmental chambers.
* Proficient in creating test plans, executing tests, and reporting results.
* Experienced in handling power supplies, electronic loads, data loggers, thermocouple installation and removal, IR cameras, air velocity sensors, and heat sink assemblies.
* Capable of setting up tests, system bring-up and troubleshooting issues with minimal assistance.
* Familiar with MDVT, EDVT, airflow, acoustics and environmental testing for networking products.

title: Digital Technology Senior Specialist - Data Operations Engineering
description:

title: Azure AI Engineer
description:
**We’re Pentland Brands:** a global family business behind some of the world’s most iconic active and lifestyle brands. We bring integrity, energy and ambition to our work, setting high standards and striving to deliver great outcomes without ego.

**Design cycling apparel built for movement, endurance and the ride ahead.**

At Pentland Brands, every role helps move our brands forward. Whether you’re supporting our people, improving our systems, growing our commercial performance, strengthening operations or shaping better ways of working, your impact reaches across a portfolio of iconic brands used by consumers around the world.

As our Azure AI Engineer, you'll partner with our brands globally and key functional areas to deliver technology that enables the business to realise its vision and strategy. You will work with our data platforms and tools to provide information that improves and enhances decision-making across the business.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Design, develop, deploy and enhance production-grade AI solutions, including intelligent agents, generative AI applications and machine learning pipelines that solve real business problems at scale.
* Own the ongoing enhancement and operational support of AI agent solutions, including defect resolution, deployments, known limitations, backlog items and future improvements.
* Provide BAU support and enhancement delivery for production APIs on Azure, covering incident investigation, root-cause analysis, code or configuration changes, testing and deployment coordination.
* Provide Azure platform operational support across App Service, Azure SQL Database, Storage Accounts, managed identities, application settings, and related configuration and access requests.
* Administer and support Azure SFTP, including user and directory creation and maintenance, permissions, approved access changes, and connectivity or path troubleshooting.
* Support deployment and release processes, including environment configuration, pre-checks, post-deployment validation, rollback, and production support coordination.
* Monitor application and platform health using App Service logs and Application Insights; perform structured root-cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions for recurring issues.
* Apply strong software engineering practices and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and dependent teams to translate requirements into reliable, maintainable solutions and measurable outcomes.

**What you’ll bring:**

**Experience:** 1–3 years of relevant experience in AI/ML engineering, Azure application development, or a closely related role.

**Must-have capabilities:**

* Strong proficiency in Python for AI/ML development, scripting, API development and automation, plus development experience with .NET and C# in the Azure ecosystem.
* Solid command of SQL for data extraction, transformation, analysis and pipeline support.
* Hands-on experience building applications with large language models, including prompt engineering, RAG architectures, embeddings and fine-tuning.
* Experience with at least one agent-building framework such as Google ADK, LangChain or LangGraph, including tool use, memory management and multi-step agent orchestration.
* Working experience with Azure deployment, compute, storage and cloud-native AI/ML services.
* Practical knowledge of building and training models using TensorFlow, PyTorch or Scikit-learn.

**Preferred capabilities:**

* Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, Qdrant or FAISS for similarity search and RAG pipelines.
* Familiarity with MLOps and CI/CD tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow or Weights & Biases for experiment tracking, model versioning and deployment automation.
* Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes for packaging and orchestrating AI workloads.
* Experience building and exposing AI services through REST or gRPC APIs using FastAPI, Flask or similar frameworks.
* Familiarity with Apache Airflow, Prefect or equivalent workflow orchestration tools.
* Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Strong analytical thinking, clear communication, the ability to work independently and across teams, and a proactive problem-solving mindset.

**Why Pentland Brands?**

Pentland Brands is the name behind some of the world’s best-known sport, outdoor and lifestyle brands, including Speedo, Berghaus, Canterbury, Endura, Ellesse, Kickers and Mitre.

We are a global family business with a clear purpose: pioneering brands that make life better. Across our teams, functions and locations, we work together to create products, experiences and partnerships that help people live more active, confident and positive lives.

Joining Pentland Brands means becoming part of a business where your work can have real reach, across multiple brands, markets, teams and disciplines. It is a place for people who want to contribute, collaborate, improve how things are done and help build the future of brands with heritage, ambition and global impact.

**Perks & Benefits**

Alongside a competitive salary and discretionary bonus, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, flexibility, and life outside work. This includes generous holiday allowance, hybrid and flexible working, employee transportation, pension and gratuity contributions, wellbeing support, medical, personal accident & term life insurance cover.

You can find full details of our benefits and perks on our UK Benefits page.

**The Interview Process**

We want our interview process to feel clear, straightforward, and supportive. If your experience and expectations look like a strong match for the role, here’s what you can expect next:

* **Talent Team Intro Call** - A 30-minute video call with our Talent Team to get to know each other, talk through the role and your experience, and answer any questions you have.
* **Experience Interview** - A more in-depth interview (usually online) with the hiring manager to explore your skills, experience and approach, and how these align with the role, our principles, and our ways of working.
* **Final Interview** - A final in-person interview at our office, focused on deeper discussion and practical application, giving you the chance to meet more of the team and see Pentland Brands in action.

Document architecture, APIs, deployment procedures, operating standards, and support processes while contributing to a culture of continuous improvement.

title: Identity & Access Management Engineer
description:
**About Marvell**

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. **Your Team, Your Impact**

Marvell is seeking a Senior level Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer with deep SailPoint Identity Security Cloud expertise to own and drive the technical direction of IAM across the enterprise.

**What You Can Expect**

* Drive the implementation of IAM technical architecture, with SailPoint Identity Security Cloud as the core governance platform, creating reference architectures aligned with security posture, and operational efficiency.
* Drive the integration of AI assisted IAM capabilities to improve decision quality, reduce manual effort, risk and champion use cases such as:
  + Intelligent access recommendations
  + Role and entitlement optimization
  + Risk based certification prioritization
  + Identity anomaly and outlier detection
* Make high impact technical decisions in areas of ambiguity, balancing risk, and scale.
* Lead the design and evolution of SailPoint ISC implementations, including identity lifecycle automation, access governance, role models, certifications, and integrations.
* Set engineering standards for rules, transforms, workflows, REST/SCIM integrations, and connector patterns.
* Drive reliability and scale of JML processes, ensuring strong controls, observability, and operational resilience.
* Architect and mature RBAC and entitlement-based governance models, including SoD and policy-driven access controls.
* Partner with Security teams to ensure IAM capabilities support audit readiness and compliance outcomes without introducing friction.
* Evaluate emerging vendor capabilities and influence platform adoption decisions with a long-term, architectural mindset.
* Serve as a trusted technical partner to application teams, infrastructure, security leadership, and audit stakeholders.
* Influence IAM adoption patterns across engineering teams without direct authority.

**What We're Looking For**

The ideal candidate will focus on defining architecture and influencing cross functional teams. The individual will serve as an IAM subject matter expert, responsible for evolving Marvell’s IAM capabilities toward a scalable, intelligent, and automation first identity platform, including the thoughtful adoption of AI driven IAM capabilities.

**Technical Competencies**

* Expert level hands-on experience with SailPoint Identity Security Cloud, including architecture, rules, workflows, transforms, roles, and certifications.
* Deep understanding of enterprise identity lifecycle management and HR driven provisioning.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, including authentication, Conditional Access, and identity governance integration points.
* Solid foundation in Active Directory architecture, group strategy, and directory security.
* Strong grasp of IGA concepts (RBAC, SoD, least privilege) and their real-world tradeoffs.
* Automation and scripting experience (PowerShell, APIs, or equivalent).

* Experience with privileged access workflows preferred.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of progressive IAM experience, with demonstrated ownership of complex SailPoint environments.
* Proven experience operating at a senior level, influencing architecture and outcomes beyond a single team.
* SailPoint or IAM certification preferred.
* Strong ability to communicate technical decisions and tradeoffs across engineering and senior leadership audiences.

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.

With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. title: AI Engineer
description:
We are seeking a skilled AI Engineer with hands-on experience in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Generative AI to design, develop, and deploy intelligent solutions for real-world business problems.

The ideal candidate will have strong programming skills in Python, experience building and integrating AI models, and the ability to develop scalable AI applications using modern frameworks, cloud platforms, and data technologies.

* Develop and integrate Large Language Model (LLM)-based solutions, AI assistants, chatbots, and intelligent automation workflows.
* Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, embeddings, and vector search capabilities.
* Work with structured and unstructured datasets for data preparation, feature engineering, model training, and evaluation.
* Develop AI services and APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Evaluate, fine-tune, and optimise AI models for accuracy, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Integrate AI models and third-party AI services into enterprise applications and existing systems.
* Collaborate with software engineers, data scientists, architects, and product teams to translate business requirements into AI solutions.
* Deploy and maintain AI applications in production environments.

* 4–8 years of experience in AI engineering, Machine Learning, or a closely related field.
* Strong proficiency in Python programming and software development fundamentals.
* Hands-on experience with Machine Learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn.
* Strong understanding of Machine Learning algorithms, model evaluation, feature engineering, and statistical concepts.
* Experience developing Generative AI applications using LLMs.
* Knowledge of prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG pipelines, and LLM evaluation.
* Experience with Hugging Face Transformers, OpenAI-compatible APIs, or other LLM platforms.
* Understanding of REST APIs, microservices, and application integration.
* Experience working with SQL/NoSQL databases and data processing pipelines.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Knowledge of Git, automated testing, Docker, and deployment practices.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar AI orchestration frameworks.

* Experience with fine-tuning, quantisation, inference optimisation, and model serving.
* Exposure to MLOps/LLMOps, CI/CD, model versioning, and monitoring tools.
* Experience developing AI agents and multi-step AI workflows.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, distributed computing, and scalable cloud architectures.
* Experience deploying AI solutions in production with measurable business outcomes.

Key Competencies

* AI/ML model development and deployment
* Generative AI and LLM application development
* Python programming and API development
* Data processing and model evaluation

* Technical problem-solving and collaboration

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:

* Receive, clarify, categorize, and troubleshoot customer requests through approved support channels.

* Ability to prioritize work, follow change and escalation controls, and learn multiple products and customer environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

* Exposure to Azure or AWS, Kubernetes or Docker, application performance monitoring, and ticketing platforms such as Azure DevOps, Zendesk, Jira, or ServiceNow.

* Interest in industrial software, manufacturing, IoT, or operational technology.

**Role Success and Growth**
===========================

* Progress is demonstrated through reliable ticket ownership, accurate diagnosis, complete documentation, safe execution, and increasing independence.

Since its founding in 2017, SymphonyAI today serves 1500+ Enterprise customers globally and has grown to 3,000 talented leaders, data scientists, and other professionals across over 30 countries.

title: AI Engineer, Harness & Eval
description:
You'll be one of the first engineers in NAVEX's AI Centre of Excellence, a new function with a company-wide mandate to put AI into how the business runs. We build AI for business operations and internal agentic products.
  
You'll build production agents and, more importantly, the harness around them: the evals, tracing and guardrails that tell us an agent works before a user finds out it doesn't. Some agents you'll build from scratch. Others were built by external partners and are moving in-house. You'll own both.
  
At NAVEX, we’re transforming the world-making it safer, more ethical, and ensuring every voice is heard. That’s real impact.
  
Our high-performance culture is driven by our values. We move with speed, passion and purpose - as one team. We are bold in our ideas, accountable in our actions, and committed to doing the right things right.
  
You’ll thrive in this hybrid role surrounded by an engaged, collaborative team deeply committed to innovation, speed, and measurable outcomes. Join us and help shape what’s next!
  
  
**What you’ll get:**  

* Meaningful Purpose. Your work helps organizations operate with integrity and protect their people-at a scale few companies can match.
* High-Performance Environment. We move with urgency, set ambitious goals, and expect excellence. You’ll be trusted with real ownership and supported to do the best work of your career.
* Candid, Supportive Culture. We communicate openly, challenge ideas- not people-and value teammates who embrace bold thinking and continuous improvement.
* Growth That Matters. You can count on authentic feedback, strong accountability, and leaders invested in your success so you can achieve real growth.
* Rewards for Results. We provide clear, competitive compensation designed to recognize measurable outcomes and real impact.

**What you’ll do:**  

* Build and ship agents for business operations and internal products. End to end: retrieval, tool use, orchestration, state, and handoffs to human
* Build MCP servers and tool integrations that give agents safe, reliable access to company systems and data
* Design the eval harness. Golden sets, regression suites, LLM-as-judge where it earns its place, human review loops. Every change ships with evidence that it made things better
* Instrument agents in production. Tracing, failure taxonomies, cost and latency tracking. When something degrades, you find out first and know why
* Take over agents built by external partners. Read the code, find where it breaks, add the evals and observability it shipped without
* Hold a verification bar. In a compliance company, an answer we can't source or explain doesn't ship

**What you’ll bring:**  

* 3+ years of AI engineering experience, most of it building LLM systems that real users depend on
* Hands-on experience building with agentic harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar
* You've built MCP servers, eval harnesses or LLM Systems, not just used them and can explain how you knew a change was an improvement
* You've owned a system that degraded in production and diagnosed why, and can walk us through it
* Strong Python. Comfortable with at least one agent framework, and willing to go below it when it gets in the way
* Experience deploying on a major cloud provider: AWS, GCP or Azure
* You've shipped end-to-end and own outcomes, not just tasks
* You can take a non-technical team's workflow and turn it into a working system
* Bonus points for:
* Building RAG over messy enterprise documents—proposals, contracts and policies
* Working with AWS Bedrock or inside VPC-constrained enterprise environments
* Building in regulated or compliance-heavy domains
* Sharing your work through writing, talks or open source
* Culture Agility. Comfort working in a fast-paced, candid environment that values innovation, healthy debate, and follow-through
* Fuel performance and outcomes. Leverage your job competencies and champion NAVEX’s core values

**Our side of the deal:**  

* We’ll be clear, we’ll move fast, and we’ll invest in your success. You deserve to be supported, challenged, and rewarded for the impact you make—and we commit to doing that every step of the way.
* The starting pay for this role is 3,000,000 INR with 10% MBO. Discover how you can grow, lead, and make an impact by visiting our career page to learn more. NAVEX is an equal opportunity employer committed to including individuals of all backgrounds, including those with disabilities and veteran status.

title: Senior Linux Administrator
description:
NVIDIA is looking for an exceptional engineer to grow and thrive alongside our Infrastructure team that designs, evaluates, and optimizes the compute inrastructure powering NVIDIA's next-generation silicon design and AI

workloads.You will own the operational health, efficiency and observability of a large Linux compute farm serving NVIDIA's VLSI design teams  
  
**What you'll be doing:**

* In this position, you will own the operational health, efficiency and observability of a large Linux compute farm serving NVIDIA's VLSI design teams, and be the person who can say where the time and the capacity are actually going.
* Profile and debug at the system level - kernel, filesystem, memory and I/O behaviour - when workloads are slow, and turn findings into fixes rather than tickets.
* Drive compute efficiency: memory request-versus-usage accuracy, CPU waste from idle and over-provisioned jobs, and the prediction models behind resource requests.
* Build the observability layer for the farm - telemetry pipelines, metrics and dashboards that make capacity, utilisation and job behaviour visible to engineers and to leadership - and own licence monitoring and expiry alerting across the EDA tool estate.
* This is a hands-on technical role. Day-to-day farm operations and live triage are a core part of it, and you will work directly with the heaviest users on their workload behaviour, since most efficiency gains come from a small number of workflows.

**What we need to see:**

* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years in Linux systems administration or infrastructure operations at scale.
* Deep Linux systems and kernel-level expertise - comfortable with perf, eBPF/bpftrace, strace, cgroups, NUMA, memory management, scheduler behaviour and I/O subsystems, and able to use them to find root cause rather than guess at it.
* Demonstrated experience diagnosing and fixing performance problems on large multi-user compute systems.

description:

Description:

**Company Description**

You will not only work at the exciting intersection of healthcare and technology but also will be mentored by some of the most brilliant minds in the industry. We are offering a global fast-track career where you can grow along with Indegene’s high-speed growth. We are purpose-driven. We enable healthcare organizations to be future ready and our customer obsession is our driving force. We ensure that our customers achieve what they truly want. We are bold in our actions, nimble in our decision-making, and industrious in the way we work.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a highly skilled and forward-thinking AI Solutions Architect to lead the design, development, and deployment of enterprise-grade AI solutions powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). This role demands hands on expertise in designing scalable AI architectures, integrating cutting-edge tools, and ensuring safety, observability, and performance at scale. This role also requires collaboration with engineering leads to drive AI innovation/ discussion, drive technical decisions, ensure delivery ownerships and include Gen AI capabilities in the existing product roadmaps/ frameworks.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in Software engineering, AI/ML systems, system/ solution engineering, distributed architecture, and platform design, along with recent hands-on work in Generative AI, multi-agent systems, LAG/RAG pipelines, and AI governance. You should be equally comfortable reviewing legacy software architectures, mentoring engineers, working with cross-functional stakeholders, and driving production readiness of AI systems.

Key Responsibilities :-

AI Platform Architecture: Design and own the end-to-end architecture for enterprise AI systems spanning LLM orchestration, multi-agent workflows, RAG pipelines, vector databases, LLM gateways, and API layers. Define reference architectures, design patterns (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Tool-Use), and enforce architectural standards through Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems: Architect and implement production multi-agent systems with specialized agents (content generation, compliance auditing, data retrieval, orchestration), inter-agent communication protocols, tool/function calling frameworks, plugin registries, and memory management (conversation buffers, working memory, long-term vector stores). Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints, fallback chains, and graceful degradation patterns.

Production RAG Systems: Design production-grade RAG pipelines including document ingestion (PDF, DOCX, HTML with tables, images, multi-column layouts), chunking strategies (recursive, semantic, document-structure-aware, parent-child), hybrid retrieval (semantic + BM25 + metadata filtering), re-ranking, query analysis/rewriting, citation enforcement, and hallucination detection.

LLM Strategy & Model Routing: Define multi-provider LLM strategies across Claude (Anthropic), GPT-4o (OpenAI), Gemini (Google), and open-source models (Llama, Mistral). Architect intelligent model routing that optimizes for cost, latency, and capability. Evaluate and recommend models for specific use cases based on capability fit, context window, compliance, and deployment constraints.

LLMOps & AgentOps: Build CI/CD pipelines for AI systems prompt versioning and regression testing, automated evaluation suites (RAGAS, LLM-as-Judge), model A/B testing, and staged rollouts. title: Design Verification Engineer, Silicon Engineering
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience verifying digital logic at RTL using System Verilog for FPGAs and ASICs.
* Experience with UVM Testbenches/environments.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
* Expertise in creating/using verification components and environments in UVM methodology at IP or Subsystem level.
* Experience with image processing, computer vision or machine learning IPs.
* Experience with AMBA(APB/AXI/ACE) or other standard protocols.
* Familiarity with CPU, GPU or other compute/ML architectures.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work with cross-functional teams.

**About the job**
-----------------

Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

As an ASIC Design Verification Engineer on the Silicon team, you will verify next-generation custom silicon accelerators and SoCs, build advanced Universal Verification Methodology (UVM) test environments, and collaborate across design, architecture, and emulation teams to deliver production-quality silicon.

  
The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Create and improve constrained-random verification environments using SystemVerilog and UVM. Use SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) and formal tools for formal verification.
* Perform power-aware simulations and formal verification to validate power management features like clock gating, power gating, and Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS). Develop and implement power-aware test cases, including stress and corner-case scenarios, for robust power integrity.
* Develop and execute coverage-driven verification plans to ensure comprehensive coverage of ASIC designs. Collaborate with design engineers to resolve coverage issues and improve design quality.
* Plan the verification of complex digital design blocks by understanding design specifications and collaborating with design engineers to identify key verification scenarios.

description:

**General Summary:**

Job Description
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Thermal and Peak Current Limits Performance Engineer to join our engineering team.


In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the thermal performance and peak current limits of our products.


You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams like architecture, power and design to analyze, and optimize thermal systems, peak current contraints and components, ensuring they meet performance and reliability standards.


**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Thermal Analysis and Design:** Conduct detailed thermal analysis and design for various components and systems to ensure optimal performance and reliability.
* **Must requirement:**


	+ Understanding of general Power HW/SW and Limits Management HW/SW architecture and framework
	+ Desirable to understand CPU, graphics and AI HW engine and architecture
	+ Understanding of Powe grid and chipset architecture
	+ Ability to analyze and deep dive into Limits throttling mechanisms effectives, efficiencies, latencies and Performance
	+ Ability to debug and analyze Power Thermal Performance issues
	+ Hands ON for characterization and profiling of Power, thermal and electrical spec
	+ Handling measuring equipment for Power and thermal
* **Peak Current Limits Analysis:** Evaluate and optimize peak current limits to ensure safe and efficient operation of electrical systems.
* **Simulation and Modeling:** Knowledge on Utilize advanced simulation and modeling tools to predict thermal behavior and peak current limits, identifying potential issues is desirable
* **Testing and Validation:** Develop and execute test plans to validate thermal performance and peak current limits, ensuring compliance with design specifications.
* **Performance Optimization:** Identify and implement strategies to optimize thermal performance and peak current limits.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with design, chipset/platform architecture, and product test teams to integrate thermal and peak current solutions into product development.
* **Documentation:** Prepare comprehensive technical reports and documentation to support design decisions and project milestones.
* **Problem Solving:**


	+ Troubleshoot and resolve thermal and electrical\-related issues in existing products and during the development phase.
	+ Providing HW and SW Limits Mechanism solutions to manage thermal and electrical risks
* Proficiency in system level debug analysis, efficient usage of Power performance tools for debug and providing detailed analysis
* **Innovation:** Stay updated with the latest advancements in thermal engineering and peak current limits, applying innovative solutions to improve product performance.

**Qualifications:**

* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics \& communications Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or a related field.
* **Experience:** Minimum of 7\+ years of relevant experience in area of Power, Thermal and limits management analysis, design, and optimization
* **Technical Skills:** Knowledge and good understanding of thermal simulation software (e.g., ANSYS, COMSOL), CAD tools, and data analysis, is added advantage.
* **Analytical Skills:** Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data.
* **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
* **Attention to Detail:** High level of attention to detail and accuracy in work.
* **Team Player:** Ability to work effectively in a team environment and contribute to team success.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with thermal management and peak current limits in electronics or semiconductor industries.
* Knowledge of industry standards and regulations related to thermal performance and peak current limits.
* Familiarity with thermal testing equipment and methodologies.
**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2\+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.

description:
Overview:

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
